We propose a method to rank feed-forward neurons at the final prompt token using a custom neuron selection dataset. We transfer the selected neuron identities to train hallucination classifiers on other factual question answering datasets. Our work provides empirical evidence that probes trained using the features from the selected neurons perform on par with probes trained on internal states. We also analyze the distribution of selected neurons and the effect of layer depth on detection performance.
title: NeuroActiSep: Detecting Factual Hallucinations from Feed-Forward Neurons in a Single Pass
title_translated: NeuroActiSep：通过单次前向传播从前馈神经元检测事实幻觉
summary_translated: 大语言模型中的幻觉现象降低了其可靠性并阻碍了实际应用。已有大量白盒研究利用内部表示来检测真实性和事实性的模式。一种较少被研究的方法是识别与幻觉相关的前馈神经元。我们提出一种方法，通过自定义神经元选择数据集，对最终提示词处的前馈神经元进行排序。我们将选定的神经元身份迁移到其他事实问答数据集上训练幻觉检测分类器。我们的工作提供了实证证据，表明使用所选神经元特征训练的探测器性能可与基于内部状态训练的探测器相当。我们还分析了所选神经元的分布特征及其在不同层深度对检测性能的影响。

summary: Agent benchmarks evaluate policy compliance but assume each policy determines a unique correct action. Natural-language policies can violate this assumption through silence, ambiguity, or contradiction, admitting multiple defensible readings that a single gold trajectory cannot capture. Auditing two $\tau^2$-bench domains, we develop a taxonomy of such policy loopholes and show that affected tasks produce unreliable scores: they lower scores across different models in different ways and make every model less consistent across repeated trials. A cross-domain comparison reveals that exploitability requires both policy ambiguity and tool permissiveness: when policy complexity exceeds what tools can enforce, agents resolve gaps inconsistently and scores become unreliable. Policy specification quality sets the ceiling on evaluation quality. Benchmark developers should audit policies before collecting gold annotations.
title: Policy Loopholes in Agent Evaluation: When Policy Ambiguity Masquerades as Agent Error
comment: Accepted at REALM EMNLP 2026
title_translated: 智能体评估中的策略漏洞：当策略模糊性伪装成智能体错误
summary_translated: 智能体基准测试评估策略合规性，但假设每个策略都确定唯一正确的动作。自然语言策略可能通过沉默、模糊或矛盾违反这一假设，导致多种合理解读，单一黄金轨迹无法捕捉。我们审计了两个τ²-基准领域，提出此类策略漏洞的分类体系，并表明受影响的任务会产生不可靠的评分：不同模型以不同方式降低分数，且所有模型在重复试验中的一致性下降。跨领域比较显示，可利用性需要同时具备策略模糊性和工具宽松性：当策略复杂度超过工具可强制的程度时，智能体不一致地填补空白，评分变得不可靠。策略规范质量设定了评估质量的上限。基准开发者应在收集黄金标注前对策略进行审计。

summary: What must a neural system be capable of to implement language? Current research annotates stimuli with linguistic variables and tests which electrodes, voxels, or language-model layers predict neural activity. Yet predictive success leaves mechanisms under-constrained. Here, we show that algebraic properties of language specify invariants that mechanisms must preserve: non-associative hierarchical grouping, commutativity, recursive closure, access to substructures, and structured workspace transitions. We term this the Neural Admissibility Program (NAP). Syntactic structure building is analyzed algebraically, with candidate mechanisms offered for each requirement: content-addressable workspace memory, graph-structured transient dynamics scheduling structure-building operations (e.g. stable heteroclinic channels), and a phase-coupled sealing operation recording grouping. Simulations show that a corrected Marcolli-Berwick entropy-optimized binding gate preserves grouping only within a narrow commitment band. As an alternative, we propose a novel neural binding operation we term 'Meld': two constituent populations converge through shared synapses, integrate sublinearly, and saturate. Meld is, to our knowledge, the closest neurally plausible composition law to syntactic Merge. It preserves every NAP invariant, uses known cortical operations, and recovers hierarchical structure at every tested depth and temperature. It predicts that effective population dimensionality separates alternative bracketings and that the composite depends on constituent disagreement. Importantly, the laws decoding bracketing most accurately are a priori inadmissible, showing that decoding accuracy alone cannot adjudicate between mechanisms. By specifying how neural dynamics can remain faithful to linguistic structure, the NAP changes the criterion by which neural implementations of cognition are evaluated.
title: Formal Properties of Language as Constraints on Neural Dynamics
title_translated: 语言的形式属性作为神经动态的约束
summary_translated: 神经系统要实现语言必须具备什么能力？当前研究通过标注刺激的语言变量，并测试哪些电极、体素或语言模型层能预测神经活动。然而，预测成功仍使机制处于欠约束状态。本文表明，语言的代数属性规定了机制必须保持的不变性：非关联的层次化分组、交换性、递归封闭性、子结构访问能力以及结构化工作空间的转换。我们称之为神经可接受性计划（NAP）。句法结构构建被代数分析，为每项要求提出了候选机制：内容寻址的工作空间记忆、图结构的瞬态动态调度结构（如稳定异循环通道），以及相位耦合的封存操作记录分组。模拟显示，修正后的Marcolli-Berwick熵优化绑定门仅在狭窄承诺带内保持分组。作为替代，我们提出一种新型神经绑定操作，称为‘Meld’：两个构成种群通过共享突触收敛，非线性整合并饱和。据我们所知，Meld是与句法合并最接近的神经可实现组合法则。它保持所有NAP不变性，使用已知皮层操作，并在所有测试深度和温度下恢复层次结构。它预测有效种群维度可区分替代括号化，且复合结果依赖于构成成分的分歧。重要的是，解码括号最准确的法则在先验上不可接受，表明仅凭解码准确性无法判定机制优劣。通过规定神经动态如何忠实地保持语言结构，NAP改变了认知神经实现的评价标准。

summary: Recently, linear attention layers have been increasingly adopted to replace softmax attention at scale for long-context modeling. However, existing context extension approaches typically apply continued pretraining directly without modifying these layers, overlooking the spectral properties of linear attention state dynamics. In this work, we study long-context extension of Gated DeltaNet (GDN) from a spectral perspective of transition matrix and identify two essential factors governing long-range information retrieval: (1) a sufficiently broad slow spectral band aligned with the target dependency length, and (2) the preservation of fast-decaying modes for state clearing and context switching. Based on this observation, we propose SpectralShift, a spectral reparameterization approach for long-context continual pretraining of GDNs. Specifically, SpectralShift reparameterizes the alpha projections initialization to reshape the decay spectrum by enhancing slow propagation capacity, and further introduces a learning-rate scaling for alpha projections to facilitate long-context training. Experiments show that SpectralShift consistently improves long-context capabilities over training, providing an effective and efficient solution for extending context windows of linear attention models. The code has been open-sourced at this https URL .
title: SpectralShift: Effective Context Window Extension of Gated DeltaNet via Spectral Reparameterization
title_translated: SpectralShift：通过谱重参数化实现Gated DeltaNet的有效上下文窗口扩展
summary_translated: 近期，线性注意力层被越来越多地用于大规模长上下文建模，以替代softmax注意力。然而，现有的上下文扩展方法通常直接应用持续预训练，而未修改这些层的谱特性。本文从转移矩阵的谱视角研究Gated DeltaNet（GDN）的长上下文扩展，识别出控制远距离信息检索的两个关键因素：(1) 与目标依赖长度对齐的足够宽的慢谱带；(2) 快速衰减模式的保留，以实现状态清除和上下文切换。基于此观察，我们提出SpectralShift，一种针对GDN持续预训练的谱重参数化方法。具体而言，SpectralShift重新参数化alpha投影初始化，通过增强慢传播能力重塑衰减谱，并进一步引入alpha投影的学习率缩放以促进长上下文训练。实验表明，SpectralShift在训练过程中持续提升长上下文能力，为线性注意力模型的上下文窗口扩展提供了一种有效且高效的方法。代码已开源。

summary: Can financial vision-language models (VLMs) turn chart evidence into reliable action recommendations? Existing hallucination evaluations are mostly claim-centric; they assess whether generated statements are supported, but not whether evidence remains traceable through rationale, confidence, and final action. We introduce E2A-Bench, a 969-query benchmark for financial chart reasoning, constructed from 323 HS300 constituents under three input modalities with deterministic OHLCV-derived evidence anchors. E2A-Bench evaluates grounding, reasoning-action consistency, evidence-confidence calibration, and directional coverage through UCR, RCI, ECI, and NDR, where NDR measures coverage-aware evidence-to-action reliability rather than realized trading performance. Evaluating 20 VLMs reveals three failures hidden by scalar hallucination scores: the lowest-UCR model ranks near the bottom by NDR due to only 6.4% directional coverage; oracle-aided verification reduces unsupported claims but can collapse coverage; and financial fine-tuning amplifies the BUY:SELL ratio by factors of 4.21 to 4.68 across strict base-fine-tuned pairs. These results show that financial VLM evaluation should trace the full evidence-to-action chain rather than rely on a single hallucination score. Code and data: this https URL
title: E2A-Bench: Benchmarking Evidence-to-Action Reliability in Financial Chart Reasoning
comment: EMNLP Findings
title_translated: E2A-Bench：金融图表推理中证据到行动可靠性的基准测试
summary_translated: 金融视觉-语言模型（VLMs）能否将图表证据转化为可靠的行动建议？现有幻觉评估多以声明为中心：评估生成陈述是否得到支持，但未检验证据是否可通过推理、置信度和最终行动追溯。我们引入E2A-Bench，一个包含969个查询的金融图表推理基准，基于323个沪深300成分股，在三种输入模态下构建，采用确定性的OHLCV衍生证据锚点。E2A-Bench通过UCR、RCI、ECI和NDR评估接地性、推理-行动一致性、证据-置信度校准及方向覆盖性，其中NDR衡量的是覆盖感知的证据到行动可靠性，而非实际交易表现。评估20个VLM揭示了三个被标量幻觉得分掩盖的失败：最低UCR模型在NDR上排名靠后，因仅有6.4%的方向覆盖；基于Oracle的验证虽减少不支持的声明，但可能导致覆盖崩溃；金融微调使BUY:SELL比率在严格基线-微调对之间放大4.21至4.68倍。这些结果表明，金融VLM评估应追踪完整的证据到行动链条，而非依赖单一幻觉得分。代码与数据：此链接。

summary: Large language models increasingly analyze computational results and draft manuscripts, making reliable communication as important as correct analysis. Using fixed computational evidence, we tested whether assigning comparisons across modeling choices elsewhere in a research workflow changes manuscript reporting. In constrained sentence-writing tasks, Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5 often omitted numerical qualifications when detailed comparisons were assigned to a group repository, but retained them more often when the same comparison was assigned to Supporting Information or its own working notes; Claude Opus 5 was less sensitive. These effects did not follow a simple accessibility ordering. A targeted placement rule largely restored sentence-level qualification, whereas a generic accuracy reminder did not. Longer contributions retained numerical qualifications, although some summaries across computational settings were still redirected to the repository. Thus, documenting context within an AI workflow does not ensure its communication where readers encounter the result.
title: Editorial routing shapes how computational results are qualified in AI-assisted scientific writing
title_translated: 编辑路由影响AI辅助科学写作中计算结果的表述方式
summary_translated: 大型语言模型越来越多地分析计算结果并撰写论文，因此可靠沟通的重要性不亚于正确分析。我们使用固定的计算证据，测试在研究流程中其他位置分配模型选择对比是否会影响论文报告。在受限的句子写作任务中，Anthropic的Claude Sonnet 5在详细对比被分配至团队仓库时经常省略数值限定词，但在相同对比被分配至附录或其自身工作笔记时则更常保留；Claude Opus 5则敏感性较低。这些效应并不遵循简单的可访问性顺序。针对性放置规则基本恢复了句子级限定词，而通用准确性提醒则无效。较长贡献保留了数值限定词，尽管部分跨计算设置的摘要仍被重定向至仓库。因此，在AI工作流中记录上下文并不能确保读者在遇到结果时获得相应传达。

summary: Semantic text watermarks encode signals in meaning rather than surface token choices, offering robustness to paraphrasing and other semantic-preserving edits. Existing semantic watermarking methods are primarily designed for autoregressive language models (ARLMs), where completed candidate units can be generated and scored before generation proceeds. This paradigm does not naturally extend to diffusion language models (DLMs), where semantic units remain incomplete during intermediate denoising steps and tokens may be updated in flexible orders. We propose DenMark, a semantic watermarking framework that injects key-dependent signals directly into the DLM denoising process. DenMark partitions the output into fixed token regions and uses temporary rollouts as semantic lookahead: conditional completions estimate the eventual semantics of an incomplete region, enabling DenMark to select local updates with higher estimated semantic watermark scores. Repeating this procedure across denoising steps progressively accumulates watermark evidence in the final output. For detection, DenMark uses calibrated scanning over candidate unit sizes to remain robust to boundary shifts introduced by semantic attacks. Across four DLMs, three datasets, and four semantic attacks, DenMark achieves the best results across all reported detection metrics in all 48 backbone-dataset-attack combinations. These results demonstrate that DenMark provides an effective mechanism for robust semantic watermarking in DLMs.
title: DenMark: Robust Semantic Watermarking for Diffusion Language Models
title_translated: DenMark：用于扩散语言模型的鲁棒语义水印
summary_translated: 语义文本水印通过在语义层面而非表面词元选择中编码信号，对改写及其他保持语义的编辑具有更强的鲁棒性。现有的语义水印方法主要针对自回归语言模型（ARLM），其中可在生成前生成并评分完整的候选单元。这一范式无法自然扩展到扩散语言模型（DLM），因为在中间去噪步骤中语义单元仍不完整，且词元可按灵活顺序更新。我们提出DenMark，一种将密钥依赖信号直接注入DLM去噪过程的语义水印框架。DenMark将输出划分为固定词元区域，并使用临时回放作为语义前瞻：条件完成估计不完整区域的最终语义，使DenMark能够选择具有更高估计语义水印得分的局部更新。在去噪步骤中重复此过程，逐步在最终输出中累积水印证据。在检测方面，DenMark采用校准扫描以应对语义攻击引入的边界偏移。在四个DLM、三个数据集和四种语义攻击下，DenMark在所有48种骨干-数据集-攻击组合中均取得了最佳检测性能。这些结果表明，DenMark为DLM中的鲁棒语义水印提供了一种有效机制。

summary: Topic models are widely used to analyze public health-related social media short texts, yet their evaluation remains dominated by metrics that focus entirely on generated topics alone. There is a lack of metrics that quantitatively assess whether assigned topics meaningfully represent the corresponding short-text posts. We propose Document-Topic Alignment metrics (DoTA), an assignment-aware evaluation framework comprising metrics that measure semantic alignment between documents (posts) and their assigned topics. We also introduce margin-based and discriminative variants that capture topic assignment confidence and distinguishability. We evaluate DoTA across five topic models on three public health-related social media datasets from X and compare DoTA metrics with conventional topic-based metrics. Results show that DoTA provides complementary evaluation cues and aligns meaningfully with human evaluations. These findings establish the need for assignment-aware evaluation and demonstrate that the addition of DoTA enables a more comprehensive and practically meaningful evaluation for assessing short-text topic modeling performance.
title: Document Topic Alignment Metrics for Evaluating Topic Models of Short-Text Public Health Communications on Social Media
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS 2027)
title_translated: 用于评估社交媒体短文本公共卫生传播主题模型的文档-主题对齐度量
summary_translated: 主题模型广泛用于分析与公共卫生相关的社交媒体短文本，但其评估仍主要依赖仅关注生成主题的指标。缺乏能定量评估分配的主题是否真正代表相应短文本帖子的度量。我们提出文档-主题对齐度量（DoTA），一个考虑分配关系的评估框架，包含衡量文档（帖子）与其分配主题之间语义对齐的度量。我们还引入基于边距和判别性的变体，以捕捉主题分配置信度和可区分性。我们在来自X平台的三个与公共卫生相关的社交媒体数据集上，对五种主题模型评估了DoTA，并将其与传统基于主题的度量进行比较。结果表明，DoTA提供了互补的评估线索，并与人工评估具有有意义的一致性。这些发现确立了考虑分配关系的评估需求，并证明加入DoTA可实现更全面且更具实际意义的短文本主题建模性能评估。

summary: Context compression reduces generator input in retrieval-augmented generation, but answer quality alone does not characterize citation attribution. We measure citation attribution across compression methods and budgets, comparing reranking, extractive selection, abstractive summarization, token pruning, and an extract-cluster-rewrite construction on ASQA and QASPER under a fixed generator and primary entailment evaluator. On ASQA at a nominal 0.25 budget (achieved compression 0.08), a RECOMP-style compressor's citations score 0.86 precision against its summaries but 0.12 against source spans under our re-attributability protocol. These estimates depend on a shared NLI model for span recovery and citation scoring and lack independent human calibration. Extractive selection's observed grounded precision ranges from 0.43 to 0.49 across nominal budgets from one-half to one-tenth of the ASQA context, while answer quality declines. For the same RECOMP setting, claim verification after source recovery yields an unsupported rate of 0.88 versus 0.17 when checking summaries. This gap persists beyond structural rejection of missing provenance, but remains evaluator-dependent. A 200-question TRUE T5-XXL audit also finds emitted--grounded gaps under both fixed and recomputed source mappings, without establishing human-calibrated support rates.
title: The Attribution-Compression Frontier in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: Accepted to GroundLM 2026 Workshop at EMNLP
title_translated: 检索增强生成中的归属-压缩前沿
summary_translated: 上下文压缩可减少检索增强生成中的生成器输入，但仅凭答案质量无法全面刻画引用归属情况。我们测量了不同压缩方法和预算下的引用归属表现，对比了重排序、抽取选择、抽象摘要、词元剪枝以及一种提取-聚类-重写结构，在ASQA和QASPER数据集上使用固定生成器和主要蕴含评估器。在ASQA上，名义0.25预算（实现压缩0.08）下，RECOMP风格压缩器的引用精度在摘要上为0.86，但在源片段上仅为0.12（基于我们的再归属协议）。这些估计依赖于共享的NLI模型进行片段恢复和引用评分，缺乏独立的人工校准。抽取选择在名义预算从一半到十分之一的范围内，观察到的接地精度在0.43至0.49之间，而答案质量下降。在同一RECOMP设置下，源恢复后的主张验证显示未支持率为0.88，而检查摘要时仅为0.17。这一差距在排除缺失来源的结构性拒绝后依然存在，但依赖于评估者。对200个问题的TRUE T5-XXL审计也发现，在固定和重新计算的源映射下均存在发出内容与真实依据之间的差距，但未建立经人工校准的支持率。

summary: Automated radiology report generation has advanced rapidly in diagnostic accuracy, yet generated reports frequently diverge from the stylistic conventions of authentic radiologist writing in structure, diction, and uncertainty language, a gap which has direct implications for clinician trust and user experience. To address this, we characterize stylistic variation across 2,000 reports from the CheXpert Plus dataset using Bio-ClinicalBERT embeddings, UMAP dimensionality reduction, and HDBSCAN clustering, identifying five distinct reporting patterns differing in pathology focus, narrative structure, and lexical preference. Drawing on these findings, we adapt the inverse constitutional AI framework to derive a style-focused constitution from radiologist-written report pairs without requiring a formal preference dataset. This constitution, encoding conventions of tone, diction, uncertainty calibration, and report structure, is incorporated into the supervised fine-tuning of a MedGemma-4B base model on 25,245 CheXpert Plus training pairs. Constitutional fine-tuning produces a substantial increases in text alignment (BLEU-4: 0.006 to 0.308; ROUGE-L: 0.171 to 0.484) relative to the untuned baseline. These gains show a qualitative shift in structural and lexical alignment rather than marginal improvement, as the baseline model produces near-zero scores due to format mismatch. Overall, we establish corpus-level style characterization and constitutional modeling as an effective and data-efficient strategy for producing radiology reports that conform to authentic radiologist writing conventions.
title: Corpus Characterization and Inverse Constitutional Fine-Tuning for Style-Aware Radiology Reports
title_translated: 风格感知放射科报告的语料库表征与逆宪法微调
summary_translated: 自动化放射科报告生成在诊断准确性方面已取得显著进展，但生成报告常与真实放射科医生写作在结构、用词和不确定性表达上的风格惯例存在偏差，这直接影响临床医生的信任度和用户体验。为解决此问题，我们利用Bio-ClinicalBERT嵌入、UMAP降维和HDBSCAN聚类，对CheXpert Plus数据集中的2,000份报告进行了风格变异表征，识别出五种不同的报告模式，其差异体现在病理关注点、叙事结构和词汇偏好上。基于这些发现，我们采用逆宪法AI框架，从放射科医生撰写的报告对中推导出聚焦风格的宪法，无需正式偏好数据集。该宪法编码了语气、用词、不确定性校准和报告结构等规范，并被纳入MedGemma-4B基础模型在25,245个CheXpert Plus训练对上的监督微调中。宪法微调相比未调优基线，显著提升了文本对齐度（BLEU-4：0.006提升至0.308；ROUGE-L：0.171提升至0.484）。这些提升体现了结构性和词汇性对齐的质变，而非边际改善，因为基线模型因格式不匹配而产生接近零的分数。总体而言，我们建立了语料级风格表征与宪法建模的有效策略，可高效生成符合真实放射科医生写作风格的报告。

summary: We propose to finetune vision-language models to generate more pragmatically optimal referring expressions by transforming observations of incremental listener comprehension, in the form of gaze scanpaths, into learning signals. During training, referring expressions are sampled from the speaker policy being optimized, conditioned on images and target referents; then, a neural listener estimating human gaze behavior maps from images and sampled referring expressions to scanpaths, each represented by a sequence of fixations, with each fixation corresponding to a word in the referring expression. We experiment with several approaches to convert fixation sequences and target referents into token- and sequence-level rewards, which are used to optimize policy parameters. Through evaluation with human listeners, we find that speaker policies trained with gaze-estimating listeners result in significantly more pragmatically-optimal references than base models, reducing sequence length from 15.4 down to 4.0 words while increasing referential success from 75.2 up to 80.0%. Our work demonstrates a promising opportunity for learning to generate utterances through language-based interaction, not only from the explicit signal of communicative success, but also from implicitly-available observations of a listener's process of comprehension.
title: Learning to Refer from Estimated Listener Gaze
comment: Accepted at COLM 2026
title_translated: 从估计听者凝视中学习指称
summary_translated: 我们提出通过将增量听者理解的观测（以凝视路径形式）转化为学习信号，微调视觉-语言模型以生成更具语用最优性的指称表达。在训练过程中，指称表达从正在优化的说话人策略中采样，条件于图像和目标参照物；随后，一个神经听者模型估计人类凝视行为，将图像和采样的指称表达映射为凝视路径，每条路径由一系列注视点组成，每个注视点对应指称表达中的一个词。我们尝试了几种将注视序列和目标参照物转换为词级和序列级奖励的方法，用于优化策略参数。通过人类听者评估，我们发现使用凝视估计听者的说话人策略生成的指称显著更优，序列长度从15.4降至4.0词，同时指称成功率从75.2%提升至80.0%。我们的工作展示了通过语言交互学习生成话语的前景，不仅基于沟通成功的显式信号，还可利用听者理解过程的隐含观测信息。

summary: The rapid diffusion of hate speech and misinformation on social networks challenges democratic societies, since direct suppression efforts may deepen polarization, fuel public distrusts, and strengthen extremist narratives. LLM-driven counter-narratives (CNs) offer a promising way to reduce those risks, yet their effectiveness depends on rhetorical and stylistic choices that remain poorly understood. We present a multi-stage agent-based framework for generating, refining, and evaluating CNs, applied to pro-Russian hate and misinformation narratives on the war with Ukraine and adaptable to other domains. A pilot experiment with human evaluators identifies effective technique style pairings, such as repetition with emotional framing enhancing persuasiveness. Building on these insights, we introduce a multi-agent refinement process that iteratively improves CNs for persuasiveness, emotional engagement, and shareability. After human validation confirmed improvement, an automated safety analysis shows that our refined CNs match or improve on expert-written counterspeech. A simulated experiment then shows that they reduce the perceived strength of pro-Russian narratives and consistently outperform a vanilla LLM baseline, highlighting a pathway toward scalable, narrative-specific interventions against hate speech and misinformation. Code and data accompanying this work are publicly available at this https URL .
title: A Multi-Stage Agentic Framework for Effective Counter-Narrative Generation and Refinement
title_translated: 一种多阶段智能体框架以实现有效的反叙事生成与优化
summary_translated: 社交媒体上仇恨言论和虚假信息的快速传播对民主社会构成挑战，因为直接压制可能加剧分裂、引发公众不信任并强化极端主义叙事。由大语言模型驱动的反叙事（CNs）提供了一种有前景的解决方案，但其有效性取决于尚不明确的修辞和风格选择。我们提出了一种基于多阶段智能体的框架，用于生成、优化和评估反叙事，应用于关于俄乌战争的亲俄仇恨言论和虚假信息，并可扩展至其他领域。一项初步的人类评估实验识别出有效的技术风格组合，例如重复配合情感化框架能增强说服力。基于这些洞察，我们引入了一种多智能体优化过程，迭代提升反叙事在说服力、情感参与度和可分享性方面的表现。经人类验证确认改进后，自动化安全分析显示，我们的优化反叙事在效果上达到或优于专家撰写的反驳言论。模拟实验进一步表明，它们降低了亲俄叙事的感知强度，并持续优于基础大语言模型基准，凸显了针对仇恨言论和虚假信息实现可扩展、叙事特定干预的路径。本文配套代码与数据已公开获取。

summary: Context parameterization enables large language models (LLMs) to internalize contexts into reusable model parameters, avoiding repeated processing across subsequent queries. However, existing methods typically assume static contexts and lack explicit mechanisms for distinguishing validity states under continual updates. To study this real-world scenario, we formalized the Memory Updating with Sequential Evolution (MUSE) task and constructed MUSE-bench to evaluate update incorporation and unaffected-information preservation. The resulting challenge requires preserving the global state while adjusting the contribution of memory evidence. Motivated by this, we proposed PLUME, a training-free method that constructs a global update representation, activates memory evidence to form a local parameter view, and adaptively integrates their predictions during decoding. Comprehensive evaluation on MUSE-bench demonstrated PLUME's effectiveness in sequential evolution settings, yielding relative improvements of 29.9% in average ROUGE-L Recall and 54.9% in LLM-as-a-Judge. Our codes are available at: this https URL .
title: Towards Evolving Context Parameterization for Large Language Models
title_translated: 迈向大型语言模型的动态上下文参数化
summary_translated: 上下文参数化使大型语言模型（LLMs）能够将上下文内化为可重用的模型参数，避免在后续查询中重复处理。然而，现有方法通常假设上下文是静态的，缺乏在持续更新下区分有效状态的显式机制。为研究这一现实场景，我们形式化了‘记忆顺序演化’（MUSE）任务，并构建了MUSE-bench以评估更新整合与无关信息保留能力。该挑战要求在调整记忆证据贡献的同时保持全局状态。受此启发，我们提出了PLUME，一种无需训练的方法：构建全局更新表示，激活记忆证据形成局部参数视图，并在解码过程中自适应地融合其预测。在MUSE-bench上的全面评估表明，PLUME在序列演化设置中表现出色，平均ROUGE-L召回率相对提升29.9%，LLM作为裁判评分提升54.9%。相关代码已公开。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed with external tools that extend what they can do beyond their own knowledge. Tools help on tasks that need external information, but their availability may also change how a model handles questions that do not need them. Prior work has mostly asked whether models select and use tools appropriately; whether an unnecessary tool changes the correctness of answers has received less attention. We ask whether making a related but unnecessary tool available affects a model's ability to answer from its own knowledge, and whether a preceding tool interaction changes this behaviour. We construct 500 query pairs across 10 knowledge domains. Each pair consists of a tool query, which needs the domain's tool, and a closed-domain query, which does not. Six LLMs are evaluated with the tool unavailable, available, and available after a prior tool call. Across 3,000 baseline trials the pooled answer rate is 98.2%. When an unnecessary tool is available it falls to 63.5%, with large differences between models. The decrease occurs even when the tool is rarely called, so it cannot be explained by unnecessary tool invocation alone. A one-sentence scope-aware system instruction recovers most of the lost answers.
title: When Tools Get in the Way: The Effect of Unnecessary Tool Availability on LLM Answering
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables
title_translated: 工具反而成为障碍：不必要工具可用性对大语言模型回答的影响
summary_translated: 大语言模型越来越多地与外部工具结合使用，以扩展其自身知识范围。工具在需要外部信息的任务中有所帮助，但其可用性也可能改变模型处理不需要工具的问题的方式。以往研究主要关注模型是否恰当选择和使用工具；而不必要工具是否影响答案正确性则较少受到关注。我们探讨了提供一个相关但不必要的工具是否会削弱模型基于自身知识作答的能力，以及先前的工具交互是否会影响这种行为。我们在10个知识领域中构建了500组查询对，每对包含一个需使用领域工具的查询和一个无需工具的封闭域查询。六种大语言模型在工具不可用、可用及先前调用过工具三种条件下进行评估。在3000次基线测试中，总体回答率为98.2%。当不必要工具可用时，回答率下降至63.5%，各模型间差异显著。即使工具极少被调用，该下降仍发生，因此不能仅归因于不当调用。一句具备作用域意识的系统指令即可恢复大部分丢失的答案。

summary: A transformer language model is trained to respond to any prompt, but each deployment asks only a narrow range of questions: a support assistant sees delivery complaints, a coding tool sees Python. Every deployment nonetheless pays the same computation per token. This paper measures how much of that cost is avoidable when the range of prompts is known in advance. The mechanism examined is early exit: a small, trained component - called a readout - is attached to an intermediate layer and proposes a token, and a confidence test decides whether to emit it or to run the remaining layers. The models are frozen, and the only supervision used is the model's own output on ordinary traffic. Three findings are reported. First, achievable savings depend strongly on the kind of traffic: at half depth on a 1.5-billion-parameter model, 96 percent of tokens could be emitted early for arithmetic word problems and 8 percent for Chinese-language explanations, at matched token-level fidelity to the full model (a measure whose limits the third finding exposes). Second, of three ways a deployment might use knowledge of its traffic, only customizing the threshold for exiting early is worthwhile: calibrating it per deployment raised exit rates by up to 59 percentage points across three models, and by more than 10 points on most corpora tested. Third, token-level fidelity - the standard evaluation measure in the early-exit literature - fails in domains where tokens can be checked against ground truth: on arithmetic word problems, three models each answered sixty questions correctly when run in full, and between 10 and 28 correctly under early exit, in the configuration that scored highest on fidelity. The intended setting is small models on personal devices, where generation is limited by memory bandwidth rather than computation.
title: One Size Does Not Fit All: Setting Inference Depth from the Questions a Deployment Actually Asks
comment: 20 pages, 5 tables in main text, 9 tables in appendices. Code, prompts, and result files at this https URL
title_translated: 并非一刀切：根据实际部署所提问题设定推理深度
summary_translated: Transformer语言模型经过训练可响应任意提示，但每个部署仅面对有限范围的问题：客服助手只处理配送投诉，编程工具只处理Python问题。然而，每个部署仍支付相同的每token计算成本。本文测量了在预先知晓提示范围的情况下，有多少计算成本是可避免的。研究机制为提前退出：在中间层附加一个小型训练组件（称为读出器），提出一个token，再通过置信度测试决定是否输出该token或继续运行剩余层。模型保持冻结，唯一监督信号来自模型自身在常规流量上的输出。报告三个发现：第一，可实现的节省高度依赖于流量类型：在15亿参数模型上半深度运行时，算术应用题中96%的token可提前输出，而中文解释任务仅8%，且在token级保真度与全模型匹配的前提下（第三点揭示了该指标的局限性）。第二，在三种利用流量知识的方式中，只有定制提前退出阈值具有价值：按部署校准阈值使退出率在三款模型上最高提升59个百分点，多数语料库提升超过10个百分点。第三，token级保真度——早期退出文献中的标准评估指标——在可与真实答案比对的领域中失效：在算术应用题中，三款模型全量运行时均正确回答60题，而早期退出配置下仅正确回答10至28题，尽管其保真度得分最高。研究目标是小模型在个人设备上的部署，其中生成受限于内存带宽而非计算能力。

summary: Although existing multi-agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems have demonstrated promise on complex multimodal reasoning tasks, they remain fundamentally limited in reasoning depth and memory structure, suffering from inadequate retrieval and state blindness when answering knowledge-intensive questions. To address these limitations, we propose GraMRAG, a graph memory-guided multi-agent RAG framework that integrates a dynamic multimodal memory graph to enable stable, multi-step multimodal reasoning. We introduce a vision-text bridged reasoning paradigm that unifies multi-scale entity cropping with a ReAct-style visual toolchain, enhancing the long-horizon cross-modal reasoning capability. We further construct a multimodal memory graph that formalizes agent reasoning as a dynamic directed acyclic graph (DAG), explicitly modeling action-observation dependencies to mitigate state blindness and suppress redundant retrieval. Moreover, we propose Topology-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO) that leverages graph topology for critical path identification and targeted node pruning, enabling fine-grained credit assignment across multi-step reasoning trajectories. Extensive experiments on challenging multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms existing baselines and achieves state-of-the-art performance on complex long-horizon reasoning tasks.
title: GraMRAG: Orchestrating Multi-Agent Multi-Step Reasoning via Graph Memory with Reinforcement Learning
title_translated: GraMRAG：基于图记忆与强化学习的多智能体多步推理协同机制
summary_translated: 尽管现有的多智能体检索增强生成（RAG）系统在复杂多模态推理任务中展现出潜力，但在推理深度和记忆结构方面仍存在根本性局限，尤其在回答知识密集型问题时面临检索不足和状态盲视问题。为解决这些限制，我们提出GraMRAG，一种基于图记忆引导的多智能体RAG框架，通过集成动态多模态记忆图，支持稳定、多步的多模态推理。我们引入视觉-文本桥接推理范式，统一多尺度实体裁剪与ReAct风格的视觉工具链，增强长程跨模态推理能力。我们进一步构建了多模态记忆图，将智能体推理形式化为动态有向无环图（DAG），显式建模动作-观察依赖关系，缓解状态盲视并抑制冗余检索。此外，我们提出拓扑感知策略优化（TAPO），利用图拓扑识别关键路径并针对性剪枝节点，实现多步推理轨迹中的细粒度信用分配。在多个挑战性多模态基准上的大量实验表明，本方法持续优于现有基线，并在复杂长程推理任务上达到当前最优性能。

summary: Frontier LLMs are increasingly capable of conducting automated research, yet their creativity in this setting has not been systematically evaluated. In this paper, we propose a set of metrics to evaluate creativity along the two dimensions of valueness and novelty. Valueness assesses whether each proposed idea is useful, while novelty is evaluated from three perspectives: whether the same idea has appeared before (Exact-Match P-Novelty), whether a previously unexplored variable or variable combination is explored (Variable-level P-Novelty), and whether the idea directly follows retrieved external knowledge or departs from it (H-Novelty). Our evaluation shows that the models achieve relatively similar scores on most creativity metrics, but differ substantially in Variable-level P-Novelty, which reflects the breadth of research-space exploration. Further correlation and idea-level performance analyses show that Variable-level P-Novelty is the creativity dimension most strongly associated with research performance.
title: Measuring the Creativity of Frontier LLMs in Automated Research
title_translated: 评估前沿大语言模型在自动化研究中的创造力
summary_translated: 前沿大语言模型在自动化研究方面的能力日益增强，但其在此场景下的创造力尚未得到系统性评估。本文提出了一套指标，从价值性和新颖性两个维度评估创造力。价值性评估每个提出想法的实用性，而新颖性则从三个角度衡量：该想法是否曾出现过（精确匹配的P-新颖性）、是否探索了之前未涉及的变量或变量组合（变量级P-新颖性），以及该想法是否直接遵循检索到的外部知识或与其相背离（H-新颖性）。评估结果显示，各模型在大多数创造力指标上得分相近，但在变量级P-新颖性上存在显著差异，这反映了研究空间探索的广度。进一步的相关性与逐项表现分析表明，变量级P-新颖性是与研究表现最密切相关的一个创造力维度。

summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has shown remarkable success in improving the mathematical reasoning of large language models. Yet problems beyond the model's current capability, where rollouts uniformly fail and no learning signal is produced, are structurally wasted despite marking the most informative training frontier. We show that these otherwise-inert problems can be unlocked via teacher-guided curriculum learning: partial reasoning traces from a stronger model create a graded difficulty landscape, and a backward-chaining curriculum progressively withdraws guidance until the model solves problems unaided. Training on only 128 unsolvable problems matches or exceeds GRPO trained on a full 2,000-problem corpus (~16x data efficiency) on the nine-benchmark average for both base models, while substantially expanding the reasoning boundary measured by pass@k at large k. Furthermore, we identify a distribution-shift cost that is particularly acute in the unsolvable-only regime and propose Monotone Frontier Curriculum (MFC), a method that monotonically drives training toward unguided solving, consistently outperforming existing curriculum methods.
title: Unlocking the Unsolvable: Teacher-Guided Curriculum for Data-Efficient RLVR
comment: 20 pages, 9 figures. Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
title_translated: 解锁不可解问题：面向数据高效强化学习验证奖励的教师引导课程
summary_translated: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在提升大语言模型数学推理能力方面取得了显著成功。然而，超出模型当前能力范围的问题——即所有尝试均失败且无学习信号产生——在结构上被浪费，尽管这些正是最具信息量的训练前沿。我们证明，通过教师引导的课程学习，这些原本无响应的问题可以被激活：更强模型提供的部分推理轨迹构建出渐进难度的环境，而后向链式课程逐步撤回指导，直至模型能独立解决问题。仅使用128个不可解问题进行训练，在九个基准测试上的平均表现即可达到或超过基于完整2,000题语料库（约16倍数据效率）训练的GRPO方法，同时显著扩展了以大k值pass@k衡量的推理边界。此外，我们识别出在仅包含不可解问题的训练模式下尤为突出的分布偏移成本，并提出了单调前沿课程（MFC）方法，该方法单调地推动训练向无指导求解方向发展，持续优于现有课程方法。

summary: Arabic large-language-model (LLM) evaluation has matured around Modern Standard Arabic (MSA): aggregated leaderboards such as the Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard (OALL), HELM Arabic, and BALSAM rank models across dozens of MSA tasks, and frontier systems increasingly saturate them. Dialectal Arabic, the language Iraqis actually speak, remains nearly invisible to this infrastructure. We introduce Mizan ("the balance"), Iraq's national benchmark for evaluating LLMs on Iraqi Arabic and the Iraqi civic context: an MSA baseline track paired with an Iraqi track across six axes (dialect comprehension, dialect generation, bidirectional MSA-Iraqi translation, Iraq-specific knowledge, official-document field extraction, and safety), built from 340 originally authored, dually reviewed items with statistically audited answer positions and Wilson intervals on every published score. A pilot evaluation of 27 systems, spanning closed frontier models three days after release, open weights across size tiers, and an Arabic trio of commercial, open-specialized, and sovereign systems, yields four findings. The MSA track saturates while the Iraqi track discriminates, with a consistent 14-18-point per-model gap and statistically tied leaders. Official-document extraction confines every system to 32-56. Arabic-focused specialization behaves as MSA specialization: two dedicated Arabic models score below a size-matched generalist on the Iraqi track. And the safety-hardened tier of the newest model family deterministically refuses innocuous dialect-comprehension items as policy violations, an over-refusal mode invisible to MSA benchmarks. The platform enforces an integrity protocol of immutable snapshots, verification certificates, a human publication gate, and public retraction, all exercised during this study. Code and the public development set accompany the paper.
title: Mizan: A National Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models on Iraqi Arabic and the Iraqi Civic Context

title_translated: Mizan：针对伊拉克阿拉伯语与伊拉克公民语境的大语言模型国家基准
summary_translated: 阿拉伯语大语言模型（LLM）评估已围绕现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）成熟发展：诸如Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard（OALL）、HELM Arabic和BALSAM等聚合排行榜对数十个MSA任务上的模型进行排名，前沿系统正逐渐饱和。而伊拉克人实际使用的方言阿拉伯语却几乎未被这一评估基础设施覆盖。我们引入Mizan（意为“天平”），这是伊拉克首个国家层面的基准，用于评估LLM在伊拉克阿拉伯语及伊拉克公民语境下的表现：包含一个MSA基线赛道和一个伊拉克赛道，涵盖六个维度（方言理解、方言生成、双向MSA-伊拉克语翻译、伊拉克特定知识、官方文档字段提取和安全性），基于340个原创、双重评审的题目构建，所有发布分数均经过统计审计并提供威尔逊区间。对27个系统的初步评估（包括发布后三天内的闭源前沿模型、跨规模的开源模型，以及商业、开源专用和主权型阿拉伯语三类系统）得出四项发现：MSA赛道已趋于饱和，而伊拉克赛道具有区分能力，每模型间保持14-18分差距且领导者统计上持平；官方文档提取任务将所有系统限制在32-56分区间；专注阿拉伯语的模型表现如同专注MSA的模型：两个专门化阿拉伯语模型在伊拉克赛道上的表现低于同规模通用模型；最新模型家族的安全强化层级会将无害的方言理解任务判定为政策违规，表现出一种MSA基准无法察觉的过度拒绝行为。该平台实施了不可变快照、验证证书、人工出版审核和公开撤稿等完整性协议，本研究全程执行。代码与公开开发集随论文一同发布。

summary: A central tenet of human cognition is systematicity, the principle that understanding one concept is inherently tied to understanding close variations of that concept. Do reasoning models robustly exhibit such systematicity? If so, we would expect consistent performance on structurally equivalent variants of the same task. Here, we extend established rule induction tasks from cognitive science to assess the systematicity of thought in current reasoning models. Each task family has compositional structure that we use to create structurally equivalent task variations through task isomorphisms such as recombination and substitution. We find that despite being able to correctly solve a task, models often fail on structurally equivalent variants of the same task. These findings suggest that many model behaviors lack systematicity, rendering it difficult to robustly establish the cognitive abilities of reasoning models beyond the particular contexts they were evaluated in.
title: Thought without systematicity? Evaluating reasoning models on rule induction tasks

title_translated: 没有系统性的思考？在规则归纳任务中评估推理模型
summary_translated: 人类认知的核心原则之一是系统性，即理解一个概念必然关联于理解其相关变体。推理模型是否稳健地表现出这种系统性？如果确实如此，我们应期望在结构相同的任务变体上表现一致。本文将认知科学中已有的规则归纳任务拓展至评估当前推理模型的思维系统性。每个任务族具有组合结构，我们通过任务同构（如重组与替换）创建结构等价的任务变体。结果发现，尽管模型能够正确解决某一任务，却常常在结构等价的变体上失败。这些发现表明，许多模型的行为缺乏系统性，使得难以在特定评估情境之外稳健地确立推理模型的认知能力。

summary: The CRITICS project addresses science accessibility and literacy by converging advanced Machine Translation (MT) based on Large Language Models (LLMs) with educational technology. By leveraging MT systems specifically optimized for scientific content, educational institutions can provide accurate, culturally relevant translations of scientific materials in students' native languages, ensuring that complex scientific concepts are comprehensible while maintaining technical accuracy. Building on these translations, the project explores the design and evaluation of innovative science teaching-learning proposals grounded in curriculum-aligned teaching-learning. Thus, CRITICS will investigate key components of scientific argumentation and critical thinking practices together with textual feedback aligned with learning objectives and assessment criteria inspired by competence-based evaluation frameworks. CRITICS aims to break down language barriers to accessing cutting-edge research and educational materials currently available only in high-resourced languages, thereby facilitating the democratization of scientific knowledge and fostering critical thinking in science education.
title: CRITICS - Critical Science Without Borders: Language Models to Promote Critical Thinking in Science Education
comment: 9 pages
title_translated: CRITICS——无国界的批判科学：利用语言模型促进科学教育中的批判性思维
summary_translated: CRITICS项目通过融合基于大语言模型（LLMs）的先进机器翻译（MT）与教育技术，致力于提升科学可及性与科学素养。借助专为科学内容优化的MT系统，教育机构可为学生母语提供准确且文化相关的科学材料翻译，确保复杂科学概念既易懂又保持技术准确性。基于这些翻译，项目探索并评估了与课程对齐的创新教学设计与学习方案。因此，CRITICS将研究科学论证的关键要素与批判性思维实践，结合与学习目标和基于能力评估框架的考核标准相一致的文本反馈。该项目旨在打破目前仅限于高资源语言的前沿科研与教育资源获取的语言壁垒，推动科学知识的民主化，并在科学教育中培养批判性思维。

summary: Datasets that ship automatically generated feature annotations invite a question rarely asked of them: would a human agree with those labels? This report answers that for the Objective Projection corpus, a Turkish narrative dataset whose scenes carry a per-scene applied_rules field from a rule-based detector over six craft features -- two prohibitions (emotion labelling, simile) and four positive techniques (materialized metaphor, micro-focus, temporal anchor, atmosphere contradiction). Three studies are reported. Study 1 ($n = 120$) scores the detector against blind labels from the scheme's own author. Study 2 ($n = 100$, a disjoint scene set) scores the detector plus Gemini 2.5 Flash and Grok against an independent non-expert rater whose labels were locked before any machine ran. Study 2b re-runs the identical protocol with Claude Fable 5 (High) and ChatGPT 5.5. The central result concerns one rule. On materialized metaphor -- closest to the methodology's theoretical core -- the five machine labellers returned positive rates of $0$, $1$, $40$, $72$ and $78$ out of $100$ scenes, against a human count of $9$. Cohen's $\kappa$ was at or indistinguishable from chance for five of six labellers, across both human references and both scene sets: $0.004$, $0.015$, $0.000$, $0.019$, $0.027$. Raw agreement ranged from $74.7\%$ to $84.5\%$, an artefact of class imbalance rather than a sign of competence. We deliberately do not resolve this into a single story. Two readings survive: the feature is genuinely inferential and beyond current automatic detection, or the rule's definition is not yet operational enough for any rater to apply consistently -- including the human. Distinguishing them needs a second independent human rater, which this report does not have and therefore does not claim.
title: Inter-Rater Reliability of LLM and Rule-Based Annotation for Inferential Narrative Features: Three Studies on a Turkish Corpus

title_translated: 基于大模型与规则的推断性叙事特征标注者间一致性：针对土耳其语语料库的三项研究
summary_translated: 自动生成特征标注的数据集常引发一个很少被问及的问题：人类标注者是否会认同这些标签？本报告针对客观投射语料库（一个土耳其语叙事数据集）回答了这一问题，该语料库中的场景包含由基于规则的检测器对六种叙事技巧进行标注的结果——包括两种禁止项（情感标签、隐喻）和四种积极技巧（具象化隐喻、微焦点、时间锚点、氛围矛盾）。报告中进行了三项研究。研究1（n=120）将检测器结果与该标注体系作者提供的盲评标签进行对比。研究2（n=100，独立场景集）将检测器、Gemini 2.5 Flash和Grok与一位独立非专家标注者的标签进行对比，其标签在任何机器运行前已锁定。研究2b则使用Claude Fable 5（高版本）和ChatGPT 5.5重复相同协议。核心发现集中在一项规则上：在最接近方法论理论核心的“具象化隐喻”任务中，五位机器标注者在100个场景中分别给出0、1、40、72和78个阳性结果，而人类标注为9个。在两种人类参考标准和两个场景集下，六位标注者中有五位的Cohen's κ值接近或无法区分于随机水平（分别为0.004、0.015、0.000、0.019、0.027）。原始一致性在74.7%至84.5%之间，这是类别不平衡造成的伪象，而非能力体现。我们刻意不将其归结为单一解释，两种解读仍存：该特征本质上是推断性的，超出当前自动检测能力；或该规则定义尚未足够明确，以至于任何标注者（包括人类）都无法一致应用。区分二者需要第二个独立的人类标注者，但本报告未具备此条件，因此不作主张。

summary: We present North Small Translate, an open-weight, LLM-based machine translation (MT) model with instruction-following capabilities built on the same foundation as Cohere's Command A Plus, a mixture-of-experts architecture with 25 billion active parameters out of 218 billion total parameters. North Small Translate is trained using difficulty sampling to obtain challenging documents and a five-step training protocol combining supervised fine-tuning, direct preference optimization, and online reinforcement learning. We prioritized throughput through a non-reasoning base model and supplemented with optional agentic capabilities to unlock translation quality gains. North Small Translate is trained to perform MT-related tasks, including post-editing and quality estimation, as well as related tasks such as general instruction following. The model achieves top MT performance across 50 languages in the class of models under 1T parameters, with no need to run expensive reasoning at inference time.
title: North Small Translate: Advanced Cost-Effective Translation (Cohere CAT+)
title_translated: North Small Translate：先进的低成本翻译（Cohere CAT+）
summary_translated: 我们提出North Small Translate，一个基于开源权重的大型语言模型（LLM）机器翻译（MT）模型，具备指令遵循能力，其基础架构与Cohere的Command A Plus相同，采用专家混合架构，激活参数达250亿，总参数量为2180亿。North Small Translate通过难度采样获取挑战性文档，并采用五步训练流程，结合监督微调、直接偏好优化和在线强化学习。我们优先考虑吞吐量，采用非推理型基础模型，并可选地引入代理能力以提升翻译质量。该模型被训练用于执行MT相关任务，如后期编辑和质量评估，以及通用指令遵循等关联任务。在参数量低于1万亿的模型类别中，North Small Translate在50种语言上实现了顶尖的MT性能，且推理时无需运行昂贵的推理过程。

summary: Pharmaceutical sales forecasts inform planning across products, regions, and distribution channels, yet their interpretation depends on inventory availability, transaction semantics, product lifecycle, and the information available when each forecast is issued. A model prediction alone does not preserve these conditions or establish whether a forecast is suitable for operational use. We present Phorecaster365, a human-supervised reference architecture that connects enterprise resource planning data to reviewable pharmaceutical sales forecasts. The architecture separates source ingestion, product-region series construction, temporally valid feature generation, statistical and machine-learning modeling, ensemble formation, uncertainty assessment, planner review, and lifecycle governance. Its central intermediate representation is a forecast context package that preserves the source snapshot, forecast target, temporal cutoff, available covariates, data-quality state, and hierarchy version. A corresponding forecast evidence package links predictions to model and calibration versions, exceptions, human adjustments, and publication history. Development experience with a synthetic panel of 10,950 daily records across 30 product-region series informs the design. Historical experiment summaries are retained only as descriptive evidence of development because their evaluation does not establish independent predictive validity. We specify a rolling-origin evaluation protocol, baseline and ablation requirements, uncertainty and robustness assessments, and a staged pathway from synthetic testing to use in governed planning. The contribution is an implementation-neutral system design and validation framework; the report does not establish real-world forecasting accuracy, comparative superiority, or operational benefit.
title: Phorecaster365: A Human-Supervised Reference Architecture for Hybrid Pharmaceutical Sales Forecasting and Planning Decision Support

title_translated: Phorecaster365：混合制药销售预测与规划决策支持的人机协同参考架构
summary_translated: 制药销售预测影响产品、区域和分销渠道的规划，但其解读依赖于库存可用性、交易语义、产品生命周期以及每次预测发布时可获得的信息。仅靠模型预测无法保留这些条件，也无法判断预测是否适用于实际操作。我们提出Phorecaster365，一种人机协同的参考架构，将企业资源规划数据与可审查的制药销售预测相连接。该架构分离了数据源摄入、产品-区域序列构建、时间有效特征生成、统计与机器学习建模、集成形成、不确定性评估、规划者审查和生命周期治理等环节。其核心中间表示为“预测上下文包”，包含源快照、预测目标、时间截止点、可用协变量、数据质量状态和层级版本。对应的“预测证据包”则链接预测与模型及校准版本、异常、人工调整和发布历史。基于包含10,950条每日记录的合成样本集（30个产品-区域序列）的开发经验指导了设计。历史实验总结仅作为开发过程的描述性证据保留，因其评估无法建立独立预测有效性。我们规定了滚动起源评估协议、基线与消融要求、不确定性与鲁棒性评估，以及从合成测试到受控规划中使用的分阶段路径。贡献在于一个与实现无关的系统设计与验证框架；报告未确立真实世界预测准确性、相对优越性或操作效益。

summary: Multimodal clinical AI typically assumes that the waveform, report, metadata, and downstream predictions attached to a record belong to the same patient. In practice, linkage failures can silently assemble individually plausible but cross-patient components, creating a safety problem that standard predictive models are not designed to detect. We study this problem as multimodal record integrity triage: given an assembled record, should its modalities be trusted to belong together? We introduce SHIFT-M3, a lightweight text-based pre-fusion screen that measures alignment-based consistency between two separately produced ECG text views: an LLM-generated interpretation and a clinical report summary. On 784,680 MEETI ECG records, SHIFT-M3 achieves 97.6% TPR@5% FPR for full text-view swaps (AUROC 0.996), 90.3% for partial swaps (AUROC 0.974), and 97.7% for label-matched hard negatives (AUROC 0.996) with only 573,569 parameters. Compared with same-dataset lexical baselines, the gains are largest on partial swaps and hard negatives, suggesting that the model is learning more than surface overlap. We also introduce the CMST (Conflict-type Multimodal Stress Test) evaluation taxonomy, a three-seed stability study, a loss ablation, a temporal-tolerance sweep, and a shared-token masking control. The main remaining failure mode is longitudinal ambiguity: at the default operating point, same-patient cross-visit pairs still produce 87.0% Type-II false positives.
title: SHIFT-M3: Pre-fusion Alignment-based Consistency Screening for Multimodal ECG Record Integrity

title_translated: SHIFT-M3：基于预融合对齐的一致性筛查以保障多模态心电图记录完整性
summary_translated: 多模态临床AI通常假设某条记录附带的心电图波形、报告、元数据和下游预测均属于同一患者。但在实践中，链接失败可能无声地组合出各自看似合理但跨患者的组件，造成安全问题，而标准预测模型并未设计用于检测此类情况。我们将此问题视为多模态记录完整性筛选：给定一个组装后的记录，其各模态是否可信属于同一患者？我们提出SHIFT-M3，一种轻量级基于文本的预融合筛查方法，通过测量两个独立生成的心电图文本视图之间的对齐一致性来判断：LLM生成的解释与临床报告摘要。在784,680条MEETI心电图记录上，SHIFT-M3在全文本视图互换情况下达到97.6%的TPR@5% FPR（AUROC 0.996），部分互换情况下为90.3%（AUROC 0.974），标签匹配的硬负样本情况下为97.7%（AUROC 0.996），仅需573,569个参数。相较于同数据集的词汇基线，其在部分互换和硬负样本上的提升最大，表明模型学习的不仅是表面重叠。我们还引入了CMST（冲突类型多模态压力测试）评估分类法、三种子稳定性研究、损失消融分析、时间容忍度扫描和共享词标记控制。主要剩余失效模式为纵向模糊性：在默认运行点，同一患者不同就诊间的配对仍产生87.0%的II型假阳性。

summary: Automatic sentence function identification is important for many downstream natural language processing (NLP) applications such as dialogue systems, text-to-speech synthesis, and machine translation. However, benchmark resources for Bangla sentence function classification remain limited. To mitigate this gap, this paper introduces a corpus of 10,000 Bangla sentences, manually annotated into four functional categories, namely declarative, interrogative, imperative, and exclamatory. The corpus is nearly balanced across the four classes, with high annotation reliability reflected by a Fleiss\' Kappa of 0.82. Furthermore, we evaluate multiple feature representations, including Bag-of-Words (BoW), TF-IDF, and Word2Vec, with several classical machine learning classifiers. In addition, two heterogeneous ensemble models, namely Single-Level Ensemble (SLE) and Double-Level Ensemble (DLE), are utilized to improve classification performance. Experimental results show that TF-IDF consistently outperforms Word2Vec, likely due to its ability to emphasize discriminative lexical cues associated with sentence functions, particularly given the relatively small corpus used to train Word2Vec. The DLE model with TF-IDF features achieves the best performance with accuracy and macro-F1 of 0.95, demonstrating the effectiveness of sparse lexical representations and heterogeneous ensemble learning for this task. Further cross-validation confirms the robustness of the approach, while LIME-based interpretability provides insights into model predictions. The developed corpus and model benchmarking establish strong baselines for Bangla sentence function classification.
title: Bangla Sentence Function Classification: Corpus Development, Model Benchmarking, and Interpretability
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE 5th International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
title_translated: 孟加拉语句子功能分类：语料库构建、模型基准测试与可解释性
summary_translated: 自动识别句子功能对对话系统、文本转语音合成和机器翻译等多种自然语言处理（NLP）应用至关重要。然而，针对孟加拉语句子功能分类的基准资源仍然有限。为弥补这一差距，本文构建了一个包含10,000个孟加拉语句子的语料库，由人工标注为四类功能：陈述句、疑问句、祈使句和感叹句。该语料库在四类间近乎平衡，标注可靠性高，Fleiss' Kappa达0.82。此外，我们评估了多种特征表示方法，包括词袋（BoW）、TF-IDF和Word2Vec，以及多种经典机器学习分类器。同时，采用两种异构集成模型——单层集成（SLE）和双层集成（DLE）以提升分类性能。实验结果表明，TF-IDF始终优于Word2Vec，可能因其能更好地强调与句子功能相关的判别性词汇线索，尤其考虑到训练Word2Vec所用语料库相对较小。使用TF-IDF特征的DLE模型表现最佳，准确率和宏F1均为0.95，证明了稀疏词汇表示与异构集成学习在此任务中的有效性。进一步交叉验证确认了方法的稳健性，而基于LIME的可解释性分析为模型预测提供了洞察。所构建的语料库和模型基准测试为孟加拉语句子功能分类建立了强有力的基线。

summary: Enterprise customer support systems must answer customer questions correctly, retrieve the right policy information, use customer context, and pass difficult cases to human agents when needed. This paper presents ShopEase, a Generative AI-based multi-agent framework for enterprise customer support. The system combines six components: Intent, CRM, Memory, Hybrid RAG, Escalation, and Supervisor, and uses LLaMA 3.2 running locally through Ollama for response generation. The retrieval module combines FAISS (dense retrieval) and BM25 (sparse retrieval), and six configurations are evaluated: BM25-only, FAISS-only, Fair RRF, Weighted RRF, RRF with Cross-Encoder, and Top-10 Hybrid with Cross-Encoder. Instead of using a fixed mapping between intent and policy, the policy category is decided directly from the retrieved documents. The system was evaluated on 2632 held-out customer queries across six categories: Refund, Return, Shipping, Cancellation, Damaged Product, and Unknown. FAISS-only achieved the highest accuracy of 85.37\% (2247 correct predictions), closely followed by Weighted RRF at 85.07\%. BM25-only achieved only 55.74\% accuracy. Adding cross-encoder reranking did not improve results: RRF with Cross-Encoder reached 83.24\%, and Top-10 Hybrid with Cross-Encoder reached 81.88\%, while also increasing response latency. Category-level analysis shows strong performance on Shipping, Cancellation, and Return, while Unknown queries remain the main source of errors. Statistical testing using McNemar's test shows no significant difference between FAISS-only and Weighted RRF, though both perform significantly better than Fair RRF and the cross-encoder configurations. Overall, dense retrieval gives the best accuracy on this dataset, and additional reranking adds processing time without improving classification performance.
title: ShopEase: A Generative AI-Based Multi-Agent Framework for Intelligent Enterprise Customer Support Using Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_translated: ShopEase：一种基于生成式AI的多智能体框架，用于企业客户支持的混合检索增强生成
summary_translated: 企业客户支持系统必须准确回答客户问题、检索正确的政策信息、利用客户上下文，并在必要时将复杂案例转交人工客服。本文提出ShopEase，一种基于生成式AI的企业客户支持多智能体框架。该系统包含六个组件：意图识别、CRM、记忆、混合RAG、升级和监督模块，并使用通过Ollama本地运行的LLaMA 3.2进行响应生成。检索模块结合FAISS（密集检索）和BM25（稀疏检索），评估了六种配置：仅BM25、仅FAISS、公平RRF、加权RRF、带交叉编码器的RRF，以及带交叉编码器的Top-10混合方案。与固定意图到政策映射不同，政策类别直接从检索到的文档中决定。系统在六个类别（退款、退货、配送、取消、损坏商品、未知）共2632个保留客户查询上进行了评估。仅FAISS配置达到最高准确率85.37%（2247次正确预测），紧随其后的是加权RRF（85.07%）。仅BM25的准确率为55.74%。加入交叉编码器重排序并未提升效果：带交叉编码器的RRF为83.24%，Top-10混合方案为81.88%，且增加了响应延迟。按类别分析显示，在配送、取消和退货方面表现良好，而未知查询仍是主要错误来源。McNemar检验表明，FAISS-only与加权RRF之间无显著差异，但两者均显著优于公平RRF和交叉编码器配置。总体而言，密集检索在此数据集上表现最佳，额外重排序增加了处理时间却未提升分类性能。

summary: In this paper, we extend FLORES+ with Portuguese-source evaluation sets for three Mozambican Bantu varieties: Xichangana, Mozambican Nyanja, and Sena. We compare Xichangana with the existing Tsonga reference and Mozambican Nyanja with Chichewa, and evaluate NLLB-200, Google Translate, GPT, and a variant-aware NLLB model. Holding system output fixed reveals substantial reference sensitivity. On \textit{devtest}, changing only the reference from Tsonga to Xichangana reduces spBLEU by 13.10 points for NLLB-200 and 15.30 for Google. On matched Nyanja subsets, replacing Chichewa with Mozambican Nyanja produces smaller but consistent reductions of 3.03 and 6.10 spBLEU, respectively. Variant-aware fine-tuning reverses this pattern on the intended targets: relative to NLLB-200, it improves Xichangana by 7.04 spBLEU and Mozambican Nyanja by 5.33 on \textit{devtest}, while losing performance on the sibling references. GPT is competitive on Tsonga and Chichewa but substantially weaker on the Mozambican varieties. For Sena, the finetuned model reaches 12.64 spBLEU and 36.21 chrF++ on \textit{devtest}. These findings motivate variety-aware language identifiers, references, and reporting for cross-border languages or language dialects/variants. The data is publicly available on Hugging Face at this https URL
title: Measuring the Cost of Variety Conflation in Multilingual MT Evaluation: Adding Mozambican Xichangana, Nyanja and Sena to FLORES+
