title_translated: 多语言机器翻译评估中多样性混淆成本的度量：在FLORES+中加入莫桑比克希昌纳语、尼亚贾语和塞纳语
summary_translated: 本文将葡萄牙语源评估集扩展至三种莫桑比克班图语变体：希昌纳语、莫桑比克尼亚贾语和塞纳语。我们比较了希昌纳语与现有宗通语参考标准，以及莫桑比克尼亚贾语与奇切瓦语，并评估了NLLB-200、Google翻译、GPT和一种变体感知的NLLB模型。在保持系统输出不变的情况下，发现参考标准具有显著敏感性。在开发测试集上，仅将参考标准从宗通语更换为希昌纳语，就使NLLB-200的spBLEU下降13.10分，Google下降15.30分。在匹配的尼亚贾子集上，将奇切瓦语替换为莫桑比克尼亚贾语分别导致spBLEU下降3.03和6.10分。变体感知微调在目标语言上逆转了这一趋势：相对于NLLB-200，它在开发测试集上使希昌纳语提升7.04 spBLEU，莫桑比克尼亚贾语提升5.33 spBLEU，但在兄弟参考标准上性能下降。GPT在宗通语和奇切瓦语上表现竞争力，但在莫桑比克变体上明显较弱。对于塞纳语，微调模型在开发测试集上达到12.64 spBLEU和36.21 chrF++。这些发现强调了跨边界语言或方言/变体应采用变体感知的语言标识符、参考标准和报告方式。数据已在Hugging Face公开提供。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for emotional support and relationship advice, where a model's tendency to preserve a user's face can inadvertently reinforce harmful interpersonal behaviors. To systematically examine this risk, we developed the Romantic Relationship Advice-Seeking Prompts (RRASP) dataset of 2,400 prompts across five relationship themes and evaluated social sycophancy using the ELEPHANT framework on two consumer-facing models, GPT-5 Mini and Gemini 3 Flash. Contrary to our initial hypothesis, grammatical mood alone did not produce systematic differences in sycophantic behavior, suggesting that what a user implies matters more than how they phrase it. Instead, perspective-driven framing had a stronger influence, with gaps between original and flipped prompts widening in follow-up responses. Consistent increases in framing and moral sycophancy across turns indicate that models become more likely to accept a user's stated premises and affirm their ethical stance as a dialogue progresses. Notably, Gemini 3 Flash exhibited substantially smaller increases in moral sycophancy than GPT-5 Mini, suggesting it is more resistant to reinforcing ethically problematic positions across turns.
title: Sweet Talkers: How Query Formulation Shapes Sycophancy in Romantic Relationship Advice
comment: Accepted to LUHME Workshop @ EMNLP 2026
title_translated: 甜言蜜语者：查询表述如何塑造浪漫关系建议中的阿谀奉承行为
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于情感支持和关系建议，而模型倾向于维护用户面子的倾向可能无意中强化有害的人际互动行为。为系统性地考察这一风险，我们构建了包含2400个提示的浪漫关系建议求助数据集（RRASP），涵盖五个关系主题，并使用ELEPHANT框架对两款面向消费者的应用模型GPT-5 Mini和Gemini 3 Flash进行了社会阿谀奉承行为评估。与初始假设相反，语法语气本身并未产生系统性的阿谀行为差异，表明用户隐含的内容比表达方式更为重要。相反，视角驱动的表述框架影响更强，原始与反转提示之间的差距在后续回复中扩大。随着对话推进，框架和道德阿谀行为持续增加，表明模型更可能接受用户陈述的前提并肯定其伦理立场。值得注意的是，Gemini 3 Flash在道德阿谀行为上的增长幅度远小于GPT-5 Mini，表明其对跨轮次强化伦理问题立场更具抵抗力。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate the responses of other language models. This approach, known as LLM-as-a-Judge, is faster and cheaper than human evaluation. However, a judge may produce consistent scores without necessarily agreeing with human evaluators. In this work, we study this issue using two local open-weight LLM judges, LLaMA-3-8B and Qwen2.5-7B. We evaluate 300 responses generated by an instruction-tuned GPT-2 (124M) model for 100 questions covering five categories: factual knowledge, instruction following, mathematics, reasoning, and writing. Each response is scored by nine human annotators and is evaluated three times by each LLM judge using the same rubric. We compare the judge scores with the average human scores using Pearson correlation, Spearman correlation, mean absolute error (MAE), signed bias, and self-consistency. LLaMA-3-8B shows a Pearson correlation of 0.275 with human scores, while Qwen2.5-7B achieves 0.340. Their MAEs are 27.71 and 18.64, respectively. Despite this limited agreement, both judges show high self-consistency, with exact consistency rates of 97.3\% for LLaMA-3-8B and 92.3\% for Qwen2.5-7B. These results show that high self-consistency does not necessarily indicate high agreement with human judgments. Our findings highlight the need to evaluate both consistency and human alignment when using local LLMs as automatic judges.
title: When Consistency Does Not Mean Reliability: Evaluating Local LLM Judges Against Human Ratings
title_translated: 一致性不等于可靠性：对比本地LLM评判者与人类评分的评估
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正被广泛用于评估其他语言模型的输出。这种被称为“LLM作为评判者”的方法比人工评估更快、更便宜。然而，评判者可能产生一致的评分却不一定与人类评价者意见一致。本文研究了这一问题，使用两个本地开源权重LLM评判者：LLaMA-3-8B和Qwen2.5-7B。我们评估了由指令微调的GPT-2（124M）模型生成的300条回应，覆盖100个问题，涉及五个类别：事实知识、指令遵循、数学、推理和写作。每条回应由九名人类标注者评分，并由每个LLM评判者使用相同评分标准重复评估三次。我们通过皮尔逊相关系数、斯皮尔曼相关系数、平均绝对误差（MAE）、有符号偏差和自一致性等指标，将评判者评分与平均人类评分进行比较。LLaMA-3-8B与人类评分的皮尔逊相关系数为0.275，Qwen2.5-7B为0.340。它们的MAE分别为27.71和18.64。尽管一致性有限，但两个评判者均表现出高自一致性，精确一致性率分别为97.3%（LLaMA-3-8B）和92.3%（Qwen2.5-7B）。结果表明，高自一致性并不必然意味着与人类判断高度一致。我们的发现强调，在使用本地LLM作为自动评判者时，必须同时评估一致性和人类对齐性。

summary: Structured knowledge fact checking aims to determine the truthfulness of natural language claims by reasoning over structured evidence. Recent program-generation approaches leverage large language models (LLMs) to generate executable graph reasoning programs, achieving strong performance on structured knowledge fact checking benchmarks. However, these methods remain limited by invalid relation generation, single-path reasoning that lacks self-correction, and biased evidence assessment that tends to overestimate supporting signals. We propose Dialectical Agentic Reasoning (DARE), a multi-agent framework that formulates structured knowledge fact checking as an iterative retrieve-reason-reflect process. DARE integrates relation-grounded evidence retrieval to constrain reasoning to valid structures, dialectical bidirectional verification to evaluate evidence from both supporting and refuting perspectives, and confidence-driven meta-reflection to dynamically determine whether additional evidence exploration is necessary. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of DARE in structured knowledge fact checking, with an 8B backbone achieving 88.12% accuracy and matching or surpassing GPT-4o-based program-generation baselines, which attests to the efficacy of dialectical agentic reasoning in eliciting the latent reasoning capabilities of LLMs.
title: DARE: Dialectical Agentic Reasoning for Structured Knowledge Fact Checking
comment: EMNLP 2026 (Findings)
title_translated: DARE：辩证式智能体推理用于结构化知识事实核查
summary_translated: 结构化知识事实核查旨在通过推理结构化证据来判断自然语言声明的真实性。近期程序生成方法利用大型语言模型（LLMs）生成可执行的图推理程序，在结构化知识事实核查基准上取得了优异表现。然而，这些方法仍受限于无效关系生成、缺乏自我修正的单路径推理，以及倾向于高估支持信号的证据评估偏差。我们提出了辩证式智能体推理（DARE），一种多智能体框架，将结构化知识事实核查建模为迭代的检索-推理-反思过程。DARE整合了基于关系的证据检索以约束推理至有效结构，辩证双向验证以从支持和反驳两个角度评估证据，以及基于置信度的元反思机制，动态决定是否需要进一步探索证据。大量实验表明，DARE在结构化知识事实核查中具有显著有效性，采用8B主干模型达到88.12%的准确率，与基于GPT-4o的程序生成基线相当甚至超越，证明了辩证式智能体推理在激发LLMs潜在推理能力方面的有效性。

summary: ICD-10-CM codes are alphanumeric codes used in the US to classify diagnoses and injuries for medical billing and epidemiological reporting. Standard ICD-10-CM benchmarks report aggregate metrics that obscure performance on complex coding scenarios. We evaluate neural, workflow, and agentic systems on a rarity-stratified set of MIMIC-IV discharge summaries and identify two orthogonal failure modes. Neural classifiers exhibit a 0.43 micro-F1 gap between rare and common codes. Workflow systems handle rare codes well but score near zero on injury and external cause codes that require multi-step guideline following. A tool-augmented agentic configuration with structured access to official ICD-10-CM reference materials recovers up to 0.34 micro-F1 on this subset. No single system dominates across all conditions.
title: Understanding the Limits of Agentic ICD Coding
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
title_translated: 理解智能体式ICD编码的局限性
summary_translated: ICD-10-CM代码是美国用于分类诊断和伤害的字母数字代码，广泛应用于医疗账单和流行病学报告。现有的标准ICD-10-CM基准测试报告的是汇总指标，掩盖了在复杂编码场景下的性能表现。我们在MIMIC-IV出院摘要的稀有性分层数据集上评估了神经网络、工作流系统和智能体系统，识别出两种正交的失败模式。神经分类器在罕见代码与常见代码之间的微F1得分差距为0.43。工作流系统能较好处理罕见代码，但在需要多步遵循指南的伤害和外部原因代码上得分接近零。通过引入工具增强的智能体配置并结构化访问官方ICD-10-CM参考材料，该系统在该子集上最多恢复0.34的微F1。没有单一系统在所有条件下都占优。

summary: Detecting harmful memes is critical for maintaining safe online communities. However, harmful intent is often implicit, arising from visual-textual incongruity and cultural stereotypes, which challenges existing multimodal detectors. We propose SyRHM, a framework that decomposes harmful meme detection into meaning-grounded retrieval and symbolic-language-enhanced multi-stage reasoning. SyRHM retrieves semantically related memes by parsing multimodal content into textual elements and descriptions, providing grounded context beyond surface-level similarity. Building on the retrieved context, SyRHM uses a translator stage to convert multimodal inputs into symbolic intermediate representations, and then performs multi-stage reasoning via planner and solver stages, enabling expressive and interpretable analysis of harmful intent. Experiments on FHM, HarM, and MultiOff demonstrate the effectiveness of SyRHM, achieving superior performance on most evaluation settings against multimodal and reasoning-based baselines, while providing reasoning traces for harmful content. The code is available at: this https URL
title: SyRHM: Symbolic-Language-Enhanced Reasoning with Associative Retrieval for Zero-shot Harmful Meme Detection
comment: 17 pages, 14 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026
title_translated: SyRHM：基于关联检索的符号语言增强推理用于零样本有害表情包检测
summary_translated: 检测有害表情包对于维护安全的在线社区至关重要。然而，有害意图往往隐含于视觉-文本不一致和文化刻板印象中，这对现有的多模态检测器构成了挑战。我们提出了SyRHM框架，将有害表情包检测分解为基于语义的检索和符号语言增强的多阶段推理。SyRHM通过解析多模态内容为文本元素和描述来检索语义相关的表情包，提供超越表面相似性的基础上下文。在此基础上，SyRHM通过翻译阶段将多模态输入转换为符号中间表示，再通过规划器和求解器阶段进行多阶段推理，实现对有害意图的可表达且可解释的分析。在FHM、HarM和MultiOff数据集上的实验表明，SyRHM在大多数评估设置中优于多模态和基于推理的基线方法，同时提供了有害内容的推理轨迹。代码已公开。

summary: Multi-hop question answering often fails when retrieval treats evidence as isolated matches to the original question, since the facts needed to answer a complex question are usually connected through intermediate entities, relations, and constraints. We propose HyperProve, a retrieval-augmented QA framework that addresses this challenge by coupling question decomposition with answer-conditioned expansion over a hypergraph of atomic facts. HyperProve does not use atomic facts, hypergraphs, or iterative retrieval in isolation; instead, it carries intermediate answers and supporting hyperedges as retrieval state, then uses that state to bias the next local hypergraph expansion. This design enables HyperProve to construct coherent evidence chains for final answer generation while making the retrieval process stateful and fact-centered. Across multi-hop QA benchmarks, HyperProve achieves the best overall performance in our evaluation, outperforming the strongest baselines by an average relative improvement of 6.2% in answer accuracy and 4.9% in F1.
title: HyperProve: Answer-Guided Hypergraph Expansion for Multi-Hop Question Answering
comment: EMNLP 2026
title_translated: HyperProve：答案引导的超图扩展用于多跳问答
summary_translated: 多跳问答在检索过程中常因将证据视为与原始问题孤立匹配而失败，因为回答复杂问题所需的事实通常通过中间实体、关系和约束相互连接。我们提出HyperProve，一种检索增强型问答框架，通过将问题分解与答案条件驱动的超图原子事实扩展相结合来应对这一挑战。HyperProve不孤立使用原子事实、超图或迭代检索；相反，它将中间答案和支持的超边作为检索状态，并利用该状态来引导下一次局部超图扩展。这种设计使HyperProve能够构建连贯的证据链以生成最终答案，同时使检索过程具有状态性和以事实为中心。在多个多跳问答基准测试中，HyperProve在我们的评估中取得了最佳整体性能，平均相对提升答案准确率6.2%、F1值4.9%。

summary: Vision--language models (VLMs) can answer chart questions accurately, but output accuracy does not show how they combine the evidence needed to recover an exact value. We study vertical-bar value reading with controlled counterfactual activation patching in Qwen2.5VL-7B-Instruct and InternVL3.5-8B. The study connects three analyses: (1) The single-factor results show that the changed bar-top region restores much more answer preference than the unchanged bar body, despite containing fewer visual tokens. Legend- and series-related states also lose local recoverability earlier than bar-geometry and axis-scale states. (2) In the handoff analysis, restoration shifts from visual legend regions in early layers to prompt-series positions in middle layers. Resetting the prompt-series state selectively reduces legend-source rescue, supporting its role as a partial mediator. (3) In the factorial analysis, both models can use geometry and scale states from separate donors to favor the combined target. InternVL performs similarly when the states come from separate donors or one image, while Qwen shows lower restoration for separate donors which suggests higher context sensitivity. Together, these results provide preliminary causal evidence for localizing the internal computations that support exact bar-value reading.
title: Inside VLM Chart Reading: Tracing Value Reading from Vertical Bar Charts Across Space and Depth
title_translated: 深入VLM图表阅读：跨空间与深度追踪垂直条形图数值读取
summary_translated: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）可以准确回答图表问题，但输出准确性无法反映其如何组合所需证据以恢复精确数值。我们通过对Qwen2.5VL-7B-Instruct和InternVL3.5-8B进行受控反事实激活修补，研究了垂直条形图的数值读取。该研究包含三项分析：(1) 单因素结果表明，尽管包含更少视觉标记，变化的条顶区域比未变化的条身区域恢复了更多的答案偏好；图例和系列相关状态也比条形几何和轴尺度状态更早失去局部可恢复性。(2) 在交接分析中，恢复从早期层的视觉图例区域转移到中期层的提示-系列位置。选择性重置提示-系列状态会降低图例来源的恢复能力，支持其作为部分中介的作用。(3) 在因子分析中，两个模型均可利用来自不同来源的几何和尺度状态来支持目标组合。当状态来自不同来源或同一图像时，InternVL表现相似，而Qwen在来自不同来源时恢复效果较低，表明其更高的上下文敏感性。这些结果共同提供了初步因果证据，揭示了支持精确条形图数值读取的内部计算机制。

summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed, the generation of harmful content has become a critical safety concern. Existing safeguards operate at the input, output, or streaming-generation stages, while early-risk methods that rely on surface tokens or output logits may suffer from weak initial signals, and internals-based detectors using dense representations may retain highly entangled and redundant safety-irrelevant information. It therefore remains unclear whether the earliest post-generation hidden states already contain reliable signals about final-response harmfulness. To address this gap, we propose ForeSight, a first-token output-risk forecasting framework that distills weak and redundant early safety signals into compact, layer-aware risk representations. Experiments on five safety benchmarks and two target models demonstrate that ForeSight achieves superior and efficient early-risk forecasting while relying solely on first-token hidden states. The code is available at: this https URL
title: ForeSight: Enhancing Risk Monitoring via Early Safety Signal Distillation
comment: 17 pages, 12 figures. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
title_translated: ForeSight：通过早期安全信号提炼增强风险监控
summary_translated: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）的广泛应用，有害内容的生成已成为关键的安全问题。现有防护机制主要作用于输入、输出或流式生成阶段，而依赖表面标记或输出logits的早期风险方法可能面临初始信号微弱的问题，基于内部表示的检测器则可能保留高度纠缠且冗余的安全无关信息。因此，尚不清楚最早的生成后隐藏状态是否已包含关于最终响应有害性的可靠信号。为填补这一空白，我们提出ForeSight，一种首个基于首令牌输出风险预测的框架，将微弱且冗余的早期安全信号提炼为紧凑、层级感知的风险表示。在五个安全基准和两个目标模型上的实验表明，ForeSight仅依赖首令牌隐藏状态即可实现优越且高效的早期风险预测。

summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world high-stakes applications, effective governance has become essential. Existing safeguards largely follow two paradigms: learning-based guards provide strong semantic discrimination but couple policy behavior to trained models and taxonomies, while programmable frameworks offer flexible control but require substantial manual prompt and workflow engineering. Neither externalizes policies as reusable operational states, making it difficult to consistently reuse policy evidence across detection, intervention, and verification. In this paper, we introduce PolicyMem, a geometric policy memory that externalizes natural-language policies as reusable geometric memory objects represented by low-rank subspaces in a shared representation space. A memory writer compiles natural-language policies into policy memory slots, and query-response pairs read the policy memory through projection energy. The resulting policy-evidence profile directly mediates the safety verdict and is reused for policy attribution and post-intervention verification. Coupled with a response rewriter, PolicyMem enables a detect-rewrite-verify loop for LLM governance. Across five widely used benchmarks, PolicyMem achieves state-of-the-art unsafe behavior detection while enabling effective policy attribution, rewriting, and post-intervention verification through the shared policy memory.
title: PolicyMem: Geometric Policy Memory for LLM Governance
comment: 19 pages, 10 figures
title_translated: PolicyMem：用于大语言模型治理的几何策略记忆
summary_translated: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）在现实世界高风险应用中的日益普及，有效的治理变得至关重要。现有的防护机制主要遵循两种范式：基于学习的防护提供强大的语义区分能力，但将策略行为与训练模型和分类体系耦合；可编程框架则提供灵活控制，但需要大量手动提示和工作流工程。这两种方法均未将策略外部化为可重用的操作状态，导致在检测、干预和验证过程中难以一致复用策略证据。本文提出PolicyMem，一种将自然语言策略外部化为可重用几何记忆对象的几何策略记忆机制，这些对象以共享表示空间中的低秩子空间形式表示。记忆写入器将自然语言策略编译为策略记忆槽，查询-响应对通过投影能量读取策略记忆。生成的策略证据轮廓直接决定安全判断，并用于策略归因和干预后验证。结合响应重写器，PolicyMem实现了用于LLM治理的检测-重写-验证循环。在五个广泛使用的基准测试中，PolicyMem在不安全行为检测方面达到最先进水平，同时通过共享策略记忆实现了有效的策略归因、重写和干预后验证。

summary: Quantum Natural Language Processing (QNLP) uses pregroup grammars to translate grammatical structure into diagrammatic representations and quantum circuits. Recent Hindi QNLP work has shown that Hindi-specific pregroup grammars can support grammar-sensitive compositional models, but grammatical type assignment is still largely manual, limiting scalability. This paper formulates automatic Hindi pregroup supertagging as a token-level classification task. Using a manually annotated corpus of 380 Hindi sentences, we evaluate lexical, contextual, prompting-based, lexical-repair, and suffix/morphology-aware methods. Results show that simple lexical and contextual models are strong in this low-resource setting: contextual backoff achieves the best completed accuracy of 64.56\%, while raw Qwen2.5 prompting reaches only 11.65\%. Lexical repair raises LLM-assisted prediction to 64.08\%, demonstrating the value of constraining generative outputs with symbolic grammar knowledge. Diagnostic analysis further shows that seen and unambiguous tokens are much easier than unseen tokens, and suffix/morphology features improve karaka-token accuracy but not overall performance. These results show that automatic Hindi pregroup assignment is feasible and can reduce reliance on manual annotation in future multilingual QNLP pipelines.
title: Scaling Hindi Quantum Natural Language Processing through Automatic Pregroup Supertagging
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables
title_translated: 通过自动预组超标记实现印地语量子自然语言处理的扩展
summary_translated: 量子自然语言处理（QNLP）利用预组语法将语法结构转化为图示表示和量子电路。近期关于印地语QNLP的研究表明，特定于印地语的预组语法能够支持语法敏感的组合模型，但语法类型分配仍主要依赖人工，限制了可扩展性。本文将自动印地语预组超标记建模为一个词元级分类任务。基于380个印地语句子的手动标注语料库，我们评估了词汇、上下文、提示驱动、词汇修复以及词尾/形态感知等方法。结果表明，在低资源环境下，简单的词汇和上下文模型表现强劲：上下文回退方法达到最佳完成准确率64.56%，而原始Qwen2.5提示仅达11.65%。词汇修复将LLM辅助预测提升至64.08%，证明了使用符号语法知识约束生成输出的价值。诊断分析进一步显示，已见且无歧义的词元远比未见词元容易处理，词尾/形态特征虽提升了卡拉卡词元的准确性，但对整体性能无显著改善。这些结果表明，自动印地语预组分配是可行的，未来可减少多语言QNLP流水线中对手动标注的依赖。

summary: Human corrections identify editable spans, but the examples receiving corrections may come from a selective feedback channel. We analyze this interaction at a fixed model checkpoint by decomposing a localized gradient into edited and retained untouched components. Squared relative selection bias is a ratio of quadratics whose derivative has the sign of an explicit quadratic polynomial. Localization can increase, decrease, or nonmonotonically change this diagnostic; its direction depends on component biases and geometry. Oracle importance weighting recovers the population mean for each fixed localization objective, but these objectives have different targets. Against one common full-gradient target, we derive the finite-sample mean-squared error, an analytic optimal retention coefficient, and a fixed-clipping extension. Exact finite-population calculations and 10,000 Monte Carlo repetitions per sample size verify the identities and counterexamples. Public human-post-edit experiments use two translation directions and pretrained models, with declared synthetic selection. An English-German extension differentiates 73.89 million native parameters. In all three declared settings, hard localization has higher relative bias but lower absolute bias than full retention. Untouched-component biases are nonzero and selected component means have negative inner products, so the general criterion applies where the simple unbiased/aligned explanation fails. Output-bias diagnostics show the same endpoint ordering of relative bias across both directions, with one interior maximum. Mechanisms reuse each language's records and include a mixture; they are not independent replications. The evidence separates relative amplification from absolute gradient error and establishes estimation properties, without inferring translation-quality gains or identifying actual complaint propensities.
title: When Edit Localization Amplifies Relative Selection Bias: Gradient Geometry, Target Mismatch, and Importance Weighting
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures
title_translated: 编辑定位如何放大相对选择偏差：梯度几何、目标错配与重要性加权
summary_translated: 人类修正识别可编辑片段，但接受修正的样本可能来自有选择性的反馈渠道。本文在固定模型检查点下分析这一交互作用，将局部梯度分解为已编辑和保留未动两部分。平方相对选择偏差是一个二次项之比，其导数符号由一个显式的二次多项式决定。定位操作可能增加、减少或非单调地改变该诊断指标；其方向取决于各成分偏差和几何结构。Oracle重要性加权可恢复每个固定定位目标下的总体均值，但这些目标具有不同目标。针对一个常见的全梯度目标，我们推导出有限样本均方误差、解析最优保留系数及固定截断扩展。通过精确的有限总体计算和每样本规模下10,000次蒙特卡洛重复验证了恒等式与反例。公开的人类后编辑实验采用两个翻译方向和预训练模型，声明合成选择性。英语-德语扩展区分了7389万本地参数。在所有三个声明设置中，硬定位相比完全保留具有更高的相对偏差但更低的绝对偏差。未动成分偏差非零，且被选成分均值具有负内积，因此一般准则适用，而简单无偏/对齐解释在此失效。输出偏差诊断显示两个方向的相对偏差终点顺序一致，且存在一个内部极大值。机制复用了每种语言的记录并包含混合，而非独立复制。证据分离了相对放大与绝对梯度误差，并确立了估计性质，但未推断翻译质量提升或实际投诉倾向。

summary: Negation remains a longstanding challenge for both language models (LMs) and large language models (LLMs). Prior work mainly focuses on a small set of high-frequency single-word negation cues, such as not and never, with limited exploration of broader negation types and modern LLMs. To address this gap, we construct NegCue, a large-scale dataset containing over 1.8M samples spanning single-word, multi-word, and affixal negation with more than 200 unique cues. We further pre-train both encoder-only LMs and LLMs on NegCue to investigate how different negation types affect negation understanding. Experiments on five downstream benchmarks show that negation types contribute unevenly to performance gains under the same training scale. In particular, affixal negation yields the largest improvements, while the gains from the commonly studied single-word negation remain modest. Moreover, our results demonstrate that further pre-training improves negation understanding for both LMs and LLMs.
title: Not all Negation Cues are Equal: Affixal Negations Yield Better Negation Understanding
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
title_translated: 并非所有否定线索都相同：词缀否定带来更好的否定理解
summary_translated: 否定仍是语言模型（LMs）和大语言模型（LLMs）长期面临的挑战。以往研究主要聚焦于少数高频单字否定线索（如not和never），对更广泛的否定类型和现代LLMs探索不足。为填补这一空白，我们构建了NegCue，一个大规模数据集，包含超过180万条样本，涵盖单字、多字及词缀否定，涉及200多个独特线索。我们进一步在NegCue上对编码器-only LMs和LLMs进行预训练，以探究不同否定类型对否定理解的影响。在五个下游基准测试上的实验表明，不同否定类型在相同训练规模下对性能提升贡献不均。特别是，词缀否定带来了最大改进，而常见研究的单字否定带来的增益仍然有限。此外，我们的结果表明，进一步预训练能有效提升LMs和LLMs的否定理解能力。

summary: We introduce LayerRoute, a parameter-efficient method for adaptive transformer layer-skipping that combines per-layer hard-gated routing (trained via a straight-through estimator) with joint LoRA fine-tuning. LayerRoute augments each of the 24 transformer blocks in Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct with a lightweight per-layer router (~21.5K parameters) and LoRA adapters (rank 8, ~1.08M parameters), training both jointly under a gate-regularized language-modeling objective. Across 10 independently-seeded training runs, LayerRoute converges to an identical skip-pattern structure in every run - a consistent set of 9 middle layers (8-16) becomes skip-eligible in all 10 seeds - and delivers genuine, verified wallclock speedup in every run (1.02x-1.06x, mean 1.04x). Quality is preserved or improved in every configuration tested: joint LoRA adaptation yields a perplexity improvement over the unmodified backbone in all 10 seeds (mean delta = -1.16 and -1.11 across the two evaluation splits used). We further verify the router performs genuine, non-trivial per-input computation: gate decisions in skip-eligible layers change the actual skip/run outcome for 87-100% of held-out samples, confirming real input-dependent routing rather than a fixed pruning pattern. LayerRoute trains in under 7 minutes on a single A100 and adds negligible overhead beyond the routing decision itself. We report our full reproducibility methodology, including a systematic diagnostic investigation into what determines the router's per-input decisions, as part of this work.
title: LayerRoute: Adaptive Layer-Skipping with LoRA-Preserved Quality for Efficient LLM Inference
title_translated: LayerRoute：保持LoRA质量的自适应层跳过高效大语言模型推理
summary_translated: 我们提出LayerRoute，一种高效的自适应Transformer层跳过方法，结合每层硬门控路由（通过直通估计器训练）与联合LoRA微调。LayerRoute在Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct的24个Transformer模块中分别添加轻量级每层路由（约21.5K参数）和LoRA适配器（秩为8，约108万参数），并在门控正则化的语言建模目标下联合训练。在10次独立种子的训练运行中，LayerRoute在每次运行中均收敛到相同的跳过模式结构——所有10个种子中，第8至16层始终成为可跳过的中间层，并在每次运行中实现真实、经验证的时钟速度提升（1.02x–1.06x，平均1.04x）。所有测试配置中模型质量得以保持甚至提升：联合LoRA适配在所有10个种子中均优于未修改的骨干模型（两个评估划分的平均差值分别为-1.16和-1.11）。我们进一步验证了路由器执行的是真正的、非平凡的输入相关计算：在87%-100%的保留样本中，跳过可选层的门控决策改变了实际的跳过/运行结果，确认了真实的输入依赖路由而非固定剪枝模式。LayerRoute在单个A100上训练时间少于7分钟，除路由决策外几乎无额外开销。本文还报告了完整的可复现性方法，包括系统性诊断研究，以揭示决定路由器输入决策的关键因素。

summary: For our submission to the WMT26 Creole Language Translation Shared Task, we focus on machine translation (MT) models for Pacific creoles: Tok Pisin, Bislama, and Solomon Pijin, with particular attention to broad domain performance. After pre-training on a large collection of domain-imbalanced data, we continue fine-tuning on a diverse mix of domain-balanced data. We rely on a number of data collection and preparation techniques, including LLM-assisted respelling and alignment, back-translation, and distillation from Gemini for domains originally not present in training data. Evaluated on Bouquet and a novel test set made of spoken language transcripts, our models beat open model baselines by 3+ chrF++ points in all directions with human-original references. Looking ahead, we plan to develop human-translated test sets for Solomon Pijin and Bislama, and to distil our best models into much smaller ones that retain broad domain coverage.
title: The University of Melbourne WMT 2026 CreoleMT Submission: A Domain-Balanced Approach to Low-Resource Pacific Creole Machine Translation
title_translated: 墨尔本大学在WMT 2026克里奥语机器翻译任务中的提交：一种面向低资源太平洋克里奥语的领域平衡方法
summary_translated: 针对WMT26克里奥语翻译共享任务，我们聚焦于太平洋克里奥语（托克皮钦语、比斯拉马语和所罗门皮金语）的机器翻译模型，并特别关注跨领域的性能表现。在大规模领域不平衡数据上进行预训练后，我们在一个多样化的领域平衡数据集上继续微调。我们采用多种数据收集与处理技术，包括LLM辅助的重拼写与对齐、反向翻译以及从Gemini模型中蒸馏生成原始训练数据中不存在的领域内容。在Bouquet基准和由口语转录文本构成的新测试集上评估，我们的模型在所有方向上均比开源模型基线高出3+ chrF++分，且参考为人工原文。展望未来，我们计划为所罗门皮金语和比斯拉马语开发人工翻译的测试集，并将最佳模型蒸馏为更小的版本，同时保持广泛的领域覆盖。

summary: The WMT26 General MT task evaluates systems on 10 language pairs that have no human references (neither translated from scratch nor post-edited from MT output by humans). We describe how we built the pseudo-references for these pairs and six other language pairs (in which some forms of human references are available): seven models translate the 3,277 official documents under up to five prompt conditions, giving a total of 26 system-prompt combinations; then three reference-free quality estimation (QE) models score every candidate; and a per-document selector picks one translation, which GPT-5.5 post-edits where needed. Working without references exposed a failure mode of QE-guided selection: the metrics rank fluent output in the wrong language above correct translations. Adding a confidence-scaled language identification penalty to the score fusion drives the wrong-language count to zero, and the resulting selector still scores better on MetricX than the rank-fusion baseline it replaces. Since no references were available for these pairs while we were building them, we calibrate every selection decision on last year's WMT25 human judgments. The human evaluation, released after construction, shows the cost of getting selection wrong: our references stand with the strongest participating systems when the selector kept a frontier-model candidate, and fall up to 17 ESA points below them when it did not. We release the selection method and the provenance of every reference ( this https URL )
title: In the Blind: Building Pseudo-References for MT Evaluation

title_translated: 盲测之中：构建机器翻译评估的伪参考
summary_translated: WMT26通用机器翻译任务在10个语言对上评估系统，这些语言对均无任何人工参考（既非从头翻译也非人工后编辑的MT输出）。我们描述了如何为这些语言对及另外六个部分存在人工参考的语言对构建伪参考：七种模型在最多五种提示条件下翻译3,277份官方文档，共产生26种系统-提示组合；随后三种无需参考的质量估计（QE）模型对每个候选译文进行评分；再由每文档选择器选出一个翻译结果，必要时由GPT-5.5进行后编辑。在无参考条件下工作暴露了QE引导选择的一个失败模式：指标将流畅但语言错误的输出排在正确翻译之上。通过在分数融合中加入置信度加权的语言识别惩罚项，错误语言数量降至零，且新选择器在MetricX上的表现仍优于其替代的排名融合基线。由于构建期间这些语言对无可用参考，我们以去年WMT25的人工判断作为选择决策的校准依据。人工评估发布后显示，选择错误带来的代价：当选择器保留前沿模型候选时，我们的参考与最强参与系统相当；而当未保留时，则落后高达17 ESA分。我们公开了选择方法及每条参考的来源记录（此链接）。

summary: A clinical agent benchmark can report the same verdict on identical inputs while the agent files a materially different order on each run. Such agents order tests, request medications and place referrals, yet benchmarks typically score one run per task and rarely ask whether identical inputs produce identical actions; MedAgentBench, the benchmark we use, scores a single attempt and says so. To measure this gap we introduce "same-input rerun", which replays a task with every input held fixed and compares the orders rather than the score, with six reliability metrics, and apply it to 1000 MedAgentBench runs across 50 tasks from its five write-capable families, two open-weight models below ten billion parameters quantised to four bits, and two temperatures. The study establishes that action-level divergence exists and can pass unrecorded by the score, not that any rate generalises. Under the 8B model at temperature 0.7, all 43 ordering groups emit a different set of orders across five identical runs, 26 emit the order on some runs and not others, and 28 record a different coded value, dose or analyte. In 22 of those 43 the benchmark reports the same failing verdict for materially different behaviour, as it does for all 10 divergent groups of the 4B model at 0.7. Orders also reach different endpoints across runs, one of which the record server rejects while the agent is told it succeeded. These findings motivate repeated-run evaluation, action-level stability reporting and execution-faithful environment feedback in clinical-agent benchmarks.
title: Same Patient, Different Order: Action-Level Reliability of Clinical LLM Agents Under Repeated Runs

title_translated: 同一患者，不同顺序：临床大模型智能体在重复运行下的动作级可靠性研究
summary_translated: 一个临床智能体基准可在相同输入下报告一致结论，但每次运行时却生成实质性不同的操作指令。此类智能体可安排检查、申请药物和发送转诊，但基准通常仅对每个任务评分一次，很少检验相同输入是否产生相同动作；我们使用的MedAgentBench基准即仅评分单次尝试并明确说明。为衡量这一差距，我们引入“相同输入重运行”方法，固定所有输入并重复执行任务，比较各次运行的指令而非得分，使用六种可靠性度量，并应用于50个任务中50个写入能力家族的1000次MedAgentBench运行，涵盖两个参数量低于十亿且量化至4比特的开源模型及两种温度设置。研究发现动作级差异确实存在，且可能在得分层面被忽略，但不意味着任何比率具有普遍性。在8B模型、温度0.7下，全部43个排序组在五次相同运行中均产生不同的指令序列，其中26组在某些运行中发出指令而在其他运行中未发出，28组记录了不同的编码值、剂量或分析物。在43组中的22组中，基准对实质不同的行为报告了相同的失败结论，这与4B模型在0.7温度下的10个分歧组情况一致。不同运行的指令还可能导致不同终点，其中一个终点被记录服务器拒绝，而智能体被告知成功。这些发现推动了重复运行评估、动作级稳定性报告以及临床智能体基准中执行忠实环境反馈的重要性。

summary: Discharge summaries are lengthy medical documents that summarize a hospital in-patient visit. Automatically generating them can reduce documentation burden and return clinician time to patient care. Whereas Large Language Model (LLMs) could be used for this task, their Achilles heel is hallucinations, which can have drastic consequences for clinical documentation. We present an evidence-driven alignment framework for discharge summarization at the clinical encounter level, that treats provenance as a first-class constraint, using semantic graphs and deep learning models. Each summary sentence is selected and organized via cross-document semantic alignment and is accompanied by explicit evidence links to its source spans. We show our results on two corpora: a publicly available corpus (MIMIC-III) and clinical notes written by physicians at the University of Illinois Hospital (UIC Health). Additionally, we make source code and trained models available.
title: Toward Complete Hospital Discharge Summarization with Abstract Meaning Representation

title_translated: 基于抽象意义表示的完整出院摘要生成
summary_translated: 出院摘要是一类冗长的医疗文档，用于总结住院患者的就诊过程。自动生成功能可减轻文档负担，使医生有更多时间投入患者照护。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）可用于该任务，但其致命弱点是幻觉问题，可能对临床文档造成严重后果。我们提出一种以证据驱动的出院摘要生成框架，从临床会诊层面进行对齐，将出处视为首要约束条件，利用语义图与深度学习模型实现。每个摘要句子通过跨文档语义对齐进行选择与组织，并附带显式的证据链接指向其源文本片段。我们在两个语料库上展示结果：公开可用的MIMIC-III语料库，以及伊利诺伊大学医院（UIC Health）医生撰写的临床笔记。此外，我们还公开了源代码与训练好的模型。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable proficiency on general-purpose tasks, yet their performance often degrades in highly-specialized technical domains. Moreover, little is known about how parametric knowledge of domain-specific terms is encoded within these models. We address this gap by contributing two novel medical jargon evaluation benchmarks and evaluate a general-purpose Llama-3.1 model against a variant fine-tuned on medical-domain data. Surprisingly, the general-purpose model outperforms the medically fine-tuned model on both tasks. Using mechanistic interpretability tools, we find systematic patterns of miscalibration for the medically fine-tuned model. Instead of reorganizing parametric knowledge, the fine-tuned model places greater emphasis on a small subset of model components associated with jargon-favoring predictions. We find that applying component reweighting strategies against the benchmark tasks successfully suppresses these components and closes the gap with the general-purpose baseline. We also observe that some jargon-sensitive components transfer knowledge to the same tasks involving materials science jargon, suggesting they encode a partially domain-agnostic notion of specialized terminology. Our results provide a case study in which a medically fine-tuned checkpoint does not improve jargon comprehension over its general-purpose counterpart, highlighting that domain adaptation should not be assumed to yield better performance on specialized terminology.
title: Domain-Specific Jargon in Large Language Models: A Comparative Analysis between General-Purpose and Specialist Models

title_translated: 大语言模型中的领域特定术语：通用模型与专业模型的对比分析
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）在通用任务上表现出色，但在高度专业化技术领域中性能常出现下降。此外，关于模型中领域特定术语的参数化知识如何编码尚不清楚。我们通过构建两个新颖的医学术语评估基准，填补这一空白，并将通用的Llama-3.1模型与一个在医学领域数据上微调的变体进行对比。令人惊讶的是，通用模型在两项任务中均优于医学微调模型。通过机制可解释性工具分析，我们发现医学微调模型存在系统性校准偏差。该模型并未重新组织参数知识，而是更加依赖少数与术语偏好预测相关的模型组件。我们发现，针对基准任务应用组件重加权策略可有效抑制这些组件，缩小与通用基线的差距。此外，我们观察到某些对术语敏感的组件也能迁移到涉及材料科学术语的任务中，表明它们编码了一种部分非领域特定的专业术语概念。我们的结果提供了一个典型案例：医学微调的检查点并未提升对术语的理解能力，反而不如通用模型，强调不能假设领域适配必然带来专业术语性能的提升。

summary: We identify \textbf{Harmfulness Propagation Dynamics (HPD)}: for harmful prompts, the projection of the last-token hidden state onto a learned harm direction rises monotonically with transformer depth, whereas benign prompts remain flat or oscillatory. This cross-layer signature reflects harmful intent as a \emph{progressively resolved} semantic property: surface form appears early, while pragmatic intent consolidates later, making the \emph{trajectory shape} more informative than any single-layer snapshot. Moreover, LDA-based harm directions, learned per layer, remain stable across random splits (pairwise cosine similarity $>0.97$), supporting the projection sequence as a reproducible structured signal. Building on HPD, we introduce \textbf{\herald{}} (\textbf{H}armful \textbf{E}ncoding \textbf{R}ecognition via \textbf{A}ctivation \textbf{L}ayer \textbf{D}ynamics). This lightweight input moderator extracts a seven-dimensional feature record, slope, curvature, monotonicity, onset layer, and related statistics from the cross-layer projection sequence and classifies it with a 288-parameter MLP. \herald{} stores one $d$-dimensional direction per layer ($262$\,KB for a 32-layer, $d{=}4096$ model), requires no gradient computation during training, and adds only $2.6{\times}10^{-6}$ prefill FLOPs at inference. Across eight prompt-harmfulness benchmarks and four model families, \herald{} achieves an average F1 of $89.3$ on OLMo2-7B, surpassing all tested guard models on adversarial jailbreak detection ($98.4$ vs.\ $96.9$ F1) and outperforming prior latent-based methods by $2.3$-$4.1$ F1 points on every backbone. Per-instance trajectories provide machine-readable audit records that reveal \emph{when} and \emph{how} harmfulness emerges, offering an interpretability advantage over single-layer approaches.
title: Harmfulness Propagation Dynamics: Layer-wise Trajectories of Adversarial Intent in Large Language Models

title_translated: 有害性传播动态：大语言模型中对抗性意图的逐层轨迹
summary_translated: 我们识别出【有害性传播动态（HPD）】：对于有害提示，最后一层隐藏状态在学习到的有害方向上的投影随Transformer深度单调上升，而良性提示则保持平坦或振荡。这种跨层特征反映了有害意图作为一种【逐步明确】的语义属性：表面形式早期出现，而语用意图后期才逐渐固化，因此【轨迹形状】比任何单层快照更具信息量。此外，基于LDA学习的每层有害方向在随机划分下保持稳定（成对余弦相似度>0.97），支持该投影序列作为可复现的结构化信号。基于HPD，我们提出【	extbf{omannum{1}}】（【H】armful 【E】ncoding 【R】ecognition via 【A】ctivation 【L】ayer 【D】ynamics）。该轻量级输入调节器从跨层投影序列中提取七维特征记录——斜率、曲率、单调性、起始层及相关统计量，并通过一个288参数的MLP进行分类。	extbf{omannum{1}}每层存储一个d维方向（32层、d=4096模型仅需262KB），训练时无需梯度计算，推理时仅增加2.6×10⁻⁶预填充FLOPs。在八个提示有害性基准和四个模型家族上，	extbf{omannum{1}}在OLMo2-7B上的平均F1达到89.3，在对抗性越狱检测中优于所有测试的防护模型（98.4 vs. 96.9 F1），且在每个主干模型上均比先前基于潜在空间的方法提升2.3–4.1 F1点。实例级轨迹提供了机器可读的审计记录，揭示有害性【何时】和【如何】出现，相较于单层方法具有解释性优势。

summary: While Large Language Models have improved rapidly, many fundamental questions remain about how to evaluate the knowledge and reasoning abilities they acquire, and how such evaluations relate to the learning signals used in pre-training. In this paper, we propose ModelLog, a declarative probabilistic framework for pre-training evaluation that makes the semantic structure of model behavior explicit and provides new formal tools for relating evaluation to learning. ModelLog specifies evaluation targets as symbolic constraints over token-level predictions and measures how strongly a model's distribution satisfies those constraints. We explore the framework through a new suite of tasks targeting negation, mutual exclusivity, and consistency, finding systematic failures that are difficult to characterize through token likelihood or answer accuracy alone. We further show that these evaluation scores can also be interpreted as losses, whose gradients reflect logical strength, informativeness, and variable-level sensitivity. This links evaluation and learning through a shared semantics, suggesting evaluation methods that diagnose model behavior while also helping to clarify the semantic structure of learning.
title: From Token Probabilities to Semantic Constraints: Towards Declarative Probabilistic Evaluation of Language Models
title_translated: 从词元概率到语义约束：迈向语言模型的声明式概率评估
summary_translated: 尽管大语言模型发展迅速，但关于如何评估其获得的知识与推理能力，以及这些评估如何与预训练中的学习信号相关联，仍存在诸多基本问题。本文提出ModelLog，一种用于预训练评估的声明式概率框架，使模型行为的语义结构显式化，并提供新的形式化工具以连接评估与学习。ModelLog将评估目标定义为词元级预测上的符号约束，并衡量模型分布满足这些约束的程度。我们通过一组新任务探索该框架，聚焦否定、互斥性和一致性，发现系统性失败，仅靠词元似然或答案准确率难以刻画。进一步表明，这些评估分数也可解释为损失，其梯度反映逻辑强度、信息量及变量层面敏感性。这通过共享语义将评估与学习联系起来，提出既能诊断模型行为又能澄清学习语义结构的评估方法。

summary: Large language models have made abstractive summarization remarkably fluent, but generated summaries can hallucinate facts, posing serious risks in biomedical and clinical domains. We address this by removing generation from the pipeline and framing summarization as extractive sentence selection. Our Hybrid Hierarchical CNN-LSTM Summarizer uses stacked multi-kernel convolutions to compose sentence-level embeddings into richer inter-sentence representations, followed by a bidirectional LSTM to model long-range dependencies across the document. A lightweight scoring head assigns per-sentence importance scores and is trained end-to-end with binary cross-entropy against oracle extractive labels. At inference, a dynamic mean-plus-standard-deviation threshold with a top-3 fallback selects sentences directly from the source and chronologically reorders them into the final summary. Since every output sentence is copied from the input, the model avoids generation-induced factual drift. On PubMed, our architecture outperforms isolated CNN and LSTM baselines, while ablations show that wider convolutional receptive fields improve sentence scoring. On MIMIC-CXR and MIMIC-IV BHC, the model performs well on unstructured narratives but defaults toward positional baselines on highly templated reports. These results suggest that structural constraints can provide a reliable path toward factually grounded summarization systems that are trustworthy by design rather than by correction.
title: A Hybrid Hierarchical 1D-CNN-BiLSTM Framework for Extractive Summarization of Biomedical and Clinical Text

title_translated: 一种混合分层一维CNN-BiLSTM框架用于生物医学与临床文本的抽取式摘要
summary_translated: 大语言模型使抽象式摘要极为流畅，但生成内容可能产生事实幻觉，在生物医学和临床领域带来严重风险。我们通过移除生成环节，将摘要任务重构为抽取式句子选择。我们的混合分层CNN-LSTM摘要器使用堆叠的多核卷积将句子级嵌入组合为更丰富的句间表示，随后通过双向LSTM建模文档内的长程依赖关系。一个轻量级评分头为每句分配重要性得分，并与真实抽取标签联合端到端训练，采用二元交叉熵损失。推理阶段，采用动态均值加标准差阈值结合前3名回退策略，直接从原文中选取句子并按时间顺序重组为最终摘要。由于每个输出句均来自输入，模型避免了生成引起的事实漂移。在PubMed上，该架构优于独立的CNN和LSTM基线；消融实验显示更宽的卷积感受野有助于提升句子评分。在MIMIC-CXR和MIMIC-IV BHC上，模型在非结构化叙述中表现良好，但在高度模板化的报告上退化为位置基线。结果表明，结构约束可为事实可靠型摘要系统提供可靠路径，使其设计即可信，而非事后修正。

summary: Clinical decisions are prospective, but clinical language models are often evaluated on retrospective records that reveal the final diagnosis, treatment response, and outcome. Such evaluations may reward the use of future information rather than reasoning under the uncertainty present at the decision point. We introduce a paired benchmark for measuring outcome-conditioned shifts consistent with hindsight bias in clinical temporal reasoning. It contains 171 case reports from the PubMed Central Open Access Subset---40 sepsis and 131 GLP-1/diabetes cases---represented as both textual narratives and human-annotated and LLM-generated textual time series (TTS). For each case, questions are tied to a clinically meaningful cutoff and paired with a prospective reference answer and an outcome-consistent \emph{hindsight trap}. Models answer each question using either a TTS truncated at the cutoff or the complete timeline; additional conditions vary the narrative source (original or synthetic) and TTS annotation source (human or LLM). We evaluate accuracy (Acc), hindsight trap rate (HTR), answer instability rate (AIR), and hindsight bias rate (HBR), each of which captures different signals of hindsight bias. Across GPT 5.6 Sol, Gemma 4, GLM 5.2, and Opus 5, full timeline exposure produces consistent hindsight-sensitive shifts, while temporal masking reduces bias without lowering accuracy.
title: Hindsight Bias in Clinical Temporal Reasoning: How Future Data Exposure Affects Large Language Model Judgment

title_translated: 临床时间推理中的后见之明偏差：未来数据暴露如何影响大语言模型判断
summary_translated: 临床决策是前瞻性的，但临床语言模型常在包含最终诊断、治疗反应和结局的回顾性记录上进行评估。此类评估可能奖励利用未来信息的行为，而非在决策点面对不确定性时的合理推理。我们引入一个配对基准，用于测量与后见之明偏差一致的结果条件性偏移。该基准包含来自PubMed Central开放获取子集的171个病例报告——40例败血症和131例GLP-1/糖尿病病例——以文本叙事和人工标注及LLM生成的时间序列（TTS）形式呈现。每个病例的问题关联一个临床有意义的截止点，并配对一个前瞻性参考答案和一个与结果一致的【后见之明陷阱】。模型使用截断至截止点的TTS或完整时间线回答问题；额外条件包括叙事来源（原始或合成）和TTS标注来源（人工或LLM）。我们评估准确率（Acc）、后见之明陷阱率（HTR）、答案不稳定性率（AIR）和后见之明偏差率（HBR），每项捕捉不同的后见之明偏差信号。在GPT 5.6 Sol、Gemma 4、GLM 5.2和Opus 5上，完整时间线暴露导致一致的后见之明敏感偏移，而时间掩码可降低偏差而不损害准确率。

summary: Speech-to-speech LLMs like Moshi, and its derivative PersonaPlex, can listen and speak concurrently through full-duplex generation. However, they can begin speaking inappropriately during prolonged user silence: under digital-zero input, Moshi and PersonaPlex initiate speech in 12/40 and 11/40 five-minute continuations, respectively. What causes this spurious speech? We investigate two hypotheses: either repeated sampling selects speech despite persistently low onset probabilities, or conditioning on the model's nonspeech outputs causes an abrupt spike in onset probability. We find that, at every observed onset, speech probability spikes by over nine orders of magnitude in one 80-ms frame, supporting the latter hypothesis. Then, to suppress these onsets without blocking genuine responses, we ask a causal counterfactual question: is the model responding to user speech, or would its next-token distribution remain similar if the preceding user input were muted? Accordingly, we suppress onsets whose distributions change little under this intervention. Across 40 held-out trials per model with realistic microphone noise, our method suppresses 13/13 Moshi and 9/9 PersonaPlex spurious onsets, while preserving 40/40 genuine responses per model. Our inference-time method requires no retraining and runs in real-time, with 95th-percentile decision time below 61 ms, within the 80-ms frame budget. Our code is available at this https URL .
title: Causal Analysis and Mitigation of Spurious Onsets in Full-Duplex Speech LLMs
title_translated: 全双工语音大模型中虚假起始现象的因果分析与缓解
summary_translated: 如Moshi及其衍生模型PersonaPlex的语音到语音大模型可通过全双工生成实现同时听与说。然而，它们在用户长时间沉默期间可能不当开始说话：在数字零输入下，Moshi和PersonaPlex分别在40次五分钟连续测试中有12次和11次启动说话。造成这一虚假说话的原因是什么？我们检验两个假设：一是重复采样即使在持续低起始概率下仍选择说话，二是模型对其非说话输出的条件化导致起始概率突然飙升。我们发现，在每次观测到的起始时刻，语音概率在短短80毫秒内飙升超过九个数量级，支持后者假设。为在不阻断真实响应的前提下抑制这些起始，我们提出一个因果反事实问题：模型是在回应用户语音，还是若前序用户输入被静音，其下一个词元分布仍保持相似？据此，我们抑制那些在干预下分布变化不大的起始。在每模型40次保留测试中（含真实麦克风噪声），该方法成功抑制了全部13次Moshi和9次PersonaPlex的虚假起始，同时保留了每模型全部40次真实响应。该推理时方法无需重训练，可实时运行，第95百分位决策时间低于61毫秒，符合80毫秒帧预算。代码已公开。

summary: We introduce CVSS-X, a large-scale synthetic speech-to-speech translation corpus that extends CVSS by reversing the translation direction. While CVSS translates from 21 languages into English, CVSS-X enables translation from English into 28 target languages spanning 12 language families. The corpus comprises approximately 240,000 parallel speech pairs per language, totaling over 16,000 hours, eight times larger than CVSS. We provide two variants: CVSS-X-C with two canonical voices per language, and CVSS-X-T with cross-lingual voice cloning, both fully generated. Evaluation shows comparable translation quality to CVSS with consistent performance across typologically diverse languages. Combined with CVSS, this enables research on bidirectional and multilingual speech-to-speech translation. The code is available at this https URL and the dataset under CC-BY-NC 4.0 license at this https URL .
title: CVSS-X: A Multilingual Speech-to-Speech Translation Corpus for 28 Languages
title_translated: CVSS-X：面向28种语言的多语言语音到语音翻译语料库
summary_translated: 我们提出了CVSS-X，一个大规模的合成语音到语音翻译语料库，通过反转翻译方向扩展了CVSS。与CVSS将21种语言翻译成英语不同，CVSS-X实现了从英语到涵盖12个语系的28种目标语言的翻译。该语料库每种语言包含约24万对平行语音，总计超过16,000小时，是CVSS的八倍大。我们提供了两种变体：CVSS-X-C每种语言使用两个标准语音，CVSS-X-T采用跨语言语音克隆，两者均为完全生成。评估显示其翻译质量与CVSS相当，并在类型学差异较大的语言中表现一致。结合CVSS，该数据集可支持双向和多语言语音到语音翻译的研究。代码可在该链接获取，数据集以CC-BY-NC 4.0许可发布。

summary: Mapping textual specifications into formal representations is essential for ensuring the correctness of protocol designs and implementations. LLM-generated mappings, used for networking security or testing, are assumed to capture a perfect understanding of the specification, which may not hold in practice. The goal of this paper is to assess the extent to which LLMs can interpret the specification correctly. We examine the degree to which an LLM's implicit representation of a finite-state transition system-defined via natural language descriptions-aligns with a manually generated ground-truth model. We designed 4 tasks and 1482 task queries for 16 protocols. We evaluated different judge biases, observed the inherent difficulty gaps between tasks, looked into the effect of 4 context types, and the influence of protocol characteristics. Our work contributes to a step toward verifying whether LLMs can really be trusted in FSM (Finite State Machine) reasoning of protocol specifications.
title: RFCLLM: Evaluating LLMs' Reasoning Ability of Network Protocol State Machines
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 (Findings)
title_translated: RFCLLM：评估大语言模型对网络协议状态机的推理能力
summary_translated: 将文本规范映射为形式化表示对于确保协议设计与实现的正确性至关重要。目前用于网络安全或测试的LLM生成的映射假设能完美理解规范，但这一假设在实践中可能不成立。本文旨在评估LLM正确理解规范的程度。我们考察了LLM基于自然语言描述隐式构建的有限状态转移系统与其人工生成的真实模型之间的对齐程度。我们设计了4个任务和1482个任务查询，覆盖16种协议。我们评估了不同评判偏差的影响，观察到任务间的固有难度差异，分析了4种上下文类型的作用以及协议特征的影响。本研究为验证LLM在协议规范的有限状态机推理中是否可信迈出了一步。

summary: Maxillofacial report generation from cone beam computed tomography is scored here by a composite objective placing 80% of its weight on a large language model judgement of factual entailment and 20% on lexical overlap, of which only the lexical fifth is visible during development. The grader's BLEU-4 and METEOR routines are reproduced in pure Python and match the reference to machine precision, and an offline entailment surrogate, which tells a report written for one patient from one written for another at an area under the curve of 0.987, makes the composite objective cheap enough to optimise directly. Over the 622-case public release, a report selected against the visible lexical ranking scores 0.2909, whereas one selected against the composite objective scores 0.4122, because pursuing n-gram overlap drives entailment precision from 0.522 down to 0.266. A 29 million parameter encoder fine-tuned on the release reaches a prevalence-weighted out-of-fold area under the curve of 0.486 over 985 statements, indistinguishable from the corpus prior, while nine numbers read from the image header reach 0.945 for mandible coverage and 0.872 for condyle coverage, and acquisition centre alone predicts sentence choice at 0.718 against 0.663 for the image-derived model, identifying dictation convention rather than anatomy as the quantity the lexical metrics reward. The delivered system emits eight unconditional statements and five gated on header geometry under polarity, laterality and tooth-level consistency constraints, and reaches METEOR 0.3542 over 50 held-out cases from an unseen centre. The dataset and code are available at this https URL
title: Clinical Reasoning Under a Partially Observed Objective in Cone Beam CT Report Generation
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. ODIN 2026 CBCT report generation challenge system. Code: this https URL
title_translated: 在部分可观测目标下的锥形束CT报告生成中的临床推理
summary_translated: 本研究通过复合目标评估颌面CT报告生成，该目标将80%权重分配给大语言模型对事实蕴含的判断，20%分配给词汇重叠，其中仅五分之一的词汇重叠在开发阶段可见。我们用纯Python重现了评分器的BLEU-4和METEOR算法，精度达到参考值水平；并引入一个离线蕴含代理，其在受试者间报告比较上的AUC达到0.987，使复合目标足够廉价以直接优化。在622例公开数据集上，基于可见词汇排名选择的报告得分为0.2909，而基于复合目标选择的报告得分为0.4122，因为追求n-gram重叠会将蕴含精确度从0.522降至0.266。一个在公开数据集上微调的2900万参数编码器，在985个陈述上的加权出折AUC为0.486，与语料库先验无显著差异；而仅从图像头信息读取的九个数值即可分别预测下颌覆盖（AUC 0.945）和髁突覆盖（AUC 0.872），且采集中心本身对句子选择的预测力（AUC 0.718）高于图像衍生模型（AUC 0.663），表明词汇指标奖励的是口述惯例而非解剖结构。最终系统输出八个无条件陈述和五个基于头信息几何特征（极性、侧向性和牙位一致性约束）的条件陈述，在来自未见中心的50个保留案例上达到METEOR 0.3542。数据集和代码已公开。

summary: Large Vision--Language Models (LVLMs) are increasingly expected to perform visual question answering (VQA) over planar media. However, existing planar VQA benchmarks typically emphasize isolated challenges: some emphasize long-document understanding with limited reasoning depth, while others require complex visual reasoning but remain restricted to single-page, noise-free settings. Moreover, through theoretical analysis, we identify the impact of irrelevant visual tokens, which leads to measurable performance degradation but has received little attention with respect to systematic quantification. To address these limitations, we introduce TestHallVQA, a multi-image VQA benchmark that simultaneously embodies document-level scale and the difficulty of human examinations, while providing comprehensive task coverage. Leveraging TestHallVQA's ability to controllably inject multi-level contextual redundancy, we further propose a novel metric, F1-R\textsuperscript{2}, which jointly quantifies LVLMs' computational reasoning capability and their evidence retrieval robustness against document-level redundancy. Extensive experiments and analyses on mainstream LVLMs reveal their latent deficiencies across multiple dimensions, offering concrete insights and directions for future research. The associated datasets, code, and complete theoretical derivations are available at this https URL .
title: TestHallVQA: Exploring LVLMs' Document-Level Reasoning under Redundant Contexts from Scientific Exams
title_translated: TestHallVQA：探索LVLM在科学考试冗余上下文下的文档级推理能力
summary_translated: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）正被期望在平面媒体上执行视觉问答（VQA）。然而，现有平面VQA基准通常强调孤立挑战：一些侧重长文档理解但推理深度有限，另一些则要求复杂视觉推理，但局限于单页、无噪声环境。此外，通过理论分析，我们识别出无关视觉标记的影响，导致可测量的性能下降，但该问题尚未得到系统量化。为解决这些局限，我们提出TestHallVQA，一个包含多图像的VQA基准，同时具备文档级规模和人类考试的难度，并提供全面的任务覆盖。利用TestHallVQA可控注入多层次上下文冗余的能力，我们进一步提出一种新指标F1-R²，联合量化LVLM的计算推理能力和面对文档级冗余时的证据检索鲁棒性。对主流LVLM的大量实验与分析揭示了其在多个维度上的潜在缺陷，为未来研究提供了具体洞见与方向。相关数据集、代码及完整理论推导均已公开。

summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have made prompts increasingly large and complex. Techniques such as chain-of-thought reasoning (Wei et al., 2022) and in-context learning (Brown et al., 2020) frequently push real-world prompts past several thousand tokens, increasing inference cost and latency. Learned compression methods such as LLMLingua (Jiang et al., 2023) and Selective Context (Li et al., 2023) achieve high compression ratios but require auxiliary language models and are non-deterministic. We ask a complementary question: how far can a training-free, fully deterministic, CPU-only pipeline based on classical lexical NLP be pushed before output quality degrades significantly? Eleven toggleable lexical transformations - stopword removal, filler-phrase deletion, contraction and abbreviation substitution, part-of-speech-based pruning, lemmatization, WordNet-driven synonym shortening, and named-entity preservation - are assembled into a configurable pipeline. Fifteen configurations are evaluated on 1,242 English-only prompts from six sources (Dolly-15k, LMSYS-Chat-1M, WildChat-1M, MMLU, GSM8K, HellaSwag), spanning eleven automatically derived task categories, yielding 18,630 paired GPT-4o-mini completions. Output preservation is measured using BLEU, ROUGE-1/2/L, BERTScore-F1, and SentenceBERT cosine similarity. The most aggressive configuration achieves a mean token reduction of 40.3% (sigma = 9.2) at a BERTScore-F1 of 0.876 against the original-prompt output; a stopword-only configuration achieves 29.6% reduction at 0.913. The compression-versus-fidelity Pareto frontier is characterized per task category, with commonsense reasoning a systematic failure mode under aggressive compression. All code, prompts, and per-cell results are released for reproducibility.
title: Lexical Prompt Compression for Large Language Models: A Training-Free, Deterministic Pipeline with Empirical Pareto Analysis Across Eleven Task Categories
comment: the paper is 27 pages with 10 figures and 4 tables. Code and data for the experiments: this https URL . Python package (pip install less-tokens): this https URL
title_translated: 大语言模型的词汇提示压缩：一种无需训练、确定性的流水线及其在十一个任务类别中的经验帕累托分析
summary_translated: 近年来大语言模型（LLMs）的发展使得提示词日益庞大复杂。诸如思维链推理（Wei等，2022）和上下文学习（Brown等，2020）等技术常使实际提示词超过数千token，增加了推理成本和延迟。已有压缩方法如LLMLingua（Jiang等，2023）和Selective Context（Li等，2023）虽实现高压缩比，但需辅助语言模型且非确定性。我们提出一个互补问题：基于经典词汇NLP的无需训练、完全确定、仅依赖CPU的流水线，在输出质量显著下降前能推进到何种程度？我们整合了十一种可切换的词汇转换操作——停用词删除、填充短语删除、缩写替换、基于词性剪枝、词形还原、基于WordNet的同义词缩短以及命名实体保留——构成可配置流水线。在六个来源（Dolly-15k、LMSYS-Chat-1M、WildChat-1M、MMLU、GSM8K、HellaSwag）的1,242个英文提示上评估了十五种配置，覆盖十一个自动推导的任务类别，共生成18,630对GPT-4o-mini完成结果。输出保真度通过BLEU、ROUGE-1/2/L、BERTScore-F1和SentenceBERT余弦相似度衡量。最激进配置实现平均40.3%（σ=9.2）的token减少，BERTScore-F1为0.876；仅停用词删除配置实现29.6%减少，BERTScore-F1为0.913。各任务类别的压缩-保真帕累托前沿被刻画，常识推理在激进压缩下成为系统性失败模式。所有代码、提示和单元结果均已发布以保证可复现性。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) perform strongly on static science benchmarks, yet their ability to reason about the physical world through active experimentation remains poorly understood. We introduce PhysMent, a benchmark that evaluates LLM physical reasoning via iterative, toolmediated interaction with a MuJoCo physics simulator. Unlike static benchmarks that supply all quantities upfront, PhysMent requires models to discover information by applying forces, querying object states, advancing time, and modifying scene geometry before answering. The benchmark comprises 105 scenes of classical mechanics, organized across four difficulty regimes (Easy/Hard and Single/Multi), three scene modalities (standard, object creation, hidden objects), and a scene-manipulation category, evaluated with a six-dimensional scoring framework. Results show that current models perform reasonably well on qualitative single-concept tasks (up to 80% accuracy) but degrade substantially on quantitative tasks that demand precise, multi-step experimental procedures: most models fall below 30% on the hardest single-concept category, where the bottleneck is procedural (adaptive multi-step tool use) rather than conceptual load. Across the seven models, accuracy ranges from 25% to 67%, with failures due to premature answer submission, inefficient exploration, and inconsistent grounding in simulator feedback rather than conceptual gaps.
title: PhysMent: An Interactive Approach For LLM Reasoning In Physics Problems
title_translated: PhysMent：一种用于大语言模型在物理问题中推理的交互式方法
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）在静态科学基准测试中表现优异，但其通过主动实验来推理物理世界的能力仍不明确。我们提出了PhysMent，一个通过与MuJoCo物理模拟器进行迭代、工具中介交互来评估LLM物理推理能力的基准。与提供所有量值的静态基准不同，PhysMent要求模型通过施加力、查询物体状态、推进时间、修改场景几何结构来发现信息后再作答。该基准包含105个经典力学场景，按四个难度等级（简单/困难）和单体/多体划分，三种场景模态（标准、物体创建、隐藏物体），以及一个场景操作类别，采用六维评分框架进行评估。结果表明，当前模型在定性单概念任务上表现尚可（最高达80%准确率），但在需要精确、多步骤实验流程的定量任务上显著退化：大多数模型在最困难的单概念类别中准确率低于30%，瓶颈在于程序性能力（自适应多步工具使用）而非概念负荷。在七种模型中，准确率范围为25%至67%，失败原因包括过早提交答案、探索效率低下以及对模拟器反馈的不一致依赖，而非概念性缺陷。

summary: Leading multilingual speech recognition models like Whisper transcribe diverse, low-resource languages without language-specific training but are computationally expensive to deploy. Token merging mitigates this inefficiency by dynamically combining redundant features, shortening the sequence length during inference without requiring retraining. In this paper, we systematically evaluate token merging on the Whisper model family across sixteen diverse languages and three different model sizes. We also test how token merging interacts with fine-tuning (DoRA) on low-resource languages. Our findings show that merging tokens increases computational efficiency with almost no loss in transcription accuracy across most low-resource languages and model sizes, and it works even after the model has been fine-tuned. Our results demonstrate that token merging is a highly practical method for making multilingual speech recognition faster and cheaper to deploy.
title: Token Merging for Multilingual Speech Recognition: A Systematic Study Across Model Scale and Fine-Tuning
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures
title_translated: 多语言语音识别中的词元合并：跨模型规模与微调的系统研究
summary_translated: 领先的多语言语音识别模型如Whisper能够在无需特定语言训练的情况下转录多种低资源语言，但部署时计算成本较高。词元合并通过动态合并冗余特征，在推理过程中缩短序列长度，无需重新训练即可缓解这一效率问题。本文系统评估了词元合并方法在Whisper模型族上的表现，覆盖十六种不同语言和三种不同模型规模，并测试其与低资源语言微调（DoRA）的兼容性。研究发现，词元合并在大多数低资源语言和模型规模下几乎不损失转录准确率的同时显著提升计算效率，且即使在模型已微调后依然有效。结果表明，词元合并是一种高度实用的方法，可使多语言语音识别更快、更低成本地部署。

summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). We introduce Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO), a critic-free method derived from Policy Mirror Descent (PMD). For autoregressive generation with terminal rewards, BPO uses the Bellman equations to reformulate PMD as a trajectory-level objective. The reformulation avoids estimating state values at intermediate states. We prove that it has the same unique optimal solution as the original PMD objective. We derive the practical BPO loss by approximating this objective. Its mismatch-correction weight is a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of BPO.
title: Bellman Policy Optimization
title_translated: 贝尔曼策略优化
summary_translated: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）能够提升大语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力。我们提出贝尔曼策略优化（BPO），一种源自策略镜像下降（PMD）的无评判器方法。针对具有终端奖励的自回归生成，BPO利用贝尔曼方程将PMD重构为轨迹级目标，避免对中间状态的价值估计。我们证明该重构目标与原始PMD目标具有相同的唯一最优解。通过近似该目标，推导出实际可用的BPO损失函数，其不匹配修正权重为互补词元概率的平滑比。在数学推理基准上的实验验证了BPO的有效性。

summary: Language models can produce plausible short proofs, but may still be unreliable on long-horizon research problems, where progress depends on a sequence of uncertain and interdependent decisions. We introduce Stellar Colosseum, a model-agnostic harness for allocating inference across research in mathematics and theoretical computer science. Colosseum explores alternative strategies before proof construction, uses a readiness gate to decide when a route is mature enough to decompose, represents the proof plan as interdependent section-level subproblems, and routes verifier findings back to the affected part of the argument. Across these stages, it generates candidates in parallel, attacks them with targeted falsification, and combines candidates and their critiques into a single research artifact through overlapping random-sample tree aggregation. The Colosseum workflow has also been integrated into Google Antigravity's Teamwork framework as the Long Proof pattern. We demonstrate the capabilities of Colosseum through open-ended research and evaluations on theorem-proving and competitive programming benchmarks. Using Colosseum with Gemini 3.1 Pro, we obtain several new results that address open problems arising from papers published at top venues such as FOCS and JMLR. On TCS-Bench, a benchmark of research-level theorem-proving tasks drawn from papers published at FOCS, STOC, and SODA, Colosseum achieves 71.0% accuracy using Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 3.7 Flash. In a separate Codeforces evaluation using Gemini 3.1 Pro, the proof-oriented pipeline with execution feedback solves 218 of 222 problems.
title: Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
title_translated: 恒星角斗场：面向数学与理论计算机科学长周期研究的多智能体框架
summary_translated: 语言模型可以生成看似合理的短证明，但在长周期研究问题上仍不可靠，因为进展依赖一系列不确定且相互关联的决策。我们引入Stellar Colosseum，一种适用于数学与理论计算机科学领域研究的模型无关框架，用于分配推理资源。Colosseum在构建证明前探索多种策略，使用就绪门判断路径是否成熟到可分解，将证明计划表示为相互依赖的章节级子问题，并将验证结果反馈至论证相关部分。在整个流程中，它并行生成候选方案，以针对性方式攻击这些方案，并通过重叠随机采样树聚合技术将候选及其批判整合为单一研究成果。Colosseum工作流已集成至Google Antigravity的Teamwork框架中，作为“长证明”模式。我们通过开放式研究及在定理证明和竞赛编程基准上的评估展示了Colosseum的能力。使用Gemini 3.1 Pro，我们在多个开放问题上取得新成果，这些问题源于FOCS和JMLR等顶级会议论文。在TCS-Bench（基于FOCS、STOC、SODA论文的科研级定理证明任务基准）上，Colosseum使用Gemini 3.1 Pro和Gemini 3.7 Flash达到71.0%的准确率。在Codeforces独立评估中，使用Gemini 3.1 Pro的以执行反馈为导向的证明流水线解决了218道题中的222道。

summary: Skills extend an LLM agent beyond its parametric knowledge, and the gain they promise rests on picking the right one. Deployed harnesses route by preloading every skill's metadata into the context, which disperses the agent's attention and caps the library size. Retrieval pipelines move the selection out of the context, but also out of the agent's capability. We show that the frozen agent LLM already carries the routing signal in its own forward passes, and that two linear maps suffice to read it out with no skill text in the context. Gavel (Glance And Verdict from a frozen LLM) reads it in two steps. A glance projects the task's and each skill's mid-layer states through the two maps, the only parameters trained, and scores the full library against compact per-skill banks that one forward pass builds at installation. A verdict then resumes the shortlisted skills' forward passes and reads the model's own likelihood and yes/no judgment, fused with the glance as a product of experts. Trained once, Gavel transfers zero-shot to three public benchmarks and SkillTraj, our new benchmark of 372 simulated agent trajectories. On Qwen3-32B it outperforms progressive disclosure and retrieve-and-rerank pipelines that add 1.2B to 16B external parameters, by up to 13.4 points on written tasks and up to 21.9 when the need for a skill arises mid-rollout. Routing accuracy improves as the backbone does, and in a bash-agent harness the same 32B triggers the correct skill on Skill-Use more often than far larger frontier models running in Codex.
title: The Router Within: Eliciting Native Skill Routing from a Frozen LLM
title_translated: 内部路由器：从冻结的大语言模型中提取原生技能路由能力
summary_translated: 技能可扩展LLM代理超出其参数化知识范围，而其潜力取决于能否选择正确的技能。现有部署框架通过预加载每个技能的元数据到上下文中实现路由，但这会分散代理注意力并限制技能库大小。检索管道虽将选择移出上下文，但也超出了代理自身能力。我们发现，冻结的LLM代理在其自身的前向传播中已携带路由信号，仅需两个线性映射即可读取，无需在上下文中包含技能文本。Gavel（来自冻结LLM的凝视与判断）通过两步完成：首先，凝视阶段通过两个映射投影任务和各技能的中间层状态，仅训练这两个参数，构建每项技能的紧凑银行库；其次，判断阶段恢复被选技能的前向传播，读取模型自身的似然度和是/否判断，并将其与凝视结果融合为专家乘积。Gavel一次性训练后，零样本迁移至三个公开基准和我们新提出的372条模拟代理轨迹基准SkillTraj。在Qwen3-32B上，其性能优于添加了12亿至160亿外部参数的渐进披露和检索-重排序管道，写作任务最高提升13.4分，中途需调用技能时提升高达21.9分。路由准确率随主干模型性能提升而提高，在bash代理框架中，同一32B模型触发正确技能的频率甚至超过运行于Codex的更大前沿模型。

summary: Data agents aim to fulfill natural-language instructions over heterogeneous data, including tables, files, and databases. However, data agents face a challenging agent-data gap: heterogeneous data resides outside the agent, while the agent can access it (e.g., column names and file paths) only through generic tools. Existing approaches either let agents directly explore raw data sources or inject manually constructed semantic layers into prompts. However, neither scales well to large heterogeneous data sources nor adapts to different agent behaviors. In this paper, we introduce EvoOntology, a self-evolving ontology layer for data agents. EvoOntology encapsulates the ontology as an MCP server comprising a schema layer, a content layer, and a tool layer, enabling agents to actively query and interact with the ontology at runtime. To this end, we introduce a builder agent for autonomous ontology construction and a self-evolution loop that continuously refines the ontology through attribution-guided typed edits that are accepted only after a backbone-conditional paired evaluation. Experiments on three well-adopted data-agent benchmarks with four LLM backbones demonstrate that EvoOntology consistently outperforms strong baselines and existing semantic-layer approaches, effectively bridging the agent-data gap and enabling more effective interaction with heterogeneous data. title: EvoOntology: A Self-Evolving Ontology Layer for Data Agents

title_translated: EvoOntology：面向数据智能体的自演化本体层
summary_translated: 数据智能体旨在对异构数据（包括表格、文件和数据库）执行自然语言指令。然而，数据智能体面临严峻的智能体-数据鸿沟问题：异构数据位于智能体外部，而智能体只能通过通用工具访问（如列名和文件路径）。现有方法要么让智能体直接探索原始数据源，要么在提示中注入手动构建的语义层。但这些方法难以扩展到大规模异构数据源，也无法适应不同的智能体行为。本文提出EvoOntology，一种面向数据智能体的自演化本体层。EvoOntology将本体封装为一个包含模式层、内容层和工具层的MCP服务器，使智能体能够在运行时主动查询和交互本体。为此，我们引入了一个构建智能体以实现本体的自主构建，并设计了自演化循环，通过仅在经过骨干模型条件下的配对评估后才接受的属性引导型类型编辑来持续优化本体。在三个广泛采用的数据智能体基准上，使用四种LLM骨干进行实验表明，EvoOntology始终优于强基线和现有语义层方法，有效弥合了智能体-数据鸿沟，提升了与异构数据的交互效率。代码：此https链接

summary: AI-driven automated decision-making requires both predictive performance and interpretability. Recent advances in interpretable machine learning (IML) provide tools for explaining model predictions, but the technical complexity of these explanations may hinder accessibility to non-experts. To address this challenge, this study integrates data storytelling with IML to enhance the explainability of AI-generated decisions for a broader audience. Following the design science research (DSR) paradigm, this study proposes a formal definition of data storytelling in IML, introduces the DIST Pyramid to align data storytelling with IML, and presents the I-P-O Model to describe their interactions. It further develops an architecture to explain AI decisions through distinct "What-if" and "Why-not" event-generation processes. The architecture also employs data desensitization to protect sensitive input data. To validate the approach, a case study is conducted with the Boston Housing dataset, using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) values and large language models (LLMs) to generate data stories with And-But-Therefore (ABT) structures. An empirical evaluation shows that 76.4% and 74.3% of respondents rated the "What-if" and "Why-not" data stories as more comprehensible, with significantly higher accessibility scores than traditional SHAP visualizations. The paper concludes with the presentation of a narrative interpretation framework that integrates IML and data storytelling, thereby expanding the research scope as well as the practical applicability of AI decision-making.
title: Data storytelling meets interpretable machine learning: Decoding AI decisions for non-experts without revealing sensitive data and model details
title_translated: 数据叙事融合可解释机器学习：在不暴露敏感数据与模型细节的前提下解码AI决策以供非专家理解
summary_translated: 基于AI的自动化决策既需要预测性能，也需要可解释性。近年来可解释机器学习（IML）的发展提供了用于解释模型预测的工具，但这些解释的技术复杂性可能阻碍非专家的理解。为应对这一挑战，本研究将数据叙事与IML相结合，提升AI生成决策对更广泛受众的可解释性。遵循设计科学研究（DSR）范式，本研究提出了IML中数据叙事的形式化定义，引入DIST金字塔以对齐数据叙事与IML，并提出I-P-O模型描述二者之间的交互。此外，还开发了一种架构，通过独立的“假设”和“反假设”事件生成过程解释AI决策。该架构还采用数据去敏技术保护敏感输入数据。为验证该方法，以波士顿房价数据集为例，结合SHapley加法解释（SHAP）值和大语言模型（LLMs）生成具有And-But-Therefore（ABT）结构的数据故事。实证评估显示，76.4%和74.3%的受访者认为“假设”和“反假设”数据故事更具可理解性，且显著高于传统SHAP可视化的人均可访问性评分。论文最后呈现了一个整合IML与数据叙事的叙述性解释框架，拓展了AI决策研究范围及实际应用价值。

summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds a language model's answers on retrieved external knowledge and returns each answer with citations that identify its sources. Those citations are the user's audit trail: they let a reader verify a claim without trusting the model. Prior security work on RAG asks whether an attacker can corrupt the answer, leaving the citation channel unexplored. We show that this channel is a new and practical attack surface. We propose CiteShade, the first citation laundering attack to RAG, in which an attacker controlling a single source induces a model to produce an attacker-chosen wrong answer and to attribute it to a trusted source that does not support it, while the evidence for the correct answer remains in context. We formulate the attack as an optimization problem, derive three necessary conditions (retrieval, generation, and citation) and construct sources satisfying them without any instruction. On multi-source multi-hop question answering the attack raises the wrong-answer rate from 0.01 to 0.68, and source deletion confirms the malicious source is the causal driver in every measured case. Vulnerability tracks a model's propensity to cite rather than its scale, reaching CLR 0.84 under explicit instruction and 0.64 with no instruction at all on the most citation-prone model tested. We then show that perplexity filtering and citation-support checking are each insufficient, and propose a counterfactual defense that verifies which source actually drove the answer.
title: CiteShade: Citation Laundering in Multi-Source Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Its Counterfactual Defense

title_translated: CiteShade：多源检索增强生成中的引用清洗及其反事实防御
summary_translated: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过检索外部知识来支撑语言模型的回答，并为每个回答附带引用以标识其来源。这些引用是用户的审计轨迹：读者无需信任模型即可验证声明。以往关于RAG的安全研究关注攻击者是否能污染回答，却未探索引用通道。我们证明该通道是一个新的且实际的攻击面。本文提出CiteShade，首个针对RAG的引用清洗攻击，其中攻击者控制单一数据源，诱导模型生成攻击者选定的错误答案，并将其归因于一个可信但不支持该答案的来源，同时正确答案的证据仍保留在上下文中。我们将攻击形式化为优化问题，推导出三个必要条件（检索、生成、引用），并构造满足这些条件的源数据而无需任何指令。在多源多跳问答任务中，错误答案率从0.01上升至0.68；源删除实验确认恶意源在所有测量案例中均为因果驱动。漏洞追踪显示模型倾向于引用而非规模，最易引用的模型在明确指令下达到CLR 0.84，在无指令下也达0.64。随后我们发现困惑度过滤和引用支持检查各自均不充分，并提出一种反事实防御机制，验证究竟是哪个源真正驱动了答案。

summary: Long-text image--text congruence scoring is increasingly important for vision-language systems that must evaluate whether detailed textual descriptions match visual content. However, raw similarity scores from dual-encoder models are difficult to interpret as calibrated congruence measures, especially under the modality gap between image and text embeddings. This paper proposes Congruency Score (CS), a lightweight calibration layer that maps image--text similarity evidence into a bounded score. Using DOCCI and Urban1k, we evaluate four frozen vision-language backbones and show that observed reductions in post-projection centroid distance do not uniformly improve image--text retrieval performance. Human-grounded evaluations on DOCCI further reveal a trade-off: direct post-hoc calibration preserves high association with human judgments, whereas selected projection-based configurations can reduce threshold-relevant slope and intercept distortions at the cost of retrieval performance and association strength. These results establish long-text image--text congruence scoring as a calibrated score-estimation problem, where retrieval performance, human association, and threshold calibration must be evaluated as distinct objectives. CS provides a lightweight way to expose and operationalize this separation.
title: Human-Grounded Calibration for Long-Text Image-Text Congruence in Vision-Language Models
