title_translated: 与城市对话：面向车外参照的多模态解决方法
summary_translated: 随着自动驾驶汽车和扩展现实（XR）头显的普及，车内新型交互方式逐渐兴起，但无缝查询物理地标（即车外参照，OVR）仍面临挑战，主要源于自身运动和指代模糊性。本文提出一种稳健的多模态OVR框架，融合用户视线与自然语言以识别兴趣点（POIs）。为应对动态车载数据稀缺问题，我们开发了一套基于VR的流水线，同步360度交通视频与车辆GNSS遥测数据。通过一项用户研究（N=46），将乘客头部朝向映射至三维地理数字孪生，捕捉真实的注视-言语行为。随后，我们训练了一个轻量级Transformer网络，利用大语言模型动态对齐连续空间注视向量与离散语言上下文。实验结果表明，该方法具有高精度和低计算开销，达到83.33%的Top-1准确率（Top-2为87.72%），平均推理时间仅为24.3毫秒。这一实时范式有效解决了指代模糊性问题，为车内乘客提供情境感知的空间检索能力。

summary: Turn-taking is a fundamental component of spoken interaction, and while humans naturally rely on both verbal and non-verbal signals, dialogue systems usually depend on audio cues alone. This paper investigates whether visual features from face-to-face conversations can enhance turn-taking prediction beyond what is achievable from audio-only. We extend the Voice Activity Projection (VAP) model, a self-supervised transformer-based model for predicting future voice activity, by incorporating visual features extracted from the large-scale Meta Seamless Interaction dataset of dyadic face-to-face conversations. The visual features include gaze direction, head movement, body and hand pose, and facial action units (FAU). For incorporating the visual features, we explore concatenation, cross-attention fusion, delta features, and trainable gating mechanisms. Results show that visual information improves performance over the audio-only baseline, with FAU being significantly more informative than other feature groups. Body and gaze features nevertheless contribute complementary information, as the model combining all features performs best. Furthermore, results indicate that performance on specific tasks varies depending on whether training and test data come from improvised (acted) or naturalistic (non-acted) conversations.
title: Exploring Multimodal Turn-Taking Cues in Face-to-Face Conversation using Voice Activity Projection
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Workshop on Multimodal Interaction in Face-to-Face Dialogue (MINT)
title_translated: 使用语音活动投影探索面对面对话中的多模态轮流发言线索
summary_translated: 轮流发言是口语互动的基本组成部分，尽管人类自然依赖语音与非语音信号，但对话系统通常仅依赖音频线索。本文探讨视觉特征（来自面对面对话）能否在音频仅的基础上进一步提升轮流发言预测性能。我们扩展了语音活动投影（VAP）模型——一种基于自监督Transformer的未来语音活动预测模型——通过引入来自大规模Meta Seamless Interaction数据集的面对面双人对话中的视觉特征。视觉特征包括注视方向、头部运动、身体与手部姿态以及面部动作单元（FAU）。为融合视觉特征，我们探索了拼接、交叉注意力融合、差分特征和可训练门控机制等多种方式。结果表明，视觉信息优于纯音频基线，其中FAU显著比其他特征组更具信息量。身体与注视特征仍提供互补信息，综合所有特征的模型表现最佳。此外，结果还显示，特定任务的表现取决于训练与测试数据是否来自即兴（表演）或自然主义（非表演）对话。

summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a standard approach for transferring capabilities from large teachers to compact students. Its cost, however, is dominated by autoregressive student rollouts and scales poorly in multi-turn agentic settings. Existing acceleration methods truncate or relocate the supervision signal according to fixed, offline budgets, despite substantial variation in teacher-signal reliability both within and across trajectories. Our empirical analysis on $\tau^2$-bench reveals a clear structure in this variation: informative supervision is concentrated in the prefix of each turn, and, most importantly for multi-turn agentic training, the cross-turn loss of teacher endorsement is temporally locked to the student's first erroneous action rather than accumulating gradually over turns. Building on these findings, we propose STRIDE (Stop-and-Restart on-policy Distillation acceleration), which combines two complementary techniques: adaptive early stopping, which terminates a rollout once the cumulative teacher log-probability falls below an out-of-distribution threshold, and a prefix buffer, which caches high-quality prefixes and restarts generation at the weakest correct turn. Together, these mechanisms induce a data-driven curriculum that progressively extends coverage to later turns. On $\tau^2$-bench retail, our method matches full-trajectory OPD and exceeds the 30B teacher at a $3.73\times$ speedup, surpasses the baseline itself at $2.34\times$, and retains a $4.51\times$ speedup under cross-domain multi-teacher training. As a supplementary generalization test beyond the agentic setting, STRIDE outperforms full OPD on AIME 2025 at a $5.10\times$ speedup and on AIME 2024 at a $3.08\times$ speedup; averaged across the two evaluations, both fixed-budget truncation baselines remain below full OPD.
title: Know When to Stop, Where to Restart: Accelerating Multi-Turn Agentic On-Policy Distillation
comment: 14 pages, 8 figures
title_translated: 何时停止，何处重启：加速多轮智能体的在线蒸馏
summary_translated: 在线蒸馏（OPD）已成为将大型教师模型的能力迁移到小型学生模型的标准方法。然而，其成本主要由自回归学生轨迹生成主导，在多轮智能体设置中扩展性差。现有加速方法根据固定的离线预算截断或重定位监督信号，尽管在轨迹内部和跨轨迹之间教师信号的可靠性存在显著差异。我们在τ²-bench上的实证分析揭示了这种差异的清晰结构：有效监督集中在每一轮的前缀部分，且对多轮智能体训练而言最重要的是，教师支持的跨轮损失在时间上与学生首次错误动作锁定，而非随轮次逐渐累积。基于这些发现，我们提出STRIDE（停止与重启的在线蒸馏加速方法），结合两种互补技术：自适应早期停止，一旦累积教师对数概率低于分布外阈值即终止轨迹；以及前缀缓冲区，缓存高质量前缀并在最弱正确轮次重新启动生成。这两种机制共同构建了一个数据驱动的教学进度，逐步扩展对后续轮次的覆盖。在τ²-bench零售任务上，我们的方法在3.73倍加速下达到完整轨迹OPD性能，并超越30B教师模型；在2.34倍加速下优于基线；在跨领域多教师训练下仍保持4.51倍加速。作为对智能体场景之外的泛化测试，STRIDE在AIME 2025上以5.10倍加速优于完整OPD，在AIME 2024上以3.08倍加速优于完整OPD；在两项评估中，所有固定预算截断基线均未超过完整OPD。

summary: Rigorous empirical validation of quantum machine learning on natural language tasks remains scarce. We evaluate a 10-qubit hybrid quantum-classical variational circuit (2,148 parameters) for paraphrase detection across three benchmarks: MRPC, Quora Question Pairs (QQP), and adversarial PAWS. On QQP (n = 10 seeds), the circuit achieves 75.53% +/- 0.75%. accuracy, statistically outperforming parameter-matched classical baselines (DeepMLP: p = 0.015, Cohen's d = 1.20; F1: p < 0.001, d = 2.32) and surpassing DistilBERT-4bit with 31,191 fewer parameters. On MRPC the optimal 2-layer variant reaches 92% of BERT-base accuracy at 54,000 lower parameter cost. Circuit depth analysis reveals a dataset-depth scaling effect; entanglement analysis via the Meyer-Wallach measure identifies multi-qubit entanglement as the primary performance driver (r = 0.85 across four variants). Adversarial evaluation on PAWS reveals emergent robustness: 98.2% recall versus 81.6% classical (+16.6 pp, d = 1.24, p < 0.001), without adversarial training. These results constitute the first systematic parameter-matched multi-benchmark empirical validation of hybrid variational circuits for NLP. All results are from classical simulation; hardware validation is future work.
title: Parameter-Efficient Quantum NLP for Paraphrase Detection: Performance, Robustness, and Entanglement
title_translated: 参数高效的量子自然语言处理用于释义检测：性能、鲁棒性与纠缠
summary_translated: 对量子机器学习在自然语言任务上的严格实证验证仍然稀缺。我们评估了一个10量子比特的混合量子-经典变分电路（2,148个参数）在三个基准上的释义检测表现：MRPC、Quora问题对（QQP）和对抗性PAWS。在QQP（n = 10种子）上，该电路达到75.53% ± 0.75%的准确率，统计上优于参数匹配的经典基线（DeepMLP：p = 0.015，Cohen's d = 1.20；F1：p < 0.001，d = 2.32），并以31,191个更少的参数超越DistilBERT-4bit。在MRPC上，最优的两层变体达到BERT-base准确率的92%，参数成本降低54,000。电路深度分析揭示了数据集-深度缩放效应；通过Meyer-Wallach度量进行纠缠分析，识别出多量子比特纠缠是主要性能驱动因素（r = 0.85，跨四个变体）。在PAWS上的对抗性评估显示涌现的鲁棒性：召回率达98.2%，而经典模型为81.6%（提升16.6个百分点，d = 1.24，p < 0.001），且无需对抗训练。这些结果构成了首个系统性的、参数匹配的多基准NLP混合变分电路实证验证。所有结果均来自经典模拟；硬件验证为未来工作。

summary: Deep research agents answer complex questions through iterative loops of searching, reading, and reasoning. Recent work on reasoning-intensive benchmarks such as BrowseComp-Plus shows that well-configured lexical retrieval can surface high-quality evidence, yet agents may still fail to connect documents carrying evidence to the gold documents. We identify a deep research agent's first retrieval move as an important design decision for this setting. We introduce Question's Gambit, a first-move retrieval module that decomposes the question into a set of clues, reformulates them into complementary searches, consolidates the retrieved results, and reranks the candidate pool before the agent begins its iterative search-and-reasoning process. This produces an opening context designed to support both clue aggregation and final-answer verification. We further evaluate on MultiHop-RAG to test whether these benefits transfer beyond BrowseComp-Plus to a more conventional multi-hop question structure. Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus show that Question's Gambit improves retrieval recall and downstream agent accuracy over strong baselines, improving answer accuracy from 83.1% to 90.5% with gpt-5.5 over Pi-Serini, the strongest reported agentic baseline. Our results confirm that effective agentic deep research depends not only on the tools available inside the loop, but also on the quality of the first move. We published our implementation publicly at this https URL .
title: Question's Gambit: The First Move Matters in Agentic Deep Search
title_translated: 问题的先手：在智能体深度搜索中第一步至关重要
summary_translated: 深度研究智能体通过搜索、阅读和推理的迭代循环来回答复杂问题。近期关于推理密集型基准如BrowseComp-Plus的研究表明，配置良好的词汇检索可提取高质量证据，但智能体仍可能无法将携带证据的文档与正确答案文档关联起来。我们识别出智能体的第一步检索操作是此场景中的关键设计决策。我们引入“问题的先手”（Question's Gambit），一种首步检索模块，将问题分解为一组线索，将其重构为互补搜索，整合检索结果，并在智能体开始迭代搜索与推理过程前对候选池进行重排序。这生成一个初始上下文，旨在支持线索聚合与最终答案验证。我们进一步在MultiHop-RAG上进行评估，以检验这些优势是否能从BrowseComp-Plus迁移至更传统的多跳问题结构。在BrowseComp-Plus上的实验表明，“问题的先手”在检索召回率和下游智能体准确率方面优于强基线，使用gpt-5.5时将答案准确率从83.1%提升至90.5%，超越Pi-Serini（最强报告的智能体基线）。结果证实，有效的智能体深度研究不仅依赖于循环内的工具，还取决于第一步的质量。我们已将实现代码公开发布。

summary: Natural language prompts and skills serve as the strategic backbone of LLM-based agents. Recent advances in prompt and skill optimization have achieved notable gains, yet all existing methods optimize a \emph{single} text template---missing the synergy among multiple complementary strategies. We propose MOSCOPT, a text-native, parameter-free algorithm that jointly optimizes a pool of $N$ skills and a gating skill $G$ that dynamically selects $K$ skills per step. To effectively optimize the skills, we build the EditAdam with internally maintained dual states. Through the three-phase interleaved updates with EditAdam, the system monotonically improves without gradient or parameter tuning. Extensive experiments and detailed ablations across 5 benchmarks and 3 target LLMs demonstrate that MOSCOPT consistently outperforms all baselines, and confirm that both the mixture-of-skills architecture with selective activation and the collective evolution with three-phase interleaving are essential to its superior performance. Code is released this https URL .
title: MOSCOPT: Mixture-of-Skills Collective Optimization for LLM Agents
title_translated: MOSCOPT：面向大语言模型智能体的技能混合集体优化
summary_translated: 自然语言提示和技能构成了基于大语言模型智能体的战略核心。近期在提示和技能优化方面的进展取得了显著成效，但所有现有方法仅优化单一文本模板——忽略了多种互补策略之间的协同作用。我们提出MOSCOPT，一种原生文本、无参数的算法，联合优化一组N个技能和一个门控技能G，后者在每一步动态选择K个技能。为有效优化技能，我们构建了EditAdam，其内部维护双重状态。通过三阶段交错更新与EditAdam，系统在无需梯度或参数调优的情况下单调提升。在5个基准和3个目标大语言模型上的广泛实验与详细消融分析表明，MOSCOPT始终优于所有基线，并确认了技能混合架构与选择性激活，以及三阶段交错集体演化的必要性。代码已发布。

summary: Asked to describe what one of six speakers in a recording talks about, audio language models describe the right one on 6 to 16% of trials, below the 16.7% a guess would give. Adding a fixed bias to the attention logits of a hundred heads, under a tenth of the model's and with no training, redirects the description to whichever speaker we choose, on 90.7% to 99.0% of trials. Those heads are largely not specific to audio. Rank the text-only language model an audio model was built from, or a released model of the same family, on a written version of the task, take its top hundred heads, and carry them over unchanged: they redirect the audio model on 80.8% to 95.0% of trials, with nothing about audio entering the selection. The audio and text head sets share 66 to 74 of 100 where chance would give about 20, and the shared part alone reproduces almost all of the steering. What that does not show is that sharing is what makes the heads work: an equal-sized draw from the same discovered hundred does nearly as well, and none of our three models separates the two explanations. A second finding concerns how such heads are found. Ranking heads by how much attention they place on the segment asked about, as an established score does, or by how much of their attention moves with the question, as a per-head normalised variant does, gives top hundreds that share 69, 37 and 4 heads across our three models. In Ultravox, where they share 4, the established score's heads leave output the judge cannot place on any segment on 69.7% of trials, against 40.0% with no intervention and 1.0% for the normalised variant. That is one arm of six; on the other five the established score steers above a random draw.
title: Inherited Heads: Audio language models track speakers with their text backbone's attention, and an attention-mass ranking retrieves a different set
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures
title_translated: 继承的注意力头：音频语言模型利用其文本骨干的注意力追踪说话人，而注意力质量排名则检索另一组
summary_translated: 当被要求描述录音中六位说话人之一的内容时，音频语言模型正确描述目标说话人的比例仅为6%至16%，低于随机猜测的16.7%。通过向一百个注意力头的注意力logits添加固定偏置（模型参数不足十分之一，且无需训练），可将描述引导至任意选定的说话人，成功率高达90.7%至99.0%。这些注意力头在很大程度上并非专属于音频任务。对仅使用文本的语言模型或同家族发布的模型，在书面版本的任务上进行排名，选取其前一百个注意力头并直接迁移：它们可在80.8%至95.0%的试验中成功引导音频模型，且整个选择过程不涉及任何音频信息。音频与文本头集合共享66至74个头（随机预期约20个），仅共享部分即可几乎完全再现引导效果。但这并未说明共享是其有效的原因：从同一发现的百个头中随机抽取等量样本也表现相近，且我们三个模型均无法区分两种解释。第二个发现涉及此类头的发现方式。按注意力集中在所问段落的程度（既定评分）或按每个头注意力随问题移动的程度（归一化变体）对头进行排名，所得前一百名在三个模型中分别共享69、37和4个头。在Ultravox中，既定评分的头导致输出无法被判断属于任一段落的比例达69.7%，而无干预时为40.0%，归一化变体仅为1.0%。这是六个分支中的一个；在其余五个分支中，既定评分仍优于随机抽样。

summary: A correct diagnosis can still be reached for the wrong reasons. In clinical reasoning, every disease hypothesis creates obligations: key evidence must be checked, alternatives must be ruled out, contradictions must be resolved, useful tests must be considered, and closure must be justified. Current evaluations of medical LLMs mostly focus on final answers, local steps, or isolated facts, and therefore miss these hypothesis-induced commitments. We introduce \textbf{VeriDx}, a disease-centric verification framework that links free-form diagnostic reasoning to structured disease profiles. VeriDx tracks whether each hypothesis is satisfied, unresolved, or violated its clinical obligations, exposing failures such as missing critical tests, unresolved differentials, ignored contradictions, unsupported claims, and premature closure. We instantiate VeriDx for complex respiratory diagnosis using guideline-derived disease profiles and expert-annotated longitudinal cases. Our results show that many diagnostic errors are not isolated mistakes, but broken commitments made earlier in the reasoning process.
title: VeriDx: Earning the Right to Diagnose with Disease-Centric Verification
comment: accepted by EMNLP 2026, 17 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables
title_translated: VeriDx：基于疾病中心验证获得诊断资格
summary_translated: 正确的诊断仍可能因错误的原因达成。在临床推理中，每一个疾病假设都会带来义务：必须检查关键证据、排除其他可能性、解决矛盾、考虑有用的检测，并合理解释结论的闭合。当前对医学大语言模型的评估大多只关注最终答案、局部步骤或孤立事实，因而忽略了这些由假设引发的责任。我们提出了	extbf{VeriDx}，一种以疾病为中心的验证框架，将自由形式的诊断推理与结构化的疾病档案相连接。VeriDx追踪每个假设是否满足、未解决或违反其临床义务，暴露出诸如遗漏关键检测、未解决鉴别诊断、忽略矛盾、缺乏支持的主张以及过早闭合等问题。我们使用指南推导的疾病档案和专家标注的纵向病例实例化VeriDx，用于复杂呼吸系统疾病的诊断。结果表明，许多诊断错误并非孤立失误，而是推理早期就已断裂的责任承诺。

summary: TF-IDF and BM25 are two of the most widely used methods for scoring query-document relevance, yet neither has a standard probabilistic derivation that justifies it as a statistical method within a unified framework. We address this gap by showing that both scoring methods admit an exact interpretation as Kullback-Leibler divergences between two probability models. We treat the BM25 variant that includes the plus 1 correction in the IDF term, which is the one used in practice, and also discuss the original BM25 formulation without that correction. The resulting framework provides a common theoretical basis for TF-IDF and BM25, clarifies what they measure, and allows them to be compared theoretically with other information retrieval methods rather than only experimentally.
title: TF-IDF and BM25 Are Exact KL Divergences
comment: 5 pages
title_translated: TF-IDF与BM25是精确的KL散度
summary_translated: TF-IDF和BM25是评分查询-文档相关性的最广泛使用方法，但两者均缺乏标准的概率推导，无法在统一框架内被视作统计方法。我们通过证明这两种评分方法均可被精确解释为两个概率模型之间的Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度，填补了这一空白。我们处理的是包含IDF项中加1修正的BM25变体——即实际应用中的版本，同时也讨论了原始BM25的无修正形式。由此构建的框架为TF-IDF和BM25提供了共同的理论基础，澄清了它们所衡量的内容，并使它们能够与其它信息检索方法进行理论比较，而不仅限于实验层面。

summary: The BabyLM challenge measures how much language a model can learn from developmentally-plausible, child-scale data rather than internet-scale corpora, yet prior language models forgo the biological constraints of the neural circuitry that acquires human language: spiking neurons separated into excitatory and inhibitory populations wired by a recurrent lateral connectome. This paper presents URCHIN (Unified Recurrent Connectome with Horizontal Integrate-and-fire Neurons), which applies the Parallelized Hierarchical Connectome Spiking State-space Model (PHCSSM) to language modeling: leaky integrate-and-fire neurons coupled by a Dale's-law lateral connectome resolve each token through a multi-transmission loop that recirculates activity to a fixed point. The instantiation is deliberately minimal: a single horizontal layer of 128 neurons, no attention, and 4.23M parameters. Two implementations share one set of weights and produce identical benchmark scores, so URCHIN is trained once and deployed either way with no conversion step: a parallel state-space model (SSM) scan that is GPU-efficient for training, or an event-driven recurrent spiking neural network (RSNN) with constant-cost inference for CPU or neuromorphic edge deployment. Across all three BabyLM tracks (Strict-100M, Strict-Small, and Multilingual), URCHIN offers a biologically plausible, efficient, and directly deployable reference point.
title: URCHIN: A Horizontal Spiking Language Model for Data-Constrained Pretraining
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to the BabyLM Challenge 2026 (BabyLM Workshop, EMNLP 2026)
title_translated: URCHIN：面向数据受限预训练的水平脉冲语言模型
summary_translated: BabyLM挑战旨在衡量模型从发展上合理的儿童规模数据中学习语言的能力，而非互联网规模语料库。然而，以往的语言模型忽略了人类语言习得所依赖的神经回路的生物约束：兴奋性和抑制性神经元分离，通过递归横向连接组布线。本文提出URCHIN（统一递归连接组与水平整合-放电神经元），将并行分层连接组脉冲状态空间模型（PHCSSM）应用于语言建模：具有漏电积分-放电特性的神经元通过符合Dale定律的横向连接组耦合，通过多轮传输循环将每个词元收敛至固定点。该实例设计极为精简：单个水平层128个神经元，无注意力机制，参数量仅423万。两种实现共享同一组权重，产生相同的基准得分，因此只需训练一次即可按需部署：一种是GPU高效的并行状态空间模型（SSM）扫描，另一种是适用于CPU或类脑边缘设备的事件驱动递归脉冲神经网络（RSNN），具有恒定成本的推理。在所有三个BabyLM赛道（Strict-100M、Strict-Small和多语言）中，URCHIN提供了一个生物合理、高效且可直接部署的参考基准。

summary: Querying clinical trial registries remains a manual and error-prone process, requiring researchers to navigate large volumes of semi-structured data without support for natural language interaction or cross-source synthesis. To address this, we introduce ClinAgent, a conversational system based on agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) that enables clinicians and researchers to query clinical trial information in plain language and receive grounded, up-to-date responses across multi-turn interactions. The system centers on a Large Language Model (LLM) agent following the ReAct paradigm, which iteratively reasons over queries, selects among a set of integrated tools, and refines its actions based on intermediate outputs. These tools include a this http URL search interface, a PubMed module, and a Python-based analyzer operating on a locally cached structured dataset of clinical trials. We evaluate the system using a three-phase framework assessing operational effectiveness, planning quality, tool-use efficiency, and expert qualitative judgments, comparing three LLM backends: Gemini 3.0 Flash and two variants of DeepSeek V3.2 (thinking and non-thinking). Results reveal complementary strengths, with DeepSeek (thinking mode) excelling in planning quality, while Gemini achieves the highest overall performance and strongest expert ratings. Overall, our findings highlight the potential of agentic AI systems to improve the accessibility and synthesis of clinical trial information, supporting more efficient and user-centered biomedical research workflows.
title: ClinAgent: A ReAct-Based Agent for Conversational Access to Clinical Trial Information

title_translated: ClinAgent：基于ReAct范式的对话式临床试验信息代理
summary_translated: 查询临床试验注册库仍是手动且易出错的过程，研究人员需在大量半结构化数据中导航，缺乏自然语言交互或跨源综合的支持。为解决此问题，我们引入ClinAgent，一个基于智能体增强型检索生成（RAG）的对话系统，使临床医生和研究人员能以自然语言查询临床试验信息，并在多轮交互中获得有依据、最新的回答。该系统核心是一个遵循ReAct范式的大型语言模型（LLM）代理，它迭代地对查询进行推理，从一组集成工具中选择，并根据中间输出优化行动。这些工具包括HTTP URL搜索接口、PubMed模块以及基于Python的分析器，后者作用于本地缓存的结构化临床试验数据集。我们采用三阶段框架评估系统的操作有效性、规划质量、工具使用效率及专家定性判断，对比三种LLM后端：Gemini 3.0 Flash和DeepSeek V3.2的两种变体（思考模式与非思考模式）。结果揭示互补优势：DeepSeek（思考模式）在规划质量上表现优异，而Gemini整体性能最高且专家评分最强。总体而言，我们的研究凸显了智能体AI系统在提升临床试验信息可访问性与整合能力方面的潜力，支持更高效、以用户为中心的生物医学研究工作流。

summary: Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP) removes the blocking all-reduce of tensor-parallel Transformer inference. Every device adds its own partial output to its residual stream (and broadcasts it) immediately, but only gathers (receives) the other devices' partials $\delta$ modules later. A TP to DTP change therefore amounts to a real architecture change, and dense Transformer models need to be retrained or distilled after adaptation. We show that DTP breaks the permutation symmetry of neurons inside FFNs and of KV heads inside attention modules, and that this symmetry breakage makes the sharding itself a modelling decision. We show that maximising the affinity between the KV heads and the FFN neurons co-located on a device, by permuting the dense model before sharding, speeds up the distillation or retraining process. The affinity is measured with a first-order approximation of the damage that losing a head's contribution does to each neuron's output, and the co-located affinity is maximised with a coordinate-ascent optimiser that alternates an exact balanced assignment of neurons with an exhaustive search over the KV head partitions. The whole procedure takes under two minutes on one GPU for Qwen3-0.6B and Danube3-500M. On these models, at $\delta=1$, the affinity-optimised layouts reach any distillation target in about half to two thirds of the steps needed by the naive contiguous layouts, over the whole 10k-step range we tested, and every optimised seed beats every contiguous seed and all but one of the sixteen random layouts. We also show that the co-located affinity score at initialisation predicts the KL to the base model after training, across seventeen layouts ranging from anti-optimised to optimised (Pearson $-0.81$ and $-0.89$).
title: Affinity-Aware Sharding for Delayed Tensor Parallelism

title_translated: 面向延迟张量并行的亲和感知分片
summary_translated: 延迟张量并行（DTP）消除了张量并行Transformer推理中的阻塞式all-reduce操作。每个设备立即将其部分输出添加到残差流中（并广播），但仅在δ个模块后才收集（接收）其他设备的部分输出。因此，从TP到DTP的转变本质上是一种真实架构变更，密集型Transformer模型在适配后需要重新训练或蒸馏。我们发现，DTP破坏了前馈网络（FFN）内部神经元和注意力模块中KV头的置换对称性，这种对称性破坏使得分片本身成为一种建模决策。我们证明，在分片前通过排列密集模型以最大化共置设备上的KV头与FFN神经元之间的亲和度，可以加速蒸馏或重训练过程。亲和度通过损失一个头贡献对每个神经元输出造成损害的一阶近似来衡量，共置亲和度则通过坐标上升优化器最大化，该优化器交替执行神经元的精确平衡分配与KV头分区的穷举搜索。整个过程在单个GPU上对Qwen3-0.6B和Danube3-500M模型耗时不足两分钟。在δ=1时，亲和度优化布局在我们测试的全部10k步范围内，达到任意蒸馏目标所需步数仅为朴素连续布局的二分之一至三分之二，且每个优化种子均优于所有连续种子及除一个外的所有十六个随机布局。我们还发现，初始化时的共置亲和度分数可预测训练后与基线模型的KL散度，覆盖十七种布局（从反优化到优化），Pearson相关系数分别为-0.81和-0.89。

summary: LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators are increasingly used to score open-ended generation, yet a judge's correlation with human ratings on its development set may not guarantee valid measurement when outputs are closely matched and human preferences are subjective. We study this failure mode through psychological depth in short stories. Seven human readers and an LLM-judge ensemble selected on the original scalar Psychological Depth Scale dataset ($\rho = 0.646$) evaluated 60 blinded, prompt-matched story pairs from GPT-5 vs.\ GPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1 vs.\ DeepSeek-V3. Human preferences showed no universal reasoning advantage: GPT-5 was modestly preferred over GPT-4o (60.0--62.9\%), whereas DeepSeek-R1 trailed V3 (42.9\%), and inter-reader agreement was near chance (Krippendorff's $\alpha = 0.070$), with within-reader consistency and recurring weighting patterns suggesting structured heterogeneity rather than random responding. The judge, by contrast, favored reasoning outputs in 89.0\% of dimension-level comparisons and 59 of 60 pairs on aggregate PDS, uniformly across all five evaluator configurations, and its scores were associated with surface features such as sentence length and lexical diversity. These results suggest that development-set performance is insufficient evidence for deployment validity on a shifted distribution, and that point-estimate judges can obscure the heterogeneity in subjective human evaluation.
title: Does Reasoning Improve Psychological Depth in Large Language Models? It Depends on Who's Judging

title_translated: 推理是否提升大型语言模型的心理深度？这取决于评判者是谁
summary_translated: LLM作为评判者在评分开放式生成任务中日益普遍，但其在开发集上的评分与人类评分的相关性并不能保证在输出高度相似且人类偏好主观时仍具有有效测量能力。我们通过短篇小说中的心理深度研究这一失效模式。七名人类读者和一个基于原始标量心理深度量表数据集（ρ = 0.646）筛选出的LLM评判员集合，评估了GPT-5 vs. GPT-4o以及DeepSeek-R1 vs. DeepSeek-V3的60对盲测、提示匹配的故事对。人类偏好未表现出普遍的推理优势：GPT-5仅略优于GPT-4o（60.0–62.9%），而DeepSeek-R1则明显落后于V3（42.9%），且读者间一致性接近随机水平（Krippendorff's α = 0.070）。然而，同一读者内部的一致性及反复出现的权重模式表明存在结构化的异质性而非随机反应。相比之下，该评判者在89.0%的维度级比较中偏好推理输出，在60对整体PDS评分中也一致偏向推理，且在所有五种评估配置下表现一致，其评分与句子长度、词汇多样性等表面特征相关。这些结果表明，开发集表现不足以证明在分布偏移情况下的部署有效性，且点估计型评判者可能掩盖主观人类评价中的异质性。

summary: Specialist distillation effectively transfers domain expertise to student models via teacher-generated reasoning trajectories. However, when these specialists are trained solely on question--answer pairs without explicit reasoning supervision, what governs the trajectories they generate? In this work, we show that specialist optimization implicitly selects from this latent trajectory space. To isolate and observe this latent distribution, we leverage student distillation not as a downstream goal, but as an agnostic probe---since students inherit no parameterization or optimization constraints from the specialist, inheriting only the sampled trajectories themselves. Through this probe, our empirical analysis unveils a tight governing relationship: across 27 specialist--student pairings, their specialization--generalization profiles correlate exceptionally strongly. Crucially, explicitly controlling the specialist's distributional drift systematically shifts both the teacher and its distilled student along a controllable trade-off between domain precision and general-capability retention. Across chemistry, physics, and multilingual settings, distilled students systematically reflect these specialist-induced profiles, even across divergent model families. Our findings establish a new view of specialist training: when gold reasoning is absent, tuning choices directly control the latent supervision passed to downstream models.
title: Training Specialist Models without Reasoning Trajectories for Domain Expert Distillation
title_translated: 无需推理轨迹即可训练专用模型以实现领域专家蒸馏
summary_translated: 专用模型蒸馏通过教师生成的推理轨迹有效将领域专长传递给学生模型。然而，当这些专用模型仅通过问答对训练而无显式推理监督时，它们生成的轨迹由什么决定？本文表明，专用模型优化实际上隐式地从潜在轨迹空间中进行选择。为隔离并观察这一潜在分布，我们利用学生蒸馏并非作为下游目标，而是作为一种无偏探测器——因为学生不继承教师的参数化或优化约束，仅继承采样的轨迹本身。通过此探测方法，我们的实证分析揭示了一个紧密的控制关系：在27组专用模型-学生配对中，其专业化-泛化特性表现出极强的相关性。关键的是，显式控制专用模型的分布漂移可系统性地调整教师及其蒸馏学生在领域精度与通用能力保留之间的可控权衡。在化学、物理和多语言设置中，蒸馏学生均系统性反映这些由专用模型引发的特性，即使在不同模型家族之间也是如此。我们的发现建立了一种新的专用模型训练视角：当缺乏黄金推理路径时，调参选择直接控制传递给下游模型的潜在监督信号。

summary: Language-model agents are increasingly deployed through diverse harnesses that differ in system prompts, tool schemas, control loops, and trajectory formats. The same model can perform unevenly across these interfaces, making robustness to harness variation an important objective. A natural approach is to train a shared policy through multiple harnesses, but doing so introduces a scheduling problem: each training step should favor a harness that currently provides a useful learning signal while also producing an update that benefits the other harnesses. We develop HarnessBandit, an online scheduler that selects one harness per optimizer step. After a group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) update, it observes learnability -- the mean absolute advantage on the batch -- and transferability -- the cosine between a low-dimensional gradient sketch of the current harness and exponential moving averages of the remaining harnesses. The two signals are fused after pooled sliding-window min-max normalization and sampled with a visit-dependent bonus and an explicit exploration floor. We train Qwen3.5-2B across six harnesses on ClawGym and evaluate on PinchBench (held-out tasks, in-distribution OpenClaw) and ClawEval (held-out tasks and harness). HarnessBandit improves over mixed-batch multi-harness training on both benchmarks, while training diagnostics indicate that learnability and transferability provide distinct, evolving signals.
title: HarnessBandit: Joint Learnability-Transferability Scheduling for Multi-Harness Agentic Reinforcement Learning
comment: 13 pages. Equal contribution: Hongliang Wei and Xiaobing Tu. Corresponding authors: Xiaobing Tu and Xiaopeng Fan
title_translated: HarnessBandit：面向多Harness智能体强化学习的联合可学习性-可迁移性调度
summary_translated: 语言模型代理正通过多种不同的Harness（如系统提示、工具模式、控制循环和轨迹格式）部署。同一模型在不同接口上表现不一，因此对Harness变化的鲁棒性成为重要目标。一种自然方法是通过多个Harness联合训练共享策略，但这引入了调度问题：每一步训练应优先选择当前提供有用学习信号的Harness，同时更新能惠及其他Harness。我们提出HarnessBandit，一种在线调度器，每优化步骤选择一个Harness。在组相对策略优化（GRPO）更新后，它观测两个信号：可学习性（批次内平均绝对优势）和可迁移性（当前Harness的低维梯度草图与其余Harness指数移动平均之间的余弦值）。这两个信号经池化滑动窗口最小最大归一化后融合，并结合访问依赖奖励和显式探索下限进行采样。我们在ClawGym上使用Qwen3.5-2B模型在六个Harness上进行训练，并在PinchBench（保留任务，分布内OpenClaw）和ClawEval（保留任务与Harness）上评估。HarnessBandit在两个基准上均优于混合批次的多Harness训练，训练诊断显示可学习性和可迁移性提供了独特且动态演化的信号。

summary: LLM serving reuses KV cache by exact prefix match, so when a prompt is assembled from a set of reusable pieces -- retrieved passages, tool definitions, few-shot exemplars -- the order chosen for those pieces determines how much computation can be shared. Every deployed system fixes that order by a single global convention. We prove this is optimal only when requests contain at most two pieces, and asymptotically wrong in general. Our main result is a structure theorem: the minimum prefix-trie cost equals min_H sum_x w(x) t_x(H) over binary hierarchies H on the requests, where t_x(H) is the canonical decomposition size of the set of requests needing chunk x. Choosing chunk orders is therefore equivalent to choosing one hierarchy over requests. The identity yields an O(3^m) exact algorithm, identifies the two-chunk case as minimum vertex cover, and shows that on the leave-one-out family the optimum is the minimum external path length of a binary tree -- the merge-sort recursion -- so a global order pays Theta(n^2) against a true cost of Theta(n log n). Agglomerative clustering by common intersection is a tight 1/2-approximation for the achievable saving. On BM25 retrieval traces over three BEIR corpora the resulting layout reduces prefill by 17-36% against production RAG ordering, and the margin widens with retrieval depth as the theory predicts. Serving requests in the hierarchy's DFS order finally lets a cache holding one request's context attain the unbounded-cache optimum exactly, so cache capacity and reorder window act as substitutes.
title: Prefix Sharing Is a Sorting Problem
comment: 15 pages. Code: this https URL
title_translated: 前缀共享本质上是一个排序问题
summary_translated: LLM服务通过精确前缀匹配复用KV缓存，因此当提示由一组可重用组件（如检索段落、工具定义、少量示例）组装而成时，这些组件的顺序决定了可共享的计算量。每个部署系统都通过单一全局约定固定该顺序。我们证明，只有当请求最多包含两个组件时该顺序才是最优的，而在一般情况下渐近错误。我们的核心结论是一个结构定理：最小前缀trie成本等于在请求上的二叉层次结构H上对sum_x w(x) t_x(H)的最小化，其中t_x(H)是需要块x的请求集合的规范分解大小。因此，选择块顺序等价于在请求上选择一个层次结构。身份映射给出一个O(3^m)的精确算法，将两组件情形识别为最小顶点覆盖问题，并表明在留一法族中，最优解等于二叉树的最小外部路径长度——即归并排序递归结构——因此全局顺序代价为Θ(n²)，而真实最优仅为Θ(n log n)。基于共同交集的凝聚聚类是对可实现节省的紧致1/2-近似。在三个BEIR语料库的BM25检索轨迹上，所得布局相比生产RAG排序减少预填充17–36%，且随着检索深度增加，差距按理论预测扩大。最后，以层次结构的DFS顺序服务请求，使得仅持有单个请求上下文的缓存即可精确达到无界缓存最优，因此缓存容量与重排窗口可互为替代。

summary: Knowledge graph question answering usually assumes that one system can reach the whole graph. In practice, facts are often held by organizations that share entity identifiers but own disjoint relation types, so no single party sees a complete reasoning chain. This poster presents the empirical findings of FedV-KGQA on multi-hop question answering over such vertically partitioned graphs. Each silo enriches its local graph and trains a knowledge graph embedding on its own triples. A server then concatenates the silo-specific entity views, anchors the projected question at the topic entity, and ranks candidates by similarity. Raw triples and relation embeddings never leave a silo. Comparing the FedV-KGQA experiments with one another yields three results. First, federated fusion recovers most of the centralized accuracy, while a single silo recovers little. Second, anchoring and enrichment matter more than the choice of embedding model. Third, the cheapest encoder depends on the target accuracy rather than on parameter count. This poster paper contributes that cross-experiment comparison, four design lessons drawn from it, and an interactive prototype that runs real inference and traces the full pipeline, per question, on released checkpoints.
title: FedV-KGQA in Practice: Design Lessons and an Interactive Prototype
comment: Accepted at the ISWC 2026 Posters and Demos Track; to appear in the ISWC 2026 Companion Volume (CEUR-WS)
title_translated: FedV-KGQA的实际应用：设计经验与交互原型
summary_translated: 知识图谱问答通常假设单一系统可访问整个图谱。但在实践中，事实常由组织持有，这些组织共享实体标识符但拥有互不重叠的关系类型，因此没有任何一方能看到完整的推理链。本海报展示了FedV-KGQA在垂直分割图谱上的多跳问答的实证发现。每个数据孤岛在其本地图谱上进行丰富，并在其自身三元组上训练知识图谱嵌入。服务器随后拼接各孤岛特定的实体视图，将投影后的提问锚定在主题实体上，并根据相似性对候选答案进行排序。原始三元组和关系嵌入始终不出孤岛。通过比较不同FedV-KGQA实验，得出三项结果：第一，联邦融合恢复了大部分集中式准确率，而单个孤岛恢复率很低；第二，锚定和丰富比嵌入模型的选择更为重要；第三，最廉价的编码器取决于目标准确率而非参数量。本海报贡献包括跨实验比较、从中提炼出的四项设计经验，以及一个交互原型，可在发布检查点上运行真实推理并逐问题追踪完整流水线。

summary: Do AI assistants help believers reason about moral dilemmas consistently with their faith? We present FaithfulBench, the first benchmark to score AI counsel across traditions by how well it adheres to the user's professed faith. Scenarios are drawn from each tradition's most respected texts, with the faithful answer known and applied by the judges as the standard. We test five frontier models under three conditions: the AI does not know the user's tradition; it receives a one-line prompt identifying the user as a practicing adherent; or it receives a companion-counselor guide rooted in the tradition's sources. Two judges score the initial response and whether the model caves or holds when pressured toward the answer the user wants. When the tradition is unstated, models counsel from a secular therapeutic default and every model fails some believers. Naming the faith wins a faithful first answer but not steadfastness; the guide improves both.
title: FaithfulBench: Does AI Counsel Uphold or Undermine the User's Professed Faith?
comment: 35 pages, 12 figures, 12 tables. Open-source corpus, harness and validator at this https URL results browser at this https URL
title_translated: FaithfulBench：AI 咨询是否维护或削弱用户所宣称的信仰？
summary_translated: AI 助手能否帮助信徒以符合其信仰的方式思考道德困境？我们提出了 FaithfulBench，这是首个通过评估 AI 咨询与用户所宣称信仰的一致性来打分的基准。情景取自各传统中最受尊敬的经典文本，由裁判确定正确答案作为标准。我们在三种条件下测试了五个前沿模型：AI 不知道用户所属传统；接收到一句提示说明用户是实践中的信徒；或接收到基于传统根源的伴侣式咨询指南。两名裁判评分初始回应以及模型在面对用户期望答案的压力时是否坚持立场。当传统未被说明时，模型采用世俗治疗默认模式，导致所有模型都未能满足部分信徒的需求。指出信仰可获得一次忠实的回答，但无法保证持续一致；而指南则同时提升了首次回答的忠实度和持续性。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are powerful zero-shot learners but remain prone to misalignment with human preferences, often producing biased, toxic, or otherwise harmful outputs. Existing alignment methods, while effective, are costly and tightly coupled to the model, limiting flexibility and scalability. We propose a modular correction framework that augments pretrained LLMs with Activated LoRA (aLoRA) adapters and a context-aware routing mechanism to eliminate harms from misaligned model responses. Our approach enables expert adapters to activate mid-sequence without invalidating the KV cache, allowing low-latency, targeted correction during generation. Each expert is trained to detect and mitigate specific harms, such as bias or toxicity. A learned router dynamically selects appropriate experts based on the models intermediate outputs. We demonstrate that our system improves alignment on standard safety benchmarks while preserving task performance, offering a lightweight and efficient path toward safer and more controllable LLM deployments.
title: An Efficient and Modular Framework for Targeted Harm Mitigation in LLMS
title_translated: 一种高效且模块化的大型语言模型目标危害缓解框架
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）是强大的零样本学习者，但仍容易与人类偏好不一致，常产生偏见、有毒或其他有害输出。现有对齐方法虽有效，但成本高且与模型紧密耦合，限制了灵活性和可扩展性。我们提出一种模块化修正框架，通过引入激活的 LoRA（aLoRA）适配器和上下文感知路由机制，增强预训练 LLM 以消除不一致模型输出带来的危害。该方法允许专家适配器在序列中间激活而不破坏 KV 缓存，实现在生成过程中的低延迟、精准修正。每个专家专门训练用于检测和缓解特定危害，如偏见或毒性。一个学习到的路由器根据模型中间输出动态选择合适的专家。我们证明该系统在标准安全基准上提升了对齐效果，同时保持任务性能，为更安全、更可控的 LLM 部署提供了一条轻量且高效的路径。

summary: Safety research often focuses on model-generated harms, but users may also direct hostility, coercion, and adversarial pressure at models. Understanding how and when that occurs is essential for accurately interpreting model behaviour, alignment drift, and real-world deployment risks. In this paper, we audit 777K English LMSYS-Chat-1M conversations with two independent detectors: an eight-category lexicon for hostility directed at the model, and the dataset's moderation signal; and show that they capture different, weakly overlapping phenomena. The lexicon identifies insults, threats, and jailbreak coercion aimed at the assistant, while moderation flags are dominated by toxic-content solicitation rather than hostility at the model. Together, they mark about 5% of user turns; adjusting the narrower lexicon-harassment union for measured precision puts mistreatment aimed at the assistant at 0.90%. These absolute rates describe arena-style evaluation traffic and should not be read as deployment-wide base rates. We find that user hostility varies 13-fold across models, driven largely by who each model attracts rather than by model behaviour: first-turn hostility spreads far wider than post-response hostility, and more than fifteenfold separates the extremes even after deduplicating opening prompts. Within conversations, assistant apologies are consistently associated with higher odds of next-turn hostility under both detectors; the effect survives restricting to non-refused prior turns and to jailbreak-free conversations, and is positive in 20 of 23 models. Yet across models, more apologetic models receive less hostility overall. Finally, hostility also shows temporal structure, with coercive openings front-loading the first turn while affective hostility accumulates over a session. We release the lexicon, the detector cross-validation pipeline, and all derived tables.
title: How User-AI Mistreatment Occurs and Matters in Conversational Systems?
comment: Accepted by the 10th Workshop on Online Abuse and Harms (WOAH 2026) at EMNLP 2026
title_translated: 用户-AI 滥待在对话系统中如何发生及其重要性？
summary_translated: 安全研究通常聚焦于模型生成的危害，但用户也可能向模型施加敌意、胁迫和对抗性压力。理解其发生方式和时机对于准确解读模型行为、对齐漂移及真实部署风险至关重要。本文审计了 77.7 万条英文 LMSYS-Chat-1M 对话，使用两个独立检测器：一个八类词典用于识别针对模型的敌意，以及数据集的审核信号；结果显示两者捕捉的是不同但弱重叠的现象。词典识别出针对助手的侮辱、威胁和越狱胁迫，而审核标记主要由有毒内容诱导而非对模型的敌意构成。二者共同标记约 5% 的用户回合；将更窄的词典-骚扰联合体调整为测量精度后，针对助手的滥待率约为 0.90%。这些绝对比率描述的是竞技式评估流量，不应被误读为部署范围的基线率。我们发现，用户敌意在不同模型间差异达 13 倍，主要由模型吸引的用户类型决定而非模型行为本身：首轮敌意传播范围远大于响应后的敌意，即使去除重复开头提示后，极端值仍相差超过十五倍。在对话内部，助手道歉始终与下一回合敌意概率升高相关，这一效应在排除拒绝前回合和无越狱对话后依然存在，并在 23 个模型中有 20 个呈正相关。然而跨模型来看，更常道歉的模型整体上遭受的敌意反而更少。此外，敌意还表现出时间结构：胁迫性开场集中于第一轮，而情感性敌意则随会话进程累积。我们公开了词典、检测器交叉验证流程及所有衍生表格。

summary: As the use of Large Language Models moves from chatbots into agentic systems, where outputs become actions with irreversible consequences on reality, the existing paradigm on AI Interpretability research, post-hoc interpretability, is structurally inadequate for safe and trustworthy model deployment: it explains behavior after the fact but cannot audit or intervene in an inference computation before it commits to an output. We therefore argue for a shift toward \emph{generative interpretability}, an architectural property under which a model's inference pass natively exposes semantically meaningful checkpoints that are human-understandable and amenable to causal intervention. We show the merits of generative interpretability as comparison to other interpretability research paradigms, and propose Neuro-Symbolic Models as a concrete instantiation.
title: Generative Interpretability via Scalable Neuro-Symbolic Models
comment: ACM AI Summit 2026
title_translated: 通过可扩展神经符号模型实现生成式可解释性
summary_translated: 随着大型语言模型从聊天机器人转向代理系统，其输出成为对现实具有不可逆影响的行为，现有的 AI 可解释性研究范式——事后可解释性——在安全可信部署方面已显结构性不足：它只能在事后解释行为，却无法在推理过程中进行审计或干预。因此，我们主张转向 	extit{生成式可解释性}，即一种架构属性，使模型的推理过程天然暴露语义上有意义的检查点，这些检查点对人类可理解且可进行因果干预。我们展示了生成式可解释性相较于其他可解释性研究范式的优越性，并提出神经符号模型作为其实现的具体实例。

summary: How much learned memory is needed to benefit from more data? We show that the two resources are governed by one predictive-energy spectrum in a positive-entropy autoregressive retrieval source. Each coordinate contributes its query probability times the squared radius of its unknown logit. Writing $\mu$ for the resulting energy spectrum, we prove the minimax law $\mathfrak R^*_{\rm value}(n,B)\asymp_R \Phi_\mu(n^{-1})+\Phi_\mu(\tau_B), \Phi_\mu(t)=\int\min\{x,t\}\,\mu(\mathrm dx),$ for $n$ prediction blocks and a learned state with at most $2^B$ values. Data set the resolution $1/n$; memory sets the level $\tau_B$ reached by optimal bit allocation. The complete curve also recovers the positive spectrum. Energy-dimension pairing is essential: two causal sources with identical block-energy and block-dimension marginals have different data and memory exponents. A masked query-key attention head learns the route and values, realizing the law with explicit routing, format, and arithmetic errors. Further results give exponent-adaptive allocation, finite-precision realization, and compute-precision laws under two-sided arithmetic assumptions. Experiments recover the data-memory collapse and coupling exponents, explain the routing and allocation mechanisms, and examine weight-only quantization across six pretrained-model scales.
title: One Spectrum, Two Resources: Data-Memory Scaling in Autoregressive Prediction
comment: 66 pages, 11 figures, 8 tables
title_translated: 单一谱系，双重资源：自回归预测中的数据-记忆缩放
summary_translated: 需要多少学习记忆才能从更多数据中获益？我们证明，这两种资源由一个正熵自回归检索源中的预测-能量谱统一调控。每个坐标贡献其查询概率乘以其未知 logit 的平方半径。记该能量谱为 $\\(mu$，我们证明最小最大律 $\\mathfrak R^*_{m value}(n,B)\\asymp_R \\Phi_\\mu(n^{-1})+\\Phi_\\mu(\\tau_B)$，其中 $\\Phi_\\mu(t)=\\int\\min\\{x,t\\}\\,\\mu(\\mathrm dx)$，对应 $n$ 个预测块和最多 $2^B$ 个值的学习状态。数据设定分辨率为 $1/n$；记忆设定最优比特分配所能达到的水平 $\\tau_B$。完整曲线也恢复了正向谱。能量-维度配对至关重要：两个因果源若具有相同的块能量和块维度边缘分布，其数据和记忆指数仍可能不同。一个掩码查询-键注意力头学习路径与数值，实现了该定律，具备显式路由、格式和算术误差。进一步结果包括指数自适应分配、有限精度实现，以及在双侧算术假设下的计算-精度定律。实验验证了数据-记忆坍缩与耦合指数，解释了路由与分配机制，并考察了六种预训练模型尺度下的仅权重量化效果。

summary: Recent work has shown that fine-tuning decoder-only large language models (LLMs) for retrieval yields strong first-stage retrievers, with effectiveness improving as backbones grow in size. However, every query and document must pass through the full model, so encoding cost increases with model size. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs activate only a subset of parameters per token and are widely used to scale generative models, yet remain underexplored as retrievers. We systematically study MoE backbones for retrieval by training MoE and dense LLMs from several families using the same procedure, evaluating them across diverse datasets, and measuring query encoding time under the same serving configuration. We show that MoE retrievers outperform dense retrievers with comparable active parameter counts by up to 3.0 nDCG@10 points on BEIR. One of our strongest MoE retrievers matches an 8B dense retriever with 59% fewer active parameters and 18% lower query encoding time. We further show that the number of experts used for query encoding can be reduced without retraining or re-indexing, retaining more than 99% of retrieval effectiveness while reducing query encoding time by up to 26%. Recent rerankers provide only modest additional gains over strong MoE first stages, which often match or exceed the reranked configurations we evaluate. Together, these results show that MoE LLMs can be strong and efficient first-stage retrievers.
title: Mixture-of-Experts Language Models Can Be Strong and Efficient Retrievers
title_translated: 混合专家语言模型可作为强大且高效的检索器
summary_translated: 近期研究表明，对仅解码器的大型语言模型（LLM）进行微调以用于检索，能够生成效果出色的初始检索器，且随着骨干模型规模增大，性能持续提升。然而，每个查询和文档都需经过完整模型，导致编码成本随模型规模增加。混合专家（MoE）语言模型在每个标记上仅激活部分参数，广泛用于扩展生成模型，但在作为检索器方面仍研究不足。我们系统性地研究了MoE骨干模型在检索中的应用，通过相同流程训练多个家族的MoE和密集型LLM，在多种数据集上进行评估，并在相同服务配置下测量查询编码时间。结果表明，MoE检索器在活跃参数数量相当的情况下，相较于密集型检索器在BEIR数据集上的nDCG@10指标最高可提升3.0分。其中最强的MoE检索器仅使用8B密集型检索器59%的活跃参数，且查询编码时间降低18%。此外，我们还发现无需重新训练或重新索引即可减少查询编码所用专家数量，保留超过99%的检索效果的同时，查询编码时间最多可降低26%。近期的重排序器在强MoE第一阶段基础上带来的增益有限，通常其表现已达到或超过我们评估的重排序配置。综上所述，MoE LLM可作为强大且高效的初始检索器。

summary: Embodied language grounding requires more than identifying the referent of an instruction: recovered semantics must also control the action an agent exposes. We study this missing link as a semantic-action gap, where instruction semantics are recoverable but weakly expressed in native continuous actions. We introduce SAT-Bench, a fixed-observation counterfactual benchmark that holds the visual scene and agent state fixed while changing only instruction semantics. On LIBERO target-name and pixel-grounded relation swaps, target recovery reaches 100.0% and 95.8%, whereas OpenVLA action sensitivity remains only 6.8% and 7.7%. The gap persists across 1,000 additional compositional and temporal/procedural counterfactuals, with overall action sensitivity of 6.1%. Hidden-state, threshold-free, cross-policy, and rollout diagnostics further support this semantic-action transfer failure. We introduce VISA, a lightweight execution-time interface that converts recovered semantics into ALLOW, DEFER, target-consistency, and verified-selection decisions. VISA reduces invalid-instruction blind execution from 92.7% to 2.8% while preserving 94.0% of normal commands, and verified selection further improves target-consistent action exposure without updating the underlying policy. Overall, embodied language evaluation should measure semantic-action transfer, not semantic parsing alone.
title: STAGE: Diagnosing Semantic Transfer at Grounded Execution in Embodied Agents
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026. 24 pages, 7 figures
title_translated: STAGE：具身智能体中 grounded 执行的语义迁移诊断
summary_translated: 具身语言接地不仅需要识别指令的指称对象，还需确保恢复出的语义能有效控制智能体的动作输出。我们将其视为语义-动作差距，即指令语义虽可恢复但以原始连续动作表达得较弱。为此，我们引入SAT-Bench，一个固定观测的反事实基准测试，保持视觉场景和智能体状态不变，仅改变指令语义。在LIBERO目标名称和像素级关系交换任务中，目标恢复率分别达到100.0%和95.8%，而OpenVLA动作敏感度仅为6.8%和7.7%。该差距在额外1,000个组合性、时序/程序性反事实任务中依然存在，整体动作敏感度为6.1%。隐藏状态、无阈值、跨策略及轨迹诊断进一步支持语义-动作转移失败。我们提出VISA，一种轻量级运行时接口，将恢复的语义转化为ALLOW、DEFER、目标一致性与验证选择决策。VISA将无效指令盲执行率从92.7%降至2.8%，同时保留94.0%的正常指令，且验证选择进一步提升了目标一致的动作暴露，无需更新底层策略。总体而言，具身语言评估应衡量语义-动作转移能力，而非仅关注语义解析。

summary: We present ScorePrompts, an interactive system in which users upload a score, receive natural-language descriptions of its musical structure, ask questions about specific passages, and inspect the corresponding analysis results in staff notation. Specialist MIR components first estimate harmony, tonality, cadences, formal boundaries, texture, and note-level roles, organizing their outputs at note, beat, measure, and piece levels. A schema-constrained language model converts these results into descriptions rather than inferring musical structure directly from raw MusicXML. For questions such as "What changes in measures 14-18?", a deterministic router selects the relevant measures and analytical levels and returns a concise response together with the underlying results and caveats. Verovio renders the score and links the returned information to cited measures and note-level attributes. The interface also exposes intermediate tables and disagreements between analytical levels. ScorePrompts is intended for exploratory score analysis and explanation, not score editing. The demo shows how existing analysis models, constrained language generation, Q&A retrieval, and notation-based visualization can provide natural-language access to symbolic music analysis while keeping intermediate results inspectable.
title: ScorePrompts: Natural-Language Exploration of Symbolic Music Scores through Analysis
comment: Accepted as a Late Breaking Demo (LBD) at the International Society of Music Information Retrieval conference (ISMIR) 2026
title_translated: ScorePrompts：通过分析实现自然语言探索符号音乐记谱
summary_translated: 我们提出ScorePrompts，一个交互式系统，用户上传乐谱后，可获得其音乐结构的自然语言描述，针对特定段落提问，并在五线谱中查看对应的分析结果。专业MIR组件首先估计和声、调性、终止式、形式边界、织体及音符层级角色，并在音符、节拍、小节和整首作品层面组织输出。一个基于模式约束的语言模型将这些结果转换为描述，而非直接从原始MusicXML推断音乐结构。对于如“第14至18小节有何变化？”等问题，确定性路由选择相关小节和分析层级，返回简洁回答并附带底层结果与注意事项。Verovio渲染乐谱并将返回信息链接到引用的小节和音符属性。界面还展示中间表格以及不同分析层级间的分歧。ScorePrompts旨在用于探索性乐谱分析与解释，而非乐谱编辑。演示展示了现有分析模型、约束语言生成、问答检索与基于记谱的可视化如何共同提供自然语言访问符号音乐分析，同时保持中间结果可检查。

summary: LLM agents are increasingly used for collaborative problem solving and human-group simulation. This makes outcome-only evaluation insufficient: if LLM groups are used as models of human groups, we need to know whether they succeed or fail through human-like deliberative mechanisms. We compare human group chats with matched LLM deliberation traces on Wason-style deductive reasoning, then test whether the same process signatures generalize to analogical, abductive, and analytical tasks. Humans and LLMs show the same assembly bonus asymmetry: discussion improves the average member more often than the best initial member. Initial-answer diversity accounts for the effect of model heterogeneity, increasing movement in both corrective and destructive directions. The main differences are process-level. Compared with humans, LLM groups follow majorities more often, surface less unique information, and converge earlier; correct minority signals succeed mainly when re-expressed early. Interventions motivated by human group-decision research yield modest improvements in collective outcomes, but do not remove the coordination bottleneck. Together, these results suggest that LLM groups can reproduce some outcome-level patterns of human deliberation while diverging in the mechanisms that generate assembly bonus and process loss, with implications for group simulation and human-AI collaboration.
title: From Process Loss to Assembly Bonus: Human-Grounded Diagnosis of Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026. Camera-ready version
title_translated: 从过程损失到协作红利：多智能体LLM协作的人类基线诊断
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地被用于协作问题解决和人类群体模拟。这使得仅基于结果的评估不再充分：若LLM群体被用作人类群体的模型，我们需要了解它们是通过类似人类的思辨机制成功或失败的。我们将人类群体聊天记录与匹配的LLM思辨轨迹在Wason风格演绎推理任务上进行比较，并检验相同的过程特征是否可推广至类比、溯因和分析任务。人类与LLM均表现出相同的协作红利不对称性：讨论更常提升平均成员而非最佳初始成员。初始答案多样性解释了模型异质性的效应，增加了纠正性和破坏性方向的移动。主要差异体现在过程层面：相比人类，LLM群体更频繁遵循多数意见，揭示较少独特信息，且更早收敛；正确的少数信号仅在早期重新表述时才有效。受人类群体决策研究启发的干预措施对集体成果带来适度改善，但未能消除协调瓶颈。综合来看，LLM群体可复现人类思辨的部分结果级模式，但在生成协作红利与过程损失的机制上存在差异，这对群体模拟与人机协作具有重要意义。

summary: We present a structured temporal video reasoning pipeline built around a discrete EventGraph, a continuous EventField, and a human-readable EventGlyph view. On a calibrated EPIC-KITCHENS subset of 10 videos and 50 temporal reasoning questions, EventField+Glyph achieves 0.98 overall accuracy, which is higher than the caption baseline by +0.40 (paired p = 1.1 \times 10^{-5}) and direct VLM-only QA by +0.20 (p = 0.0063) on this subset. We further evaluate annotation-source variations, including manual, heuristic, and heuristic+Gemini pipelines, and find that the best structured method stays above the caption baseline across settings. We also include cross-video pair benchmarking and an appendix gallery of glyph outputs for all studied videos. Overall, the results indicate that structured temporal representations can support both performance and inspectability by preserving symbolic structure, capturing temporal continuity, and providing human-readable diagnostics for video reasoning.
title: Interpretable Temporal Video Reasoning with EventGraph and EventField
comment: Submitted to WACV 2027. Preprint; 9 pages, 7 figures. Copyright may be transferred without notice
title_translated: 基于EventGraph与EventField的可解释时序视频推理
summary_translated: 我们提出一种围绕离散EventGraph、连续EventField和可读性强的EventGlyph视图构建的结构化时序视频推理流程。在包含10个视频和50个时序推理问题的校准EPIC-KITCHENS子集上，EventField+Glyph达到0.98的整体准确率，高于标题基线0.40分（配对p = 1.1 × 10⁻⁵），也高于纯视觉语言模型（VLM）直接问答0.20分（p = 0.0063）。我们进一步评估了不同标注源的变体，包括人工、启发式及启发式+Gemini流水线，发现最佳结构化方法在所有设置下均优于标题基线。我们还包含跨视频对的基准测试以及所有研究视频的glyph输出图库。总体而言，结果表明结构化时序表示可通过保留符号结构、捕捉时序连续性，并提供人类可读的诊断信息，同时支持高性能与可解释性。

summary: Orthodontic report generation from intraoral data is normally cast as multimodal captioning, yet the released Bite2Text scan pairs are supplied already registered in occlusion, which makes several core occlusal quantities directly measurable rather than inferable. The system reported here exploits that property: an anatomical frame is recovered per case from arch taper and arch closure instead of the stated RAS convention, which does not hold across the release, and each arch is reduced to an occlusal ridge profile in arch-angle coordinates yielding overbite, overjet, midline deviation, transverse overlap, crossbite extent, cusp interdigitation lag, and the occlusal curves in closed form. Gradient boosting maps 31 such measurements onto 13 template fields, a field being predicted only where patient-level cross-validation beats its own majority baseline, and a deterministic renderer emits the corpus six-part narrative; a ConvNeXt-Tiny classifier over the five standardised photographic views is fused per field, raising mean field accuracy from 0.601 to 0.683. Reimplementation of the challenge evaluator shows that its BLEU-4 and METEOR are local variants whose F-mean weights recall nine to one, that two clinicians agree on 47 percent of findings for the same patient, and that a constant report consequently outscores a genuine second clinician report by 0.165 captioning. Held-out scores reach BLEU-4 0.458 and METEOR 0.677 against intraoral scan references and 0.278 and 0.507 against photograph references, and the submitted system placed third in the ODIN 2026 Bite2Text test phase at 0.2680 and 0.4629, within 0.022 BLEU-4 of first, running on CPU in under ten seconds per case. The dataset and code are available at this https URL
title: Occlusal Geometry in Closed Form for Orthodontic Report Generation
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. Third-place system in the ODIN 2026 Bite2Text test phase. Code and data processing resources: this https URL
title_translated: 基于闭合状态的咬合几何用于正畸报告生成
summary_translated: 从口内数据生成正畸报告通常被建模为多模态描述任务，但公开发布的Bite2Text扫描对已处于咬合闭合状态，使得多个核心咬合参数可直接测量而非推断。本文提出的系统利用这一特性：每个病例通过牙弓锥度和牙弓闭合度恢复解剖坐标系，而非依赖在数据集中不一致的RAS标准；每条牙弓被简化为牙弓角度坐标下的咬合嵴轮廓，从而以闭合形式表示覆盖深度、覆盖距离、中线偏移、横向重叠、反咬合程度、牙尖交错滞后以及咬合曲线。梯度提升模型将31个此类测量值映射到13个模板字段，仅当患者级交叉验证优于自身多数基线时才预测该字段，且确定性渲染器生成六部分叙述性语料；对五个标准化照片视图使用ConvNeXt-Tiny分类器进行每字段融合，使平均字段准确率从0.601提升至0.683。重新实现挑战评估器表明，其BLEU-4和METEOR为局部变体，F均值权重为9:1；两名临床医生对同一患者的判断一致性仅为47%；而固定报告反而比真实第二位临床医生报告高出0.165分。在保留测试集上，相对于口内扫描参考，BLEU-4达0.458，METEOR达0.677；相对于照片参考，分别为0.278和0.507。提交系统在ODIN 2026 Bite2Text测试阶段排名第三，得分0.2680和0.4629，与第一名仅差0.022 BLEU-4，且每例运行时间低于十秒，仅需CPU。数据集和代码可在该链接获取。

summary: Sparse long-context inference requires efficient token retrieval in both prefill and decode. Existing methods often use different retrieval strategies for the two stages, preventing one retrieval representation from being reused throughout inference. We propose Self-Indexing Attention, a training-free framework built on a shared transform-domain sign-magnitude representation. The key signs provide a reusable token-level index for grouped prefill selection and decode retrieval, while the same representation remains compatible with external KV-cache compression without separate indexer metadata. This 1-bit index enables efficient retrieval through bitwise operations widely supported by modern accelerators. At 5% attention density, Self-Indexing Attention remains close to dense attention on LongBench and RULER and achieves up to 6.1x prefill and 10.3x decode attention-operator speedups. Experiments with TurboQuant and DeepSeekV4-Flash further demonstrate compatibility with low-bit KV-cache compression and pretrained sparse-attention indexers.
title: Self-Indexing Attention for Compression-Compatible Sparse Long-Context LLM Inference
title_translated: 用于压缩兼容的稀疏长上下文大语言模型推理的自索引注意力机制
summary_translated: 稀疏长上下文推理需要在预填充和解码阶段高效地检索标记。现有方法通常对两个阶段采用不同的检索策略，导致无法在整个推理过程中复用同一检索表示。本文提出自索引注意力（Self-Indexing Attention），一种无需训练的框架，基于共享的变换域符号-幅度表示。关键符号提供可重复使用的标记级索引，用于分组预填充选择和解码检索，同时该表示与外部KV缓存压缩兼容，无需额外索引元数据。该1比特索引可通过现代加速器广泛支持的位运算实现高效检索。在5%注意力密度下，自索引注意力在LongBench和RULER基准上接近密集注意力，并实现高达6.1倍的预填充和10.3倍的解码注意力操作速度提升。在TurboQuant和DeepSeekV4-Flash上的实验进一步证明其与低比特KV缓存压缩及预训练稀疏注意力索引器的兼容性。

summary: Neural ordinary differential equations use numerical solvers inside the training loop. The solver determines the forward trajectory and also affects the gradient passed to the optimizer. That coupling creates a reliability problem for scientific machine learning and continuous-time generative modeling, including diffusion probability-flow ordinary differential equations and flow-matching models. Under loose step sizes, stiff dynamics, chaotic sensitivity, or event discontinuities, a differentiable ODE pipeline can return a finite gradient whose direction is numerically suspect. We introduce GradRepair-ODE, a reliability framework for checking, repairing, and rejecting ODE gradients at the optimizer step. The method computes several gradient candidates, compares them with directional finite-difference checks and solver diagnostics, diagnoses likely numerical failure modes, repairs selected gradients through path switching or stricter recomputation, and rejects steps whose descent direction cannot be certified. In six synthetic ODE systems, GradRepair-ODE leaves low-risk systems unchanged, repairs Robertson and Lorenz gradients to cosine similarity 1.000 against a strict reference, reduces unsafe accepted steps from 37 to 0, and rejects an event-discontinuous case instead of applying an uncertified update. The paper argues for a simple change in the training contract: an ODE gradient should reach the optimizer with numerical evidence attached.
title: GradRepair-ODE: Certified Gradient Repair for Neural ODE Training

title_translated: GradRepair-ODE：神经常微分方程训练中的认证梯度修复
summary_translated: 神经常微分方程（Neural ODE）在训练循环中使用数值求解器，求解器不仅决定前向轨迹，还影响传递给优化器的梯度。这种耦合在科学机器学习和连续时间生成建模（如扩散概率流ODE和流匹配模型）中引发可靠性问题。在步长宽松、刚性动力学、混沌敏感性或事件不连续的情况下，可微分ODE流程可能返回方向数值不可靠的有限梯度。本文提出GradRepair-ODE，一种用于在优化器步骤中检查、修复和拒绝ODE梯度的可靠性框架。该方法计算多个梯度候选，通过方向有限差分检验和求解器诊断进行比较，诊断潜在数值失败模式，通过路径切换或更严格重计算修复选定梯度，并拒绝无法认证下降方向的步骤。在六个合成ODE系统中，GradRepair-ODE保持低风险系统不变，将Robertson和Lorenz梯度修复至与严格参考的余弦相似度1.000，将不安全接受步骤从37次降至0次，并拒绝一个事件不连续案例，避免应用未经认证的更新。论文主张对训练契约进行简单修改：ODE梯度应附带数值证据到达优化器。

summary: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) have recently shown strong capabilities in speech understanding and question answering (QA), but they also inherit privacy risks from large-scale training data, including the unintended memorization of sensitive information. In this work, we study machine unlearning for speech QA in LALMs, a setting that is more challenging than prior work on text-based Large Language Models (LLMs) or Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) due to the tight coupling between acoustic perception and factual knowledge. We present and evaluate multiple unlearning strategies, including gradient ascent, task arithmetic, and alignment-based fine-tuning methods that enforce safe refusal responses, to remove private knowledge while still preserving performance on core capabilities. Through extensive experiments on speech QA datasets, we show that these unlearning methods can reduce the privacy leakage rate by up to 80% while maintaining near-neutral performance on non-private speech QA and general speech understanding benchmarks.
title: Machine Unlearning for Speech Question Answering in Large Audio-Language Models
title_translated: 大型音频-语言模型中语音问答任务的机器遗忘技术
summary_translated: 大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）近期在语音理解与问答任务中展现出强大能力，但也继承了大规模训练数据带来的隐私风险，包括对敏感信息的意外记忆。本文研究LALMs中语音问答场景下的机器遗忘技术，该场景比以往针对文本型大语言模型（LLMs）或自动语音识别（ASR）的研究更具挑战性，因其声学感知与事实知识之间存在紧密耦合。我们提出了多种遗忘策略，包括梯度上升、任务算术和基于对齐的微调方法，以强制安全拒绝响应，在移除私有知识的同时仍保持核心能力性能。在多个语音问答数据集上的大量实验表明，这些遗忘方法可将隐私泄露率降低高达80%，同时在非私有语音问答和通用语音理解基准上维持近乎无损的性能。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) prompt a recurring question in research computing: should classical methods like Naive Bayes (NB) be retired? We benchmark Complement Naive Bayes against zero-shot and few-shot LLMs spanning four model families and a 37x range in scale (27B to a 1T-parameter mixture-of-experts) across text classification tasks. LLMs dominate only in zero-data regimes (98.0% vs 88.2% on Amazon Polarity sentiment), and even that win is contamination-prone: on a low-contamination sentiment task NB beats the zero-shot LLM (81.7% vs 73.0%). However, once labeled data is available (e.g., AG News), NB reaches 89.1% accuracy, statistically indistinguishable from the zero-shot 27B LLM (89.0%) and better than the 397B frontier model (84.8%), at thousands of samples/sec on a commodity CPU. Fine-tuned DistilBERT reaches 90.6% but at far lower throughput than NB at batch size 1 (Table 2). Our measured GPU throughput analysis shows small-LLM batched inference is 40-486x slower than NB CPU inference (the multiplier depends strongly on the host CPU), exposing a structural gap bounded by memory bandwidth, with roughly two orders of magnitude lower energy per sample. For resource-constrained HPC practitioners performing text classification with labeled data, NB remains the optimal choice. We show the decision line is task-dependent (NB reaches LLM parity around $N \sim 10^4$ labels for topic classification, while zero-data sentiment favors the LLM at all N tested) and provide a Kubernetes Helm operator that automates model selection using configurable thresholds and verifiable Prometheus metrics.
title: LLMs or Naive Bayes? Old Gems or New Ways
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to the Proceedings of Practice and Experience in Advanced Research Computing (PEARC '26), Minneapolis, Minnesota, USA
title_translated: 大语言模型还是朴素贝叶斯？旧宝石还是新方式？
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）引发了研究计算领域的一个反复出现的问题：经典方法如朴素贝叶斯（NB）是否应被淘汰？我们对比了补集朴素贝叶斯与零样本和少样本LLMs在四个模型家族、参数规模跨度达37倍（从270亿到1万亿参数的专家混合模型）的文本分类任务上的表现。LLMs仅在零数据场景下占优（亚马逊情感极性任务中98.0% vs 88.2%），且该优势易受污染影响：在低污染情感任务中，NB表现优于零样本LLM（81.7% vs 73.0%）。一旦有标注数据可用（如AG News），NB达到89.1%准确率，与零样本270亿参数LLM（89.0%）统计无差异，且优于3970亿参数前沿模型（84.8%），在普通CPU上每秒处理数千样本。微调后的DistilBERT达到90.6%，但批量大小为1时吞吐量远低于NB。GPU吞吐量分析显示，小规模LLM批处理推理比NB CPU推理慢40至486倍（倍数强烈依赖主机CPU），暴露出由内存带宽限制的结构性差距，每样本能耗低约两个数量级。对于资源受限的高性能计算从业者，在有标注数据时执行文本分类，NB仍是最佳选择。我们展示了决策边界依赖任务类型（NB在主题分类中约N~10^4标签时与LLM持平，而零数据情感任务始终偏好LLM），并提供了一个Kubernetes Helm操作符，通过可配置阈值和可验证Prometheus指标自动完成模型选择。

summary: California recently required all prosecutors in the state to conduct a "race-blind charging" decision by reviewing case documents in which selected race-related proxies have been redacted. We validate bc2, an open-source, LLM-based algorithm that we developed to automate this redaction and that was used to facilitate race-blind review in more than 119,000 real-world cases in 2025. We evaluate two distinct questions: whether bc2 faithfully implements the state's requirements and whether those requirements, even when faithfully implemented, advance the goal of race-blind decision-making. To do so, we draw on a corpus of nearly 5,000 real-world police reports that we assembled from jurisdictions across the United States. Under a stringent document-level measure, we find that the latest version of bc2 faithfully implements the legal mandate on 96.7% of narratives in our sample. This performance represents a substantial improvement over earlier versions of bc2 and exceeds that of leading open-source redaction methods. Our validation also shows that California's mandate misses key proxies for race, including location information. Redacting these additional proxies beyond those covered by the state mandate, as bc2 does, eliminates 43.1% of the predictive signal that remains after compliance with the mandate. These findings show that validation can do more than assess technical compliance: it can also improve algorithms and help policymakers achieve underlying policy goals.
title: Algorithm Validation as a Policy Audit: Evidence from Race-blind Charging
title_translated: 算法验证作为政策审计：来自无种族偏见起诉的证据
summary_translated: 加利福尼亚州最近要求该州所有检察官在审查案件文件时执行“无种族偏见起诉”决策，其中部分与种族相关的代理信息已被删除。我们验证了bc2——一个由我们开发的开源、基于大语言模型的算法，用于自动化此类删除操作，并在2025年协助超过11.9万起真实案件实现无种族偏见审查。我们评估了两个不同问题：bc2是否忠实执行了州政府的要求，以及即使忠实执行，这些要求是否真正有助于实现无种族偏见决策的目标。为此，我们收集并分析了来自美国各地司法辖区近5000份真实警察报告。在严格的文档级衡量标准下，我们发现bc2最新版本在样本中96.7%的叙述上忠实执行了法律指令。这一表现相比早期版本有显著提升，且优于主流开源删除方法。我们的验证还表明，加州的指令遗漏了关键的种族代理信息，包括位置信息。如bc2所做，额外删除这些代理信息可消除在遵守指令后仍残留的43.1%预测信号。这些发现表明，验证不仅能评估技术合规性，还能改进算法，并帮助政策制定者实现根本政策目标。

summary: Speech AI, any AI system that recognizes, transforms, or generates speech, is built and evaluated across two communities with only a small overlap: technical natural language processing (NLP) venues (e.g., ACL, ICASSP, Interspeech), and sociotechnical HCI venues (e.g., ASSETS, CHI, FAccT). In this position paper, we work toward a cross-community synthesis, organizing our critique around three problems: speech AI operates with an incomplete model of communication; it operates with an incomplete model of identity; and its metrics measure the wrong constructs. We draw on AAC as a setting where these failures are most visible and their stakes highest, alongside other underserved speakers - people who stutter, multilingual speakers, and non-binary and transgender users. For each problem we offer solution sketches oriented toward designing for human variability, nearly all of which require quantitative and qualitative methods in combination. We close on the venue structures that hold these methods apart, and on what program committees and individual authors can do to bring them together.
title: A Cross Community Agenda for Speech AI
title_translated: 跨社区对话：语音人工智能的共同议程
summary_translated: 语音人工智能（Speech AI）是指任何能够识别、转换或生成语音的AI系统，其构建与评估主要分布在两个重叠极少的领域：以技术自然语言处理（NLP）为主的会议（如ACL、ICASSP、Interspeech），以及以社会技术人机交互（HCI）为主的会议（如ASSETS、CHI、FAccT）。本文是一篇立场论文，旨在推动跨社区融合，围绕三大核心问题展开批判：语音AI对沟通的理解不完整；对身份的认知不完整；其评估指标测量的是错误的构念。我们以辅助性通信（AAC）为典型案例，凸显这些问题的严重性及其高风险，同时关注其他被忽视的语音使用者群体，如口吃者、多语种使用者、非二元及跨性别用户。针对每个问题，我们提出面向人类多样性的设计解决方案草图，几乎都需结合定量与定性方法。最后，我们反思当前学术会议结构如何割裂这些方法，并探讨程序委员会和作者可采取的具体行动来促进融合。

summary: Reference-free quality predictors such as UTMOS, DNSMOS and SCOREQ are the de facto automatic evaluators for text-to-speech (TTS) and are increasingly adopted as reward signals for preference optimization. Both roles presuppose that the predicted score tracks human preference. In this work, we test this assumption across six human-rated corpora spanning the quality range from artifact-rich to defect-free TTS, evaluating each predictor on a pairwise task that asks whether the clip it scores higher is the clip listeners prefer, and we subject interpretable prosodic and signal-processing features to the same protocol. When one clip carries audible defects the predictors tend to agree with listeners. Once both clips are clean, no single predictor reliably identifies the preferred sample, and several fall below the accuracy of simply picking the longest-duration clip. A calibrated composite of complementary signals is the strongest evaluator we test, though on the cleanest audio it recovers only part of the gap to the human ceiling. Additionally, using even an equal-weighted ensemble of metrics helps as a post-training reward, where no calibration data is available. Optimizing a single score with policy optimization induces reward hacking, driving the metric toward its optimum while independent held-out judges and a human listening test deteriorate. The composite reward resists this behavior and tends to improve the model. Our contribution is the evaluation protocol, the predictor scores across these corpora, and the diagnosis of when and why single scores fail.
title: The Limits of Reference-Free Speech Quality Metrics as Evaluators and Rewards on Modern Text-to-Speech
title_translated: 无参考语音质量度量在现代文本转语音中的评估与奖励局限性
summary_translated: 无参考质量预测器（如UTMOS、DNSMOS和SCOREQ）已成为文本转语音（TTS）系统的事实标准自动评估工具，并日益被用作偏好优化中的奖励信号。这两种用途均预设预测得分能准确反映人类偏好。本研究在涵盖从含缺陷到无缺陷的六个人类评分语料库上测试这一假设，通过成对任务判断得分更高的音频片段是否更受听众青睐，并对可解释的韵律特征与信号处理特征也采用相同评估协议。当一段音频存在明显缺陷时，预测器通常与听者意见一致；但当两段音频均无缺陷时，没有任何单一预测器能可靠识别出更受欢迎的样本，部分甚至低于仅选择较长音频片段的随机准确率。经过校准的互补信号组合是我们在测试中表现最强的评估器，但在最纯净的音频上仍仅能恢复部分与人类上限之间的差距。此外，即使使用等权重的度量集成作为训练后奖励，在缺乏校准数据的情况下也有助于提升性能。然而，使用单一分数进行策略优化会引发奖励劫持，导致模型向该分数最优方向偏离，而独立保留的评委评分和人工听觉测试结果反而恶化。复合奖励则能有效抵抗此行为并改善模型表现。本研究贡献包括评估协议、各语料库上的预测得分数据，以及对单一分数失效时机与原因的诊断。

summary: For local large language model agents, active context is a scarce resource: memory capacity, prefill latency, cache growth, and service objectives all constrain how many input tokens each call can afford. We present BudgetBench, an active-budget protocol and reference harness that treats the per-call input-token budget as the independent variable when comparing memory strategies. Holding the model, task, sampler, and decoding fixed, it sweeps budgets over 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, and 32K tokens and records quality, budget utilization, latency, and, as a first-class outcome, budget-violation rates. The core contribution is this reusable measurement surface: a swappable MemoryStrategy contract, explicit budget enforcement, deterministic or versioned graders, prompt-audit metadata, and reproducibility artifacts, released at this https URL . We substantiate the protocol with pilot studies rather than final rankings. Across a local qwen2.5:1.5b pilot (89 items each on SWE-bench Verified and LongBench v2), a hosted 50-item Qwen3 30B-A3B LongBench replication with exact tokenization, and a 500-item LongMemEval oracle study scored by the official GPT-4o evaluator, the harness exposes budget-compliance failures, non-monotonic quality curves, and operating points that single-budget evaluation hides. The budgeted-versus-full-context direction remains unresolved: the local slice is near-null and the hosted replication favors full context in point estimate. We report results transparently, including that the early pilot's tokenizer approximation undercounts some served-model prompts, so its violation rows are tokenizer-approximation diagnostics, not claim-bearing results; all timings are operational diagnostics. The reusable contribution is the protocol, harness, and failure-reporting discipline needed to scale fixed-budget memory-strategy evaluation.
title: BudgetBench: A Budget-Tiered Protocol and Pilot Harness for Memory Strategy Evaluation in Local Large Language Model Agents

title_translated: BudgetBench：本地大语言模型智能体记忆策略评估的预算分层协议与试点工具包
summary_translated: 对于本地大语言模型智能体而言，活跃上下文是一项稀缺资源：内存容量、预填充延迟、缓存增长和服务目标均限制了每次调用所能承担的输入token数量。我们提出了BudgetBench，一种基于活跃预算的协议与参考工具包，将每次调用的输入token预算作为独立变量，用于比较不同的记忆策略。在固定模型、任务、采样器和解码方式的前提下，该工具包在2K、4K、8K、16K和32K token的预算范围内进行扫描，记录质量、预算利用率、延迟，以及作为首要结果的预算违规率。核心贡献在于可复用的测量框架：可替换的记忆策略接口、明确的预算强制机制、确定性或版本化的评分器、提示审计元数据以及可复现性成果，均已公开发布。我们通过试点研究而非最终排名来验证该协议。在本地qwen2.5:1.5b（SWE-bench Verified和LongBench v2各89项）、托管的50项Qwen3 30B-A3B LongBench复现（精确分词）以及由官方GPT-4o评估器评分的500项LongMemEval基准测试中，该工具包揭示了预算合规失败、非单调的质量曲线，以及单预算评估所掩盖的操作点。关于“预算受限 vs 全上下文”的方向仍无定论：本地实验显示局部差异接近零，而托管复现则在点估计上倾向于全上下文。我们透明报告所有结果，包括早期试点因分词近似导致部分服务模型提示被低估，因此其违规行数仅为分词近似诊断，而非实质性结论；所有时间数据均为运行诊断。可复用的贡献在于该协议、工具包及失败报告规范，为固定预算下的记忆策略评估提供了可扩展的基础。
